192: अतिरेक अतिरेक, i. e. अति-रिच् + अ, m. Excess, high degree.
193: अतिलुब्धता अति-लुब्ध + ता (vb. लुभ्), f. Excessive greediness, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 109.
194: अतिलोभता अति-लोभ + ता, f. Ex-cessive greediness.
195: अतिवर्तन अतिवर्तन, i. e. अति-वृत् + अन, n. Remission (of a fine), Man. 8, 290.
196: अतिवर्तिन् अतिवर्तिन्, i. e. अति-वृत् + इन्, adj., f. नी।  1. Crossing, passing over.  2. Not caring, Daśak. in Chr. 194, 8.  3. Offending, Rām. 4, 16, 37.
197: अतिवाद अतिवाद, i. e. अति-वद् + अ, m. A reproachful speech, Man. 6, 47.
198: अतिवाह्य अति-वाह्य (vb. वह्), n. Passing (as time), Böhtl. Chr. 217, 38.
199: अतिवृत्ति अति-वृत् + ति, f. Trespass, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 3.
200: अतिशय अतिशय, i. e. अति-शी + अ, m.  1. Excellence.  2. Excess, Śiś. 9, 77.  3. Plenty, Vikr. d. 157.  4. As former part of comp. words: 1. In a high degree, great, Pañc. 239, 14. 2. Violent.  -- Comp. निरतिशय, i. e. निस्-, adj. not to be surpassed, greatest, Pañc. i. d. 36. स-, adj. most ex-cellent, Man. 9, 114.
201: अतिशयिन् अतिशयिन्, i. e. अतिशय + इन्, adj., f. नी। Most excellent, Vikr. d. 159.
202: अतिशायिन् अतिशायिन्, i. e. अति-शी + इन्, adj. Surpassing, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 1.
203: अतिसमीपता अति-समीप + ता, f. Too close proximity, Śiś. 9, 81.
204: अतिसर्ग अतिसर्ग, i. e. अति-सृज् + अ, m. Granting (of a wish), Rām. 4, 52, 21.
205: अतिसार and अतीसार अती̆सार, i. e. अति-सृ + अ, m. Diarrhœa.
206: अतीन्द्रिय अतीन्द्रिय, i. e. अति-इन्द्रिय।  I. adj. Surpassing the senses, trans-cendental, Bhāṣāp. 57.  II. n. Mind, Man. 1, 7.
207: अतीव अतीव, i. e. अति-इव, adv.  1. Much, very.  2. Indeed, Śāk. d. 137, v. r.
208: अतृप्तिता अ-तृप्ति + ता। f. Insatia-bleness, Śiś. 9, 64.
209: अतोर्थम् अतोर्थम्, i. e. अतस्-अर्थ + म्, adv. To that end, Rām. 3, 8, 15.
210: अत्ता अत्ता, f. A mother, Mṛcch. 27. 2. (Prākṛ.)
211: अत्तृ अत्तृ, i. e. अद् + तृ, m. One who eats, Man. 5, 30; (a king) who swal-lows up the possessions of his people, Man. 8, 309.
212: अत्य अत् + य, m. A horse, Chr. 290, 6 = Rigv. 1, 64, 6.
213: अत्यन्त अत्यन्त, i. e. अति-अन्त, adj., f. ता।  1. Excessive, very large.  2. Endless, perpetual, Man. 5, 46; eternal. acc. sing. तम्, adv. 1. very much. 2. for ever, Man. 9, 202.
214: अत्यय अत्यय, i. e. अति-इ + अ, m.  1. Passing away, lapse (of time), Man. 8, 145.  2. Death.  3. Danger, Man. 5, 27.  4. Transgression, crime, fault, Man. 8, 243; दाप्यो ऽष्टगुणम् अत्ययम्, ‘he shall be fined eight times the amount of the defraudation,’ Man. 8, 400.  -- Comp. अन्-, adj. imperishable. काल-, m. lapse of time, Man. 8, 145. जल-, m. the end of the rainy season, i. e. autumn. तप-, m. 1. the end of the hot season, i. e. the rainy season. 2. the end of the heat, i. e. sunset, Śāk. d. 60. दुरत्यय, i. e. दुस्-, adj., f. या, 1. hard to be crossed (as a river), MBh. 4, 1970. 2. hard to be attained, 13, 4880. 3. unfathomable, Rām. 3, 71, 15. निरत्यय, i. e. निस्-, adj., f. या, 1. free from danger. 2. infallible. महा-, 1. m. great pain, Chr. 11, 15. 2. adj. very pernicious, Chr. 22, 22. सु-महा-, adj. very dan-gerous, Chr. 37, 3.
215: अत्यर्थम् अत्यर्थम्, i. e. अति-अर्थ + म्, adv. Exceedingly.
216: अत्र अ + त्र (cf. इदम्), adv.  1. = the loc. of इदम्, In this, Śāk. d. 59.  2. Here, therein, Man. 3, 235.
217: अत्रत्य अत्र + त्य, adj. Of this place, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 18.
218: अत्रि अत्रि, m. The name of a Ṛṣi, or saint, Man. 1, 35.
219: अत्रिन् अत्रिन् (for अत्त्रिन्, vb. अद्), adj. A demon, Chr. 292, 10 = Rigv. 1, 85, 10.
220: अथ अ + थ (probably for अथा, Ved. cf. इदम्), adv.  1. Then, Nal. 17, 35.  2. Now, at the beginning of works and parts of works.  3. But, Nal. 22, 13.  4. In conditional sentences: If, अथ तान् नानु गच्छामि गमिष्यामि य-मक्षयम्, ‘if I do not follow them, I shall go to the house of death,’ Rām. 2, 60, 3. -- With following उ, (अथो): 1. afterwards, then, Chr. 56, 11. 2. and, Man. 2, 430. 3. even, Chr. 3, 1; and 23, 28. -- With following अपि, ne-vertheless, Rām. 2, 29, 7. -- With fol-lowing वा: 1. or also, or, Man. 2, 219. Pañc. i, d. 399, वाथ instead of वा-थ वा (cf. Pañc. iii, d. 36. अथो वा, Man. 3, 202). 2. or even, Bhartṛ. 2, 10. 3. but no, Śāk. 60, 18. 4. it is particularly used to introduce sen-tences: for, Pañc. 26, 14. -- With fol-lowing किम्: yes, well (in dialogue, cf. τί μήν). -- Cf. Lat. at.
221: अथर्वन् अथर्वन् (borrowed from the Zend. आथ्र-वन्, derived from आतर्, ‘fire’), m.  1. A priest.  2. The name of a Ṛṣi, or saint.  3. The Atharvaveda.
222: अथर्वाङ्गिरस अथर्वाङ्गिरस, i. e. अथर्वन्-अङ्गिरस् + अ।  1. adj., f. सी। Revealed to Atharvan and Angiras, Man. 11, 33.  2. sing and pl. The hymns of the Atharvaveda.
223: अथर्वी अथर्वी, f. (probably from अ-थर्वन्), The wife of a priest(?), Chr. 296, 10 = Rigv. 1, 112, 10.
225: अद् अद्, ii, 2, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm. Nal. 12, 35). To eat, Man. 2, 53; to devour, 4, 28. स्वदित, i. e. सु-अदित, n. Well eaten, a term used after presenting food (‘muc good may it do you!’), Man. 3, 251; 254. अद्य, Eatable, Pañc. iv. d. 79 (perhaps it ought to be changed to आद्य, the regular form). -- Cf. ἔδω; Lat. edere; Goth. itan; A.S. etan.
226: ऽअद् -अद्, latter part of comp. words. One who eats, cf. क्रव्याद्।
227: अदन अद् + अन, n. Eating, Man. 11, 64.  -- Comp. फल-, m. a parrot.
228: अदम्भित्व अदम्भित्व, i. e. अ-दम्भिन् + त्व, n. Sincerity.
229: अदस् अदस्, pronoun, nom. sing. m. and f. असौ, nom. and acc. sing. n. अदस्; the bases of the remaining cases are अमु, अमू, and अमी। That, you, Man. 10, 128. It is preceded by the rela-tive pronoun, He-who, Man. 1, 7.
230: अदायिक अदायिक, i. e. अ-दाय + इक, adj. For which there are no heirs.
231: अदिति अ-दिति, f. The name of a fe-male deity, Chr. 298, 25 = Rigv. 1, 112, 25; the mother of the gods, Rām. 3, 20, 15.
232: अदृश्यता अ-दृश्य + ता (vb. दृश्), f. Invisibility, Bhartṛ. 1, 95.
233: अदेशकाल अ-देश-काल, s. A wrong place and wrong time, Bhag. 17, 22.
234: अद्भुत अद्भुत।  I. adj., f. ता। Sur-prising, wonderful; superl. अद्भुत + तम, most surprising.  II. n. A strange phenomenon, Man. 4, 118; a prodigy  -- Comp. अत्यद्भुत, i. e. अति-, adj. very surprising. महा- adj. very surprising.
235: अद्य अद्य, Ved. also अद्या, i. e. अ -दिव् + आ (cf. इदम्), adv.  1. To-day.  2. Now. -- Cf. Lat. ho-die, ἤδη.
236: अद्यतन अद्य + तन, adj., f. नी।  1. Of to-day, Pañc. 5, 6. -- 2. Of this time, a contemporary, Rājat. 5, 100. ‘The Hriṣīkeśa (i. e. an idol of Viṣṇu) of Suyya, reposing in meditation on the bank, may be adored by any con-temporary who comes near the temple of Sundarī.’
237: अद्यतनीय अद्यतनीय, i. e. अद्य-तन + ईय, adj., f. या। Of to-day, Pañc. 169, 13.
238: अद्यूति अद्यूति, i. e. अ-दिव् + ति, adj. Eager, Chr. 298, 24 = Rigv. 1, 112, 24.
239: अद्रि अद्रि, m.  1. A stone, Chr. 293, 3 = Rigv. 1, 88, 3.  2. A mountain.  3. A cloud, Chr. 291, 5 = Rigv. 1, 85, 5.  4. A proper name.  -- Comp. अस्त-, m. the mountain called अस्त (q. cf.). कुत-, m. a principal mountain. तुषार-, तुहिन-, and प्रालेय-, m. Himālaya.
240: अद्रिसारमय अद्रि-सार + मय, adj. f. यी। Made of iron.
241: अद्वयत्व अ-द्वय + त्व, n. Absence of duality. त्व + तस्, adv. In conse-quence of there being no duality, Vedāntas. in Chr. 218, 23 (i. e. because he knows that there is no duality, that all is one).
242: अद्वारतस् अ-द्वार + तस्, adv. By any other aperture than the door, MBh. 13, 4750.
243: अद्वेषरागिन् अद्वेषरागिन्, i. e. अ -द्वेष-राग + इन्, adj. Exempt from hatred and affection, Man. 2, 1.
244: अद्वेष्टृत्व अ-द्वेष्टृ + त्व, n. In-offensiveness, Vedāntas. in Chr. 219, 6.
245: अध अ + ध (cf. अधस्), a particle. There, then, Lass. Anth. 98, 14 = Rigv. 5, 9, 5.
246: अधम अधम (an old superlative, akin to अधस्), adj., f. मा। Extremely low, Man. 6, 65. In Karmadhāraya compounds it is generally the latter part: e. g. द्विज-, m. the meanest of twice-born men, Man. 3, 140; नर-, m. the lowest of mortals, Man. 10, 26; पाप-, m. the lowest of the wicked; पार्थिव-, m. the meanest of kings; पुरुष-, m. the vilest of men; शशक-, m. the vilest of hares.  -- Cf. Lat. infimus.
247: अधमर्ण अधमर्ण, i. e. अधम -ऋण, m. A debtor, Man. 8, 47.
248: अधमर्णिक अधमर्णिक, i. e. अध-मर्ण + इक, m. A debtor, Man. 8, 48.
249: अधर अधर (an old comparative, akin to अधस्).  I. adj., f. रा। Lower, inferior.  II. m.  1. The lower lip Śāk. 102, 10.  2. The lip in general, Śiś. 9, 46.  -- Comp. खण्ड्त्त-, adj., f. रा, with bitten lips, Pañc. 46, 1. --Cf. Lat. inferus; Goth. undar; A.S. under; probably ἔνεροι.
250: अधरोष्ठ अधरोष्ठ, and अधरौष्ठ अधरौष्ठ, i. e. अधर-ओष्ठ, m.  1. The lower lip, Suśr. 1, 114, 19.  2. The lower and the upper lips, the lips, Pañc. 45, 11.  -- Comp. अङ्गुलि-सम्-वृत-, adj. the lips of which are covered with the finger, Śāk. d. 73. विम्ब-फल-, adj., f. ष्ठी, having lips like the Bimba fruit, Rām. 5, 28, 17.
251: अधस् अ + धस् (cf. इदम्).  I. adv.  1. Underneath.  2. Low, Man. 11, 224.  3. Down, Pañc. i. d. 214; to hell, Man. 7, 53.  II. prepos. Under, with the gen., Man. 2, 59, and abl. Pañc. 115, 25.  III. doubled: अधो-धस्, i. e. अधस्-अधस्, adv.  1. Lower and lower, Man. 7, 53.  2. One below the other. -- Cf. ἔνθεν, and see अधर।
252: अधस्तात् अधस्-तात् (the latter part is the original abl. of तद्).  I. adv.  1. Underneath, below.  2. Down, down-ward, Man. 4, 54; to hell, 194.  II. prepos. Under, with the gen.  III. latter part of comp. adv. Under, Pañc. 141, 20.
253: अधि अ + धि (cf. इदम्).  I. adv. Above, on high, Chr. 291, 2 = Rigv. 1, 85, 2.  II. prepos. Over, on with the abl., Chr. 287, 7 = Rigv. 1, 48, 7.  III. Combined and compounded with verbs and their derivatives.  IV. Former part of compounded nouns and adverbs, implying:  1. Over, cf. अधिज्य  2. Chief, cf. अधिराज।  3. Before, cf. a-ध्यक्ष।  4. Relative to, cf. अधियज्ञ।  5. On, cf. अधिजानु। -- Cf. Lat. ad.
254: अधिक अधि + क, adj.  1. Exceed-ing, Man. 3, 49; greater, Rām. 4, 9, 9 stronger, Pañc. ii. d. 29; more than, with the abl., Man. 9, 154; higher than, with the abl., Bhag. 6, 46; dearer, Rām. 2, 45, 32, Gorr.  2. Surpassing, Man. 11, 185; chief, Hit. pr. d. 48; highest, Bhartṛ. 2, 17.  3. Having an addition, अधिकं मासम्, ‘a month and more,’ Rām. 3, 15, 27.  4. Too much, Rām. 6, 16, 78. -- acc. sing. कम्, adv. 1. Much, exceedingly. 2. More; with the abl., Rājat. 5, 419. Comparat. अधिक + तर, Better than, Śāk. 100, 17.  -- Comp. 1. exceeding, e. g. एक-, adj. exceeding one, i. e. two, Man. 9, 117. सर्व-दान-, adj. better than any gift, Yajñ. 1, 334. प्राण-, adj. dearer than life. वर्ष-शत-, adj. longer than a century. 2. exceeded by, par-ticularly after numerals, e. g. वर्षे॥। राजन्यबन्धोर् द्वाविंशे, वैश्यस्य द्व्यधिके ततह्, ‘in the twenty-second year for a soldier, for a merchant two years later than that,’ Man. 2, 65. नवतिं नवाधिकाम्, ninety-nine, Ragh. 3, 69. वयोधिक, i. e. वयस् -अधिक, adj. advanced in age, Man. 4, 141. 3. doubled: अधिकाधिक, adj. outbidding each other, Rājat. 5, 264.
255: अधिकरण अधिकरण, i. e. अधि -कृ + अन, n.  1. Substance, substratum, or site.  2. Court of justice, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 20.  -- Comp. धर्म-, n. 1. administration of justice, Pañc. 97, 1. 2. A court of justice, Pañc. 96, 25. राम-, adj. relating to Rāma, Rām. 2, 15, 29. समान-,  I. n. generic property.  II. adj. contained in the same subject or category.
256: अधिकार and अधीकार अधी̆कार, i. e. अधि-कृ + अ, m.  1. Superintend-ence, Vikr. d. 42.  2. Administration.  3. Office, Pañc. 63, 23.  4. Office of a king.  5. Right, title, Man. 2, 16.  6. Topic, main point.  -- Comp. ताम्बूल-, m. the bearer of betel, an officer, Pañc. 63, 22. धर्म-, m. administration of justice. पृ-तना-, adj. relating to battles, MBh. 1, 7166. समान-, m. 1. equal duty. 2. generic character. हृत-, adj. 1. deprived of office. 2. deprived of one's right.
257: अधिकारित्व अधिकारित्व, i. e. अधि-कारिन् + त्व, n. The office of a super-intendent, Rājat. 5, 470.
258: अधिकारिन् अधिकारिन्, i. e. अधि -कार + इन्, adj.  1. One who holds an office, Pañc. i. d. 180.  2. A super-intendent, Hit. 61, 7.  3. One who is entitled to, or fit for, something, Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 9.  -- Comp. धर्म-, m. a judge, Pañc. 101, 2.
259: अधिक्षेप अधिक्षेप, i. e. अधि-क्षिप् + अ, m.  1. Detraction, Rājat. 5, 234.  2. Censure, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 3.  3. Sneer, 184, 16.
260: अधिगम अधि-गम् + अ, m.  1. Com-ing to, attaining, Megh. 50.  2. Acces-sion to, Rājat. 5, 45.  3. Gaining, profit, Man. 8, 157.  4. Reading, Man. 2, 2.  5. Perception, Śiś. 9, 19.  -- Comp. दुस्-, adj. 1. hard to be attained, Mālav. 10, 8. 2. difficult to be learned, Kir. 5, 18.
261: अधिगमन अधि-गम् + अन, n.  1. Obtaining, Rām. 4, 45, 19.  2. Reading, Man. 11, 65.  -- Comp. दार-, n. mar-riage, Man. 1, 112.
262: अधिगुण अधि-गुण, adj. Of supe-rior qualities, Megh.
263: अधिगोप्तृ अधिगोप्तृ, i. e. अधि-गुप् + तृ, in धन-, m. A name of Kuvera, MBh. 5, 7521.
264: अधिजनन अधि-जन् + अन, n. Birth. Man. 2, 169.
265: अधिजानु अधि-जानु, adv. On the knee, Śiś. 9, 54.
266: अधिज्य अधि-ज्य (cf. ज्या), adj. Strung (as a bow), Śāk. d. 6.
267: अधिज्यता अधिज्य + ता, f. Condi-tion of being strung, Ragh. 11, 14.
268: अधित्यका अधि + त्य + का, f. Land on the upper part of a mountain, Hit. 101, 18.
269: अधिप अधि-प (vb. 2. पा), m.  1. A lord, Chr. 3, 3.  2. A king.  3. A superintendent, Rājat. 5, 233.  4. A commander.  -- Comp. अमर-, m. a name of Indra, Rām. 2, 74, 19. स -अमर-, adj. with the lord of the gods, Rām. 3, 53, 28. जन-, m. a king. जल-, m. a name of Varuṇa. तारा-, m. the moon, Rām. 3, 58, 4. दण्ड-, m. lord chief justice, Kathās. 25, 130. दण्ड-धर-, m. a king, Rājat. 4, 655. देव-, m. Indra. द्वार-, m. a porter, a chamberlain, Rājat. 5, 213. धरा-, m. a king. नगर-, m. chief of the police in a town, Kathās. 5, 49.
270: अधिपति अधि-पति, m.  1. A lord, an owner, Man. 8, 37.  2. A king.  -- Comp. गण-, m. Śiva, Śiś. 9, 27. त्रि-, m. epithet of Kṛṣṇa-Viṣṇu (lord over the three primary qualities), Bhāg. P. 3, 16, 24. दशाधिपति, i. e. दशन्-, m. a commander of ten men, MBh. 12, 3712. धन-, m. a name of Kuvera, Kir. 5, 16. नगर-, m. chief of the police in a town, Kathās. 10, 70.
271: अधिमन्थ and अधीमन्थ अधि-मन्थ, i. e. अधि-मन्थ् + अ, m. Acute pain in the eyes.
272: अधिमांसक अधि-मांस + क, m. Inflammation of the tonsils.
273: अधियज्ञ अधि-यज्ञ।  I. m. The supreme sacrifice, Bhag. 8, 4.  II. acc. sing. ञम्, adv. Concerning sacrifice, Man. 6, 83.
274: अधियोध अधि-योध, m. A cham-pion(?), Rām. 6, 23, 28.
275: अधिरथ अधि-रथ, m.  1. A charioteer.  2. A proper name.
276: अधिराज अधिराज, i. e. अधि-राजन्, m. A supreme king.

528: अन्तरतस् अन्तर + तस्, adv.  1. From the interior, Śiś. 9, 19.  2. Within (in his heart), Rām. 3, 62, 1.

999: † अर्क् अर्क्, i. 10, Par. (rather a de-nom. derived from अर्क).  1. To praise.  2. To heat.

1008: अर्चक अर्च् + अक। adj. Worshipping, Man. 11, 224.
1009: अर्चन अर्च् + अन, n. Worship, Da-śak. in Chr. 181, 19.
1010: अर्चा अर्च् + आ, f. Worship, Chr. 56, 11.

1012: अर्चितृ अर्च्-इतृ, m. A worshipper, Rām. 5, 32, 7.

1017: 2. अर्ज् अर्ज्, i. 10, Par. To work, to prepare. -- With the prepositions समुप सम्-उप, To prepare, Chr. 14, 21 (read तत् तु).
1018: अर्जन अर्ज् + अन, n. Earning, ac-quisition, Böhtl. Indr. Spr. 219.

1020: अर्णव अर्णव (from अर्ण, ved. by aff. व for वन्त्), m. The ocean, Rām. 4, 9, 38.  -- Comp. महा-, m. the ocean. लवण-, m. the sea of salt water, Rām. 1, 1, 70. स-पर्वत-वन-, adj., f. वा (viz. पृथिवी, earth), with its moun-tains, forests, and seas, Rām. 1, 16, 32.
1021: अर्त्ति अर्त्ति, i. e. अर्द् + ति, f. Pain, Kathās. 13, 152.

Kathās. 22, 52. तैर् एवार्थ्यमानस्, Being requested by them. -- With the prep. अभि अभि, To ask, to request, Prab. 109, 18, with two acc; Par., with acc. and loc. Kathās. 26, 148. त्वाम् भर्तृत्वे ऽभ्य् अर्थयिष्यति, She will ask thee to become her husband. अभ्-यर्थित, Asked, Man. 2, 189. n. De-sire, Yājñ. 2, 88. -- With कद् कद्।  1. To treat ill, Böhtl. Ind Spr. 591.  2. To reproach, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 15.  3. To torment, Kathās. 18, 243. -- With प्र प्र, To request, Pañc. 255, 22; प्रार्थयान instead of प्रार्थयमान, Rām. 2, 25, 31; with inf. किम् इदं प्रार्-थितं कर्तुम्, What is this which you intend to do? To prepare, Rām. 4, 26, 25 (Par.); Chr. 55, 7.  2. To consider, Rām. 6, 101, 17.  3. To expect, Vikr. 20, 9.  4. To interpret, Śāk. d. 67.  5. To judge, Pañc. 185, 2.  6. 1023: अर्थ अर्थ, i. e. ऋ + थ, m.  1. De-sire; विवाह-, a marriage suit.  2. Aim; सिद्ध-, one who has obtained his aim, Chr. 62, 60.  3. Advantage, Bhartṛ. 2, 40.  4. Business, Man. 2, 67.  5. The acc. अर्थम् is used as an adverb, but almost always at the end of a compound word, implying, ‘for,’ ‘on account of,’ e. g. यज्ञ-सिद्धि-अर्थम्, For the performance of sacri-fices, Man. 1, 23. The dat. अर्थाय, and loc. अर्थे, may be also used at the end of a compound word, or may govern the genitive. Abl. अर्थात्, ‘to wit,’ ‘namely,’ Sch. Śāk. d. 41.  -- Comp. इति-अर्थ + म्, adv. to this end, Brāhmaṇav, 3, 4. इन्द्रिय-, m. an object of sense, Man. 4, 16. एतद्-अर्थ + म्, therefore, Pañc. i. d. 330; in order, Rām. 2, 52, 24 किम्-, adj. with what aim, Chr. 57, 24. किम्-अर्थ + म्। adv. why, to what end, Nal. 22, 7. कृत-, adj. having attained one's end, satis-fied, Rām. 4, 34, 22. गृह-, m. the business of the house, Man. 2, 67. तद् -अर्थ + म्, adv. therefore, Rām. 1, 73, 4. निरर्थ, i. e. निस्-,  I. m. nonsense.  II. adj. 1. purposeless. 2. poor. 3. un-meaning. निश्चितार्थ, i. e. निस्-चित-, (vb. चि), adj. completely resolved, Rām. 4, 42, 9. पर-, m. 1. great import-ance. 2. the interests of another. 3. sexual intercourse. परम-, m. 1. the most sublime truth. 2. the whole truth. 3. reality. 4. earnest, Śāk. d. 51. पुरुष-, m. 1. the object or aim of man. 2. human exertion. भूत-, m. an element of life. महा-,  I. m. a principal object.  II. adj. 1. significant. 2. dignified. यज्ञ-, adj. serving for a sacrifice, Bhag. 3, 9. यथा-, adj. 1. according to the sense. 2. proper, right, थम्, adv. suitably, properly. अ-यथा-, adj. not true, Śāk. d. 54. यद्-अर्थ + म्, adv. for what reason, Chr. 3, 3. यावदर्थ, i. e. यावन्त्-,  I. adj. as much as may be useful, Man. 2, 182.  II. adv. थम्, as much as may be useful, ib. 2, 51. स्व-,  I. adj. 1. having one's own object. 2. having a literal meaning. 3. pleonastic.  II. m. 1. property. 2. own object. 3. own interest, Bhartṛ. 2, 59.

2441: उलूक उलूक, m.  1. An owl, Bhartṛ. 2, 89.  2. A name of Indra, Chr. 46, 26.  3. The name of a country, its people (plur.), and its king, MBh. 1, 335, etc.  Comp. कुम्भ-, m. A kind of owl, MBh. 13, 5499. -- Cf. Lat. ulula, A.S. and O.H.G. ūla.
2442: उलूखल उलूखल (cf. उदूखल), n. A mortar, Pañc. 249, 8.
2443: ऽउलूखलिक -उलूखलिक, i. e. उलू-खल + इक, adj. A substitute for the last, when latter part of comp. adj., e. g. दन्त-, adj. One who uses his teeth as a mortar or pestle, Man. 6, 17.
2444: ऽउलूखलिन् -उलूखलिन्, i. e. उलू-खल + इन्, in दन्त-, adj. Using his teeth as a mortar or pestle, Rām. 1, 52, 26 Gorr.
2445: उल्का उल्का, i. e. probably ज्वल् + क, f.  1. A firebrand, Rām. 3, 75, 51.  2. Fire falling from heaven, a meteor, Man. 1, 38.  -- Comp. तृण-, f. a burn-ing bunch of grass, Hit. i. d. 81. मका-, f. a great fireball, Man. 4, 103. -- Cf. Lat. Vulcanus.
2446: उल्मुक उल्मुक, i. e. perhaps ज्वल् + मन् + क, cf. उल्का,  I. n. A firebrand, Pañc. 38, 20.  II. m. A proper name, MBh. 2, 1275.
2447: उल्लङ्घन उल्लङ्घन, i. e. उद्-लङ्घ् + अन, n. Transgress, Kathās. 22, 57.
2448: उल्लाप उल्लाप, i. e. उद्-लप् + अ, m. Violent cry, Bhartṛ. 3, 6 (perhaps, with the former part खल-, a comp. of the Bahuvr. class, denoting a tyrant, cf. Galanos' translation).
2449: उल्लापिक उल्लापिक, i. e. उल्लाप + इक (?), adj. Betraying(?), Chr. 57, 22.
2450: उल्लापिन् उल्लापिन्, i. e. उद्-लप् + इन्, adj., f. नी, Calling out, Amar. 36.
2451: उल्लास उल्लास, i. e. उद्-लस् + अ, m.  1. Skipping, Amar. 48.  2. Joy, Sāh. D. 83.  -- Comp. चिदुल्लास, i. e. चित्-, adj. rejoicing the mind, Bhāg. P. 9, 11, 33.
2452: उल्लासन उल्लासन, i. e. उद्-लस् + अन, n. Delighting, making happy, Rājat. 5, 243 (हस्ताग्रवेष्टनोल्लासनस्पृशः खड्गस्य, Of the sword which seemed to rejoice at being grasped by his hand).
2453: उल्लुञ्चन उल्लुञ्चन, i. e. उद्-लुञ्च् + अन, n. Pulling, Yājñ. 2, 217.
2454: उल्लेख उल्लेख, i. e. उद्-लिख् + अ, m. Description, Kathās. 25, 225.
2455: उल्लेखन उल्लेखन, i. e. उद्-लिख् + अन, n. Scraping, Man. 5, 124.
2456: उल्व उल्व, n.  1. Amnium, the caul, Ait. Br. 1, 3.  2. The womb, Bhag. 3, 38. -- Cf. Lat. vulva.
2457: उल्वण उल्वण (probably akin to उरु, of which the original form has been उर्वन्, cf. εὐρυν-ω for εὐρυνϳω), adj., f. णा।  1. Abundant, MBh. 3, 340.  2. Evident, Rājat. 5, 148 (incarnate).  -- Comp. अति-, adj. very violent, Rām. 3, 30, 29.
2458: उशनस् उशनस्, m., nom. sing. उशना, The name of a Ṛṣi or saint, Rām. 6, 31, 14; identified with Śukra, regent of the planet Venus, MBh. 1, 3204.
2459: उशीनर उशीनर, m. The name of a country, its people (pl.), and its king, MBh. 1, 227.
2460: उशीर उशीर, m. and n. The root of a fragrant grass, Andropogon muri-catum, Rām. 2, 55, 14.
2461: उष् उष्, i. 1, Par.  1. To burn; to burn up, Man. 4, 189.  2. To chas-tise, Man. 9, 273. -- Cf. αὕω, εὕω, εὔσανα, εὕστρα; Lat. uro prurire; O.H.G. usil-var, yellow, probably Lat. aurum. --Cf. 2. वस्।
2462: उषती उषती (ptcple. of an aor. of उष्?), f. Inauspicious, MBh. 1, 3558.
2463: उषर्बुध् उषर्बुध्, i. e. उषस्-बुध्, adj. Early awake, Chr. 295, 18 = Rigv. i. 92, 18.
2464: उषस् उषस्, i. e. 2. वस् + अस्, f. The dawn, morning, Kir. 5, 40; ved. nom. pl. उषासस्, Chr. 294. 2 = Rigv. i. 92, 2. The deity of the dawn, Chr. 287, sqq.  -- Cf. aeol. αὔως (= the original nom. sing. वसास्), ἠώς; Lat. aurora.
2465: उष्ट्र उष्ट्र,  I. m. A camel, Man. 3, 162.  II. f. उष्ट्री, A she-camel, Pañc. 87, 6.  -- Comp. खर-, n. an ass and a camel, Yājñ. 2, 160.
2466: उष्ट्रिका उष्ट्रिका, i. e. उष्ट्री + क, f. A she-camel, Pañc. 228, 16.
2467: उष्ण उष्ण, i. e. उष् + न,  I. adj., f. णा, Hot, Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 17.  II. m. and n. The hot season, Man. 11, 113.  -- Comp. अति-, adj. exceedingly hot, Man. 3, 236. अन्-, adj. not hot, Man. 2, 61; chilly, Śiś. 9, 3.
2468: उष्णग उष्ण-ग (vb. गम्), m. The hot season, Rām. 5, 31, 16.
2469: उष्णता उष्ण + ता, f., and उष्णत्व उष्ण + त्व, n. Heat, MBh. 3, 15101.
2470: उष्णालु उष्णालु, i. e. उष्ण + आलु, adj. Hot, Vikr. d. 41.
2471: उष्णिमन् उष्णिमन्, i. e. उष्ण + इमन्, m. Heat, Śiś. 9, 65
2472: उष्णीष उष्णीष, m. and n. A diadem, a turban, Chr. 25, 56; Rājat. 5, 206.
2473: उष्णीषिन् उष्णीषिन्, i. e. उष्णीष + इन्, m. A name of Śiva, MBh. 13, 1158.  -- Comp. कञ्चुकोष्णीषिन्, i. e. कञ्चुक-उष्णीष + इन्, the affix be-longing to both parts of the compound, wearing jackets and turbans, Rām. 6, 99, 23.
2474: उष्मन् उष् + मन्, m.  1. Heat, MBh. 9, 13969.  2. Ardour, Pañc. ii. d. 67; Śiś. 9, 85.  3. Hot moisture, Man. 1, 45.  -- Comp. धन-, m. ardent longing for wealth, Man. 9, 231. नि-धान-, m. ardour, courage, caused by the possession of a treasure, Pañc. 118, 15. निस्-, adj. cold, MBh. 14, 476.
2475: उसर् उसर्, i. e. 2. वस् + अर् (र् for न्, and originally for वसन्त्, identic with उषस् for वसन्त्), f. Dawn, morning; acc. pl. उस्रस्, Lass. 100, 15 = Rigv. vii. 15, 8. -- Cf. ἦρι = loc. वस्रि, ἄμιστον, breakfast, αὔριον.
2476: उस्र उस्र, i. e. 2. वस् + र,  I. m. A ray of light, Kir. 5, 31.  II. f. रा, A cow, Chr. 293, 1 = Rigv. 1. 87. 1; Chr. 294, 4 = Rigv. i. 92, 4.
2477: उस्रिया उस्रिया, i. e. उस्र + इय, f. A cow, Chr. 297, 12 = Rigv. i. 112, 12.
2478: † उह् उह्, i. 1, Par. To hurt or to kill.
2481: ऊढि ऊढि, i. e. वह् + ति, f. Bringing, Rājat. 5, 173.
2482: ऊति ऊति, f. i. e.  I. अव् + ति,  1. As-sistance, Chr. 288, 14 = Rigv. i. 48, 14; help, Lass. 98, 16 = Rigv. v. 9, 6; ऊती, ved. instr. sing, Chr. 291, 13 = Rigv. i. 64, 13.  2. Quickness, Bhāg. P. 8, 5, 44.  II. वे + ति, Web, tissue, Bhāg. P. 2, 10, 1; 4.
2483: ऊधन् ऊधन्, and, with र् for न्, ऊधर् ऊधर्, and ऊधस् ऊधस्, based on original *वद्-धन्त् (cf. उदन्, vb. धा, and पयोधस्), n. An udder.  -- Cf. οὖθαρ, uber; O.H.G. ūtar; A.S. uder.
2485: ऊधस्वन्त् ऊधस् + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Having exuberant udders.
2486: ऊन् ऊन्, i. 10, Par. (properly a denom. of the following), To detract.
2487: ऊन ऊन (probably for वन् + न from वन् = Goth. van, vans: cf. O.H.G. wên-ag, few, perhaps εὖνις, etc.), adj., f. ना।  1. Lessened, Yājñ. 2, 295.  2. Inferior, Man. 9, 123.  3. Wanting, usually as former or latter part of a comp., e. g. अल्प-, adj. Wanting, a little, Man. 8, 217. किंचिद्-, adj. A little less, Sāv. 4, 26. त्रि-भाग-, adj. Reduced by a third, Rājat. 5, 170. दशोन, i. e. दशन्-, adj. Wanting ten, Rām. 1, 46, 12. If one only is wanting, एक may be added, e. g. एकोनचत्वारिंश, i. e. एक-ऊन-, ord. The thirty-ninth, MBh. 1, adhy. 39, but usually it is dropped, e. g. ऊन -विंश, ord. The nineteenth, MBh. 3, adhy. 19. As former part, e. g. ऊन-द्वि -वार्षिक (i. e. -द्वि-वर्ष + इक), adj. A child under two years, Man. 5, 68; ऊन-षोडशवर्ष (i. e. -षष्-दशन् -वर्ष), adj. Under sixteen years, Rām. 1, 22, 2. -- Cf. probably Lat. un-, or unde-, e. g. in unde-viginti = ऊन -विंशति।
2488: † ऊय् ऊय्, i. 1, Ātm. (properly वे, i. 4, Ātm.). To sew, to weave.
2490: ऊरु ऊरु, perhaps akin to उरु, m. The thigh, Rām. 3, 52, 32. When the latter part of a comp. adj., the fem. ends in रु, or रू, e. g. वामोरु, i. e. वाम-, f. रू, Having beautiful thighs, MBh. 1, 1903; but रु (against the grammatical rule), MBh. 1, 2988. क-रभोपमोरु, i. e. करभ-उपम-ऊरु, f. रू, and करभोरु, i. e. करभ- f. रू, Having thighs like the proboscis of an elephant, Ragh. 6, 83; Śāk. d. 69. रम्भ-, f. रू, Having bambu-like thighs, Mālav. d. 45. वर-, f. रु, Having beautiful thighs, Rām. 3, 52, 53.  -- Comp. अन्-,  I. adj. thighless.  II. m. Aruṇa, the charioteer of the sun, Skandap., Kāśīkh. 2, 13.
2491: ऊरुज ऊरु-ज, adj. Born from the thigh, MBh. 1, 6820.
2492: ऊर्ज् ऊर्ज्, i. 10, Par. (properly a denomin. derived from the next).  1. To nourish, to strengthen.  2. † To live. उर्जित,  1. Swollen, Rājat. 5, 214.  2. Strong, Hariv. 9920.  3. Distinguished, Ragh. 9, 38.  4. Violent, Rām. 2, 85, 2.  -- Cf. ὀργάω, ὀργάς, perhaps Lat. ur-gere.
2493: ऊर्ज् ऊर्ज्, f. Strength, food, Chr. 295, 17 = Rigv. i. 92, 17; Bhāg. P. 4, 24, 38.
2494: ऊर्ज ऊर्ज् + अ, m. Strength, Man. 2, 55.
2495: ऊर्जस्कर ऊर्जस्कर, i. e. ऊर्ज् + अस्-कृ + अ, adj. Causing strength, MBh. 3, 14181.
2496: ऊर्जस्वल ऊर्जस् + वल, adj., and ऊर्जस्विन् ऊर्जस् + विन्, adj., f. नी, Strong, Ragh. 2, 50.
2497: ऊर्जावन्त् ऊर्ज् + आ + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Abundant with food, MBh. 13, 1842.
2498: ऊर्ण ऊर्ण, i. e. वृ + न, n., and f. णा, Wool, MBh. 2, 1847.  -- Comp. कर्णोर्ण, i. e. कर्ण-, adj. having wool near the ears, Bhāg. P. 4, 6, 21. पत्रोर्ण, i. e. पत्र-, n. 1. Wove silk. 2. A garment of wove silk. -- Cf. Goth. vulla; A.S. wull; Lat. vellus, οὖλος.
2499: ऊर्णमय ऊर्ण + मय, adj., f. यी, Woollen.
2500: ऊर्णु ऊर्णु, ii. 2, Par., Ātm. (pro-perly vb. वृ, ii. 5). To cover; Ātm. To hide one's self, Bhāg. P. 2, 9, 27. -- With the prep. अप अप, To discover, Chr. 294, 4 = Rigv. i. 92, 4. -- With वि वि, To discover, Chr. 295, 11 = Rigv. i. 92, 11.
2502: ऊर्ध्व ऊर्ध्व, i. e. ऋध् + व, adj., f. वा।  1. Erect, Hiḍ. 3, 2.  2. Raised (as dust), Man. 11, 110.  3. Upper, MBh. 1, 1034.  4. The name of a kind of flying, Pañc. ii. d. 57. वम्, adv.  1. Upwards, Rām. 4, 8, 5.  2. Above, Man. 1, 92.  3. After, Rām. 3, 53, 4; after death, Man. 9, 104. -- Cf. ὀρθός; Lat. arduus.
2503: ऊर्ध्वग ऊर्ध्व-ग (vb. गम्), adj., f. गा।  1. Going upwards, MBh. 3, 850.  2. Being in the air.
2504: ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्रक ऊर्ध्व-पुण्ड्र + क, m. A perpendicular line on the forehead made with sandal, etc.; a sectarial mark, Lass. 70, 11.
2505: ऊर्मि ऊर्मि, probably क्वृ + मि, m. and f. A wave, Bhartṛ. 2, 4.  -- Comp. क्षीर-, a wave of the sea of milk, Ragh. 4, 27.
2506: ऊर्मिन् ऊर्मिन्, i. e. ऊर्मि + इन्, adj., f. णी, Wavy (ved.).  -- Comp. महा-, adj. having great waves, MBh. 3, 793.
2507: ऊर्मिमन्त् ऊर्मि + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, adj. Surgy, Rām. 4, 9, 38.
2508: ऊर्व ऊर्व, m. The name of a saint from whose thighs (ऊरु) proceeded the submarine fire, Hariv. 2527 sqq.
2509: † ऊष् ऊष्, ii. 1, Par. To be dis-eased.
2510: ऊष ऊष,  I. m. Saline earth, Man. 5, 120.  II. f. षी, Salt ground, Bhāg. P. 1, 15, 21.
2511: ऊषण ऊषण, i. e. ऊष् (= उष्) + अन, n. Pepper.
2512: ऊषर ऊष + र, adj., f. रा, Im-pregnated with saline particles, MBh. 13, 3341.  2. Salt ground, barren land, Man. 2, 112.
2513: ऊष्मन् ऊष्मन् (= उष्मन्)।  1. Heat, MBh. 14, 468.  2. A name compris-ing the sibilants and ह्, Bhāg. P. 3, 12, 47.
2514: ऊष्मप ऊष्मप, i. e. ऊष्मन्-प (vb. 1. पा).  I. adj. Drinking the steam of food only, MBh. 13, 646.  II. m. pl. The name of a class of Pitṛs or Manes, MBh. 2, 341.
2515: 1. ऊह् ऊह्, i. 1, Ātm., with prepo-sitions also Par. To apprehend, MBh. 1, 5228. -- Caus. To observe, MBh. 2, 1240. -- With the prep. अपि अपि, To understand, Hit. iii. d. 33. -- With अभि अभि, To infer, Kathās. 7, 11
2516: 2. ऊह् ऊह् (derived from वह्, and appearing only after prep.), i. 1, Par. and Ātm. ऊह्यमाना, Rājat. 5, 33, is to be corrected to उह्य्°, pass. of वह्, Being carried. -- With the prep. अप अप।  1. To remove, Man. 8, 414; 11, 102 (Ātm.); अपोहित, Prab. 116, 7. -- 2. To press, to follow immediately, Ragh. 19, 5.  3. To avoid, Man. 10, 86 (Ātm.).  -- With the prep. व्यप वि-अप।  1. To remove, Man. 2, 102.  2. To expiate, Man. 11, 81.  3. To keep off, Rām. 6, 75, 57 (Ātm.). -- With उद् उद्। To raise, Bhāg. P. 4, 8, 15. -- With उप उप, To bring near, Rām. 2, 52, 6. --Pass. To begin, MBh. 2, 2051. उपोढ, Produced, Śāk. d. 169. -- With समुप सम्-उप in समुपोढ,  1. Near, Man. 6, 41.  2. Commenced, Rām. 2, 75, 29.  -- With प्रति प्रति, प्रत्यूढ।  1. De-nied, Rām. 5, 31, 14.  2. Exceeded, Bhāg. P. 4, 22, 38.  3. Interrupted, Man. 5, 84. -- With वि वि, To arrange an army, Man. 7, 191. व्यूढ, Large, Rām. 6, 36, 45. -- With निर्वि निस्-वि, निर्व्यूढ  1. Brought out, MBh. 1, 6257.  2. Achieved, Kathās. 17, 159. --With प्रतिवि प्रति-वि, To arrange an army against, MBh. 3, 16370, प्रत्य्-अव्यूहत्, instead of प्रतिव्य्-औहत्; प्रतिव्यूढ, Large, Rām. 6, 35, 18.
2517: ऊह ऊह् + अ, m. Connected reason-ing, MBh. 13, 6725.  -- Comp. अन्-ऊह, adj. without (long) reflection, quick, Bhāg. P. 3, 5, 48; 18, 12. दुरूह, i. e. दुस्-, adj. difficult to be inferred, Man. 11, 238. v. r.
2518: ऋ ऋ, i. 1, ऋच्छ (in epic poetry also अर्च्छ = ἔρχομαι), ii. 3; 5; 9 Par.  1. To go.  2. To go to.  3. To undergo. With abstracts (cf. इ): Man. 1, 53, ग्लानिम् ऋच्छति, To become inert; MBh. 3, 2166, मृत्युम्, To die; अर्छ्, Nal. 7, 4; MBh. 3, 84; Nalod. 2, 10, युद्धरङ्गताम् आर, To become the field of battle.  4. To rise, ऋ-णु।  5. To meet, Man. 8, 351; to attain, Nalod. 1, 32; to fall on, Man. 8, 18, ऋच्छ।  6. To gain, to acquire.  7. To move, to raise, ved. ii. 3, इयर्मि।  8. To open, ii. 5.  9. To attack, MBh. 4, 1059, ऋच्छ।  10. To hurt; ऋत, and ऋते, see separately. -- Caus. अर्पय,  1. To cast; अर्पित, thrown, Ragh, 8, 87; turned, Bhag. 8, 7.  2. To fasten, Śāk. d. 133.  3. To pierce.  4. To put, Ragh. 9, 74.  5. To deliver, Yājñ. 2, 65; Daśak. in Chr. 183, 24; 201, 11.  6. To restore, Man. 8, 191. -- अर्पित।  1. Cut in, Śāk. d. 74.  2. Written, Ragh. 17, 79.  -- Comp. चित्र-, adj. painted, Śāk. d. 143. -- With the prepos. अभि अभि, To attack, MBh. 3, 11726, ऋच्छ, 11875 अर्च्छ। -- With आ आ।  1. To meet, MBh. 3, 17226.  2. To adapt (ved.). -- With प्र प्र, To rise, Chr. 288, 3 = Rigv. i. 49, 3. -- With प्रति प्रति, Caus.  1. To fasten, Ragh. 6, 28.  2. To deliver, Ragh. 15, 41.  3. To restore, Daśak. in Chr. 195, 15; 189, 15; 192, 16.  -- With वि वि, To open, Chr. 288, 15 = Rigv. i. 48, 15. -- With सम् सम्, Caus.  1. To cast, MBh. 1, 6978.  2. To deliver, Pañc. 36, 13.  3. To restore, Hit. 72, 20. -- समर्पित।  1. Fastened, Kumāras. 6, 63.  2. Put together, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 2.  3. Resting, Rām. 1, 77, 25.  4. Painted, Ragh. 3, 15. -- Cf. ἔρχομαι, ὄρνυμι, ἄρνυμαι, ἄρος, μισθαρνέω, ἰάλλω, ὄλλυμι (Lat. abolere), ἄρω, ἀρτίζω; Lat. orior, adorior, adolesco, adultus; Goth. alds; A.S. ald; O.H.G. arnên.
2519: ऋक्वन् ऋक्वन्, i. e. ऋच् + वन्।  I. adj. Praising.  II. m. A praiser, Chr. 293, 5 = Rigv. i. 87, 5.

Away with, e. g. किं विलम्बेन, Do not tarry, Rām. 3, 35, 35. किं बहुना, In short, Pañc. 5, 3. किम् अनेन, No question, Śāk. 91, 7. -- With instr. and gen. किं ते ज्ञातैर् महाधनुर्ध-रैः, What have you to do with knowing the great archers? Draup. 7, 4. -- Instead of the instr. may be used also the ab-solutive, किं ते सूर्यम् निपात्य, What matters it to you to bring down the sun? MBh. 13, 4628. -- Joined with the demonstr. pron. इदम्, e. g. को यम्, Who there? Hit. 18, 11. -- Doubled, e. g. किंकिं न करोति, What, what does he not? Pañc. i. d. 338. -- It joins two questions in one sentence, e. g. का वाम् कं वरम् इच्छति, Who of you chooses the one and who the other boon? Rām. 1, 39, 12.  II. Indefin. pron.  1. Some, Bhag. 2, 21; generally followed by, a., च, Bhāg. P. 3, 3, 11; preceded by the relat. pron. यद्, Who-ever, whatever, Man. 12, 95.  b. च न, Anybody, Nal. 17, 44 (40); any-thing, Man. 8, 76; some, Bhāg. P. 5, 23, 4; doubled, कांश्चन-कांश्चन, Several, Rām. 2, 96, 34; preceded by the relat. pron. यद्, Whatever, Nal. 4, 2.  c. चिद्, Anybody, Man. 8, 212; any, 8, 232; whoever, Sāh. D. 7, 12 somebody, Nal. 14, 2. कं चित् कालम्, Some time, Rām. 3, 21, 31. कश् चिद् --कश् चिद्, Some one -- another, Rām. 1, 4, 18; preceded by the relat. pron. यद्, अ। Whatever, Man. 2, 7. α. Some trifle, Man. 9, 115.  d. अपि, see अपि।  2. Any, Yajñ. 3, 133.  3. Joined with न, Nobody, Bhartṛ. 3, 99. -- With च न or न -- च न, Nothing, nobody, Nal. 15, 16; Man. 4, 134. मा किं च न, Not at all, Bhāg. P. 1, 13, 39. न हि किं च न, Never, MBh. 1, 6132. -- With न -- चिद्, Nobody, nothing, Nal. 3, 24; not any, Man. 1, 81. -- With न -- अपि, Nobody, Bhartṛ. 3, 99; not the least, Pañc. 157, 6.  III. किम् (acc. sing. ntr.) adv.  1. Why, Nal. 11, 3.  2. A par-ticle of interrog., e. g. साम्यम् इच्छसि किम्, Are you really desirous of re-admission to equality? Man. 11, 195. --With following उ, किम् उ, How much more? Man. 7, 55. -- With following च, Further, Kathās. 2, 1; Pañc. 226, 11; Hit. 4, 18; go on, Śāk. 89, 17. -- With following तु, But, MBh. 1, 1916. -- With following नु,  1. 4767: च च,  I. A copulative particle, And. Where two things are to be joined, it is,  1. Repeated, च -- च (like τε--τε; Lat. que -- que), As well -- As, and, संजीवयति चाजस्रं प्रमापयति चाव्ययः, That immutable power re-vivifies as well as destroys in eternal succession, Man. 1, 57; दश चाष्टौ च, Ten and eight, Man. 1, 64.  2. Dropped in the first place; this is the general use, Hit. i. d. 33.  3. Dropped, but not often, in the second place, e. g. प्रेत्य चेह, In the next world and in this, Man. 3, 20. Where more than two things are to be joined, some have the conjunction, while others are without it, e. g. कर्णौ चर्म च बालांश् च वस्तिं स्नायुं च रोचनाम्, (let him carry) their ears, their hides, their tails, the skin below their navels, their tendons, and the liquor exuding from their foreheads, Man. 8, 234.  II. When followed by वा, Either, Man. 12, 89; when preceded by वा, Or, Nal. 14, 8.  III. Even, Śāk. 6, 5; and even, Hiḍ. i. 26.  IV. Just, Ragh. 12, 45.  V. But, Hit. Pr. d. 12.  VI. If, Bhartṛ. 2, 45. --Cf. τε; Lat. que; Goth. -h, e. g. in sa-h, ‘and he.’

9701: प्रत्युत्थान प्रत्युत्थान, i. e. प्रति -उद्-स्था + अन, n. Rising from a seat as a mark of respect, Pañc. 117, 11.

9727: प्रदायिन् प्रदायिन्, i. e. प्र-दा + इन्, adj. sbst. Giving, a giver, Man. 3, 175.
9728: प्रदिश् प्र-दिश्, f. Intermediate point of the compass, or half-quarter, as north-east, Matsyop. 43.
9729: प्रदीप प्र-दीप् + अ, m.  1. A lamp, Hit. i. d. 167, M.M.  2. Splendour, Śāk. 7, 4.

9731: प्रदीप्ति प्र-दीप् + ति, f. Light, lustre, splendour.

9735: प्रदेशस्थ प्रदेश-स्थ, adj. Situated in a district, Rājat. 5, 39.

9739: प्रद्युम्न प्र-द्युम्न, m. The god of love.
9740: प्रद्योत प्र-द्योत, m.  1. A ray of light.  2. Light.

9751: प्रपलायन प्र-पलायन, n. Flight, Pañc. i. d. 362.
9752: प्रपा प्र-पा, f. A cistern, Man. 8, 319.

9754: प्रपाणि प्र-पाणि, m. The palm of the hand.

9757: प्रपितामह प्र-पितामह,  I. m.  1. A paternal great-grandfather, Bhag. 11, 39.  2. pl. Ancestors, Utt. Rāmac. 15, 5.  3. A name of Brahman.  II. f. ही, A paternal great-grandmother.  -- Comp. वृद्ध-,  I. m. a paternal great-great-grandfather.  II. f. ही, a paternal great-great-grandmother.
9758: प्रपित्सु प्रपित्सु, i. e. प्र-पित्स, de-sider. of पत्, + उ, adj. Being about to descend, to alight, Śiś. 9, 1.
9759: प्रपूरण प्रपूरण, i. e. प्र-पूर् + अन (see पृ), n. The drawing of a bow-string, Rām. 1, 60, 10 Gorr.
9760: प्रपौत्र प्र-पौत्र,  1. and °त्रक त्र + क, m. A great-grandson, Kathās. 9, 7, Yājñ. 1, 78.  2. f. त्री, A great-granddaughter.
9761: प्रबन्ध प्र-बन्ध् + अ, m.  1. Unin-terrupted connexion.  2. Continuous application, Hit. 47, 3, M.M.; action.  3. A connected narrative, composition, Utt. Rāmac. 112, 5.  4. 9762: प्रबल प्र-बल,  I. adj., f. ला।  1. Pre-vailing, Hiḍ. 4, 46; strong, Ṛt. 1, 24; powerful.  2. Violent, Vikr. d. 81.  3. Much, Rājat, 5, 68.  II. m. A sprout.
9763: प्रबाल प्र-बाल, m. and n.  1. Coral, Rām. 3, 49, 4.  2. A sprout, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 18.  3. A new leaf.  4. The bridge of a lute, through which the strings are drawn.
9764: प्रबोध प्रबोध, i. e. प्र-बुध् + अ, m.  1. Waking, Hit. iii. d. 142; vigilance.  2. Awaking either from sleep or igno-rance, Pañc, 37, 20.  3. Knowledge, intellect.  4. Awakening, Rām. 6, 37, 38.
9765: प्रबोधन प्रबोधन, i. e. प्र-बुध्, Caus., + अन, n.  1. Awakening, Pañc. 4, 13; recalling to life, Utt. Rāmac. 460, 10.  2. Instructing, Pañc. 4, 15.

9771: प्रभाकर प्रभा-कर, m.  1. The sun.  2. The moon.  3. Fire.  4. A proper name = Kumārilasvāmin.

9774: प्रभावन्त् प्रभा + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Luminous, splendid, Pañc. i. d. 82.
9775: प्रभु प्र-भु (vb. भू),  I. adj., f. भ्वी and भु।  1. Strong.  2. Able; with gen., Man. 11, 30; with inf., Mālav. d. 9.  3. Eternal, Sund. 1, 19.  II. m.  1. Caus. फालय, To open, MBh. 1, 5977. -- With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, प्रोत्फुल्ल, Blown, as a flower, Ṛt. 6, 34. -- With प्र प्र, प्रफुल्ल,  1. Blown, as a flower, Ṛt. 6, 1.  2. Smiling.  3. Shining.  4. Requited. -- Cf. probably ὄϕελος, ὀϕέλλω; Lat. flos; A.S. blowan; Goth. bloma; A.S. bloma, blostma.

10240: बलदेव बलदेव, m.  1. Air, wind.  2. The elder brother of Kṛṣṇa.
10241: बलभिद् बल-भिद्, m. Indra (the slayer of बल), Bhartṛ. 2, 85.

10245: बलाकिन् बलाकिन्, i. e. बलाक + इन्,  I. adj. Having cranes, Ragh. 11, 15.  II. m. A proper name, Johns. Sel. 42, 58.
10246: बलात्कार बलात्कार, i. e. बल + अत् (abl. of बल), -कार, m. Violence, Śāk. d. 173; Lass. 24, 19.
10247: बलाहक बलाहक, also वला° वला°, m.  1. A cloud, MBh. 1, 1289; Śiś. 4, 54.  2. A mountain.  3. A Nāga.  4. A demon, Draup. 2, 13.

10260: बहुक बहुक, m.  1. A crab.  2. The digger of a tank.

10262: बहुतस् बहु + तस्, adv. From or by much, or many.

10703: भोक्तुकाम भोक्तुकाम, i. e. भोक्-तुम् (vb. 2. भुज्), -काम, adj. Wishing to eat, Hiḍ. 3, 17.

Nourishing, cherish-ing, food, Bhag. 2, 5.  6. Pleasure, Rām. 3, 53, 3.  7. Enjoyment, Bhartṛ. 2, 35; Pañc. ii. d. 131; feasting, Hit. ii. d. 99.  8. Adverse enjoyment (usu-fruct), Man. 8, 149.  9. 10707: भोगकर भोग-कर, adj., f. री, Affording enjoyment, Bhartṛ. 2, 17.

10709: भोगार्ह भोगार्ह, i. e. भोग-अर्ह, n. Wealth.

The capital of the serpents.  2. A royal concubine.  -- Comp. कृष्ण-, m. a sort of black snake, Gīt. 6, 12.
10712: भोज भोज, i. e. भुज् + अ, m.  1. A cowherd.  2. The name of a country.  3. The name of a king, Johns. Sel. 19, 91.
10713: भोजन भोजन, i. e. 2. भुज् + अन, n.  1. Enjoying, Pañc. 61, 22.  2. Eat-ing, Pañc. 245, 22.  3. Food, Pañc. 138, 2.  -- Comp. अ-, n. abstaining from food, Man. 11, 166. अति-, n. excessive eating, Man. 2, 57. एक-, n. 1. eat-ing once a day, MBh. 13, 5161. 2. eating in company, MBh. 13, 6238. कृमि-,  I. adj. one who feeds upon worms, Bhāg. P. 5, 26, 18.  II. m. the name of a hell, Bhāg. P. 5, 26, 7. म्लेच्छ-,  I. m. wheat.  II. n. half-ripe barley. सह-, n. eating with somebody, Lass. 18, 2.
10714: भोजस् भोजस्, i. e. 2. भुज् + अस् in विश्व-, adj. Yielding all the enjoy-ments, Lass. 101, 5 = Rigv. vii. 16, 2.
10715: भोजिन् भोजिन्, i. e. 2. भुज् + इन्, adj. One who eats, Man. 4, 212.  -- Comp. गृह-, m. a house-mate, Rājat. 5, 402. भुजंग-, m. the boa constrictor. शष्प-, adj. sbst. a beast feeding on grass, Pañc. 25, 6.
10716: भोज्यता भोज्य + ता (vb. 2. भुज्), f. Condition of being eaten, Pañc. 193, 21.
10718: भोस् भोस्, an old voc. sing. of भवन्त्।  1. A vocative particle, Man. 2, 124; Ho! there! repeated, भोभोस्, O! Hit. 10, 6, MM.  2. An interro-gative particle, Vikr. 85, 20.  3. Interj. of grief, Oh! Hit. 71, 3, M.M.
10719: भौजङ्ग भौजङ्ग, i. e. भुजंग + अ, adj., f. गी, Like a snake, Pañc. iii. d. 18.

10721: भौतिक भौतिक, i. e. भूत + इक (vb. भू),  I. adj.  1. Relating or apper-taining to spirits, Man. 3, 174.  2. Ele-mental.  3. Existing.  II. m. Śiva.
10722: भौम भौम, i. e. भूमि + अ,  I. adj.  1. Relating to the earth, rising from the ground, Man. 11, 155.  2. Terres-trial.  3. Relating to the planet Mars, Lass. 16, 16.  II. m.  1. III. f. मी, A name of Sītā.  -- Comp. अन्तर्-, adj. being or living in the interior of the earth, Rām. 1, 42, 3. बहु-, adj. having many stories. सप्त(न्)-, adj. having seven stories, Rām. 5, 10, 11 (? cf. my translation of the Pañc. n. 208, and भूमिका).
10723: भौरिक भौरिक, i. e. भूरि + इक, m. The superintendent of gold in a royal treasury (cf. भारिक).
10724: भ्यस् भ्यस्, i. 1, Ātm. To fear, to tremble (cf. भी).

To throw down from (abl.), Ragh. 13, 36 (Calc.). प्रभ्रंशित, Expelled, MBh. 3, 601. -- With वि वि, विभ्रष्ट,  1. Broken off, or from.  2. Fallen.  3. Separated.  4. Deprived, MBh. 3, 3.  5. Lost. 10726: भ्रंश भ्रंश् + अ, m.  1. Falling.  2. Declining from a height, or from pro-priety, ruin, Bhag. 2, 63.  3. Falling off, Megh. 2.  4. 10727: भ्रंशिन् भ्रंश् + इन्, भ्रंसिन् भ्रंस् + इन्, adj., f. नी।  1. Falling, Megh. 30; Śāk. 1. 7.  2. Causing to fall (स्व-अर्-थ-, injuring, or detrimental to, our interest), Pañc. 248, 18.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. not falling, durable, Pañc. iii. d. 18.
10728: भ्रंस् भ्रंस्, भ्रंसिन् भ्रंसिन्, see भ्रंश्, भ्रंशिन्।

10733: † भ्रण् भ्रण्, i. 1, Par. To sound (cf. भ्रम् and रण्).

10735: भ्रम् भ्रम्, i. 1 and 4, भ्राम्य, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 3, 12228), originally, The flying about and humming of insects.  1. To be beside one's self, Daśak. in Chr. 183, 17 (read उद्भ्रम्य). उद्-भ्रान्त,  1. Flying upward, Rām. 6, 83, 26.  2. Whirled on, thrown up, Hit. iii. d. 140.  3. Whirling on, Utt. Rāmac. 138, 4.  4. Bewildered, Pañc. 141, 4. -- With परि परि,  1. To walk round about, Pañc. 230. 16.  2. To roam about, Hit. 76, 6, M.M.; Pañc. 21, 1.  3. To fly round about, Pañc. 148, 10. -- With वि वि, To rove, Nalod. 3, 26.  2. To wander over, MBh. 3, 2648.  3. † To play, to wanton. वि-भ्रान्त,  1. Agitated, Bhag. 16, 16.  2. Hurried.  Comp. अ-, adj. not playing (?), unmoved, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 5. --With मस् सम्, संभ्रान्त, Agitated, confused, Utt. Rāmac. 50, 3; troubled, Śāk. 12, 17.  Comp. अ-, adj. fearless, Utt. Rāmac. 44, 7. सु-संभ्रान्त, adj. greatly bewildered. -- Cf. भ्र-मर; Lat. fremere; O.H.G. breman; A.S. bremman; O.H.G. bremo, briosa; N.G. brausen; πεμϕρηδών, ϕριμάσσομαι, βρέμω, βροντή, βαϐράζω, βαϐραδών, etc.

10741: भ्रष्टाधिकारत्व भ्रष्टाधिकारत्व, i. e. भ्रष्ट-अधिकार्च् + त्व (vb. भ्रंश्), n. Loss of office, Pañc. 22, 11.

10749: भ्रामक भ्रामक, i. e. भ्रम्, Caus. + अक,  I. adj. Causing to whirl.  II. m.  1. A cheat.  2. A jackal.  3. The sun-flower.  4. A sort of loadstone.
10750: भ्रामर भ्रामर, i. e. भ्रमर + अ,  I. m. A sort of loadstone.  II. f. री,  1. Pārvatī,  2. A female attend-ant on Durgā.  III. n.  1. Honey.  2. Whirling round.  3. Epilepsy.  4. A kind of dancing.  5. A village.

10777: मकरन्द मकरन्द,  I. m.  1. The nectar of a flower, Prab. 79, 16.  2. A kind of jasmine.  II. m. The filament of a lotus.
10778: मकुर मकुर, मकुल मकुल, see मुकुर, मुकुल।
10779: मकुष्ठ मकुष्ठ,  I. adj. Going slowly.  II. m. A sort of rice.
10783: मक्ष मक्ष, m.  1. Hypocrisy.  2. Wrath.  3. Multitude.

10785: मक्षु and °क्षू मक्षू̆ (properly loc. pl.), adv. Quickly, Chr. 291, 15 = Rigv. i. 64, 15. -- Cf. Lat. mox.
10786: † मख् मख्, and मङ्ख् मङ्ख्, i. 1, Par. To go.
10787: मख मख, m.  1. A warrior, Chr. 290, 11 = Rigv. i. 64, 11.  2. 10789: मगध मगध,  I. m.  1. The name of a country, Hit. 36, 10, M.M.  2. An inhabitant of that country.  3. A bard.  II. f. धा, Long pepper.
10790: मघ मघ (cf. मह्),  I. n.  1. Power, wealth (ved.).  2. A kind of flower.  II. m.  1. One of the Dvīpas or divisions of the universe.  2. Plea-sure.  III. f. घा (usually pl.), The tenth lunar asterism, Man. 3, 273; Sund. 2, 2.  IV. f. घा or घी, A sort of grain.
10791: मघवन् मघवन्, a curtailed form of the next.  I. adj., f. घोनी, Wealthy, Chr. 287, 2 = Rigv. i. 48, 2.  II. m. Indra, Vikr. 86, 19.
10792: मघवन्त् मघ + वन्त्,  I. adj. Wealthy. m. A sacrificer, Chr. 291, 14 = Rigv. i. 64, 14.  II. m. Indra, Vikr. 88, 21.
10793: मङ्क् मङ्क्, i. 1, Ātm.  1. To go, Bhaṭṭ. 14, 10. †  2. To adorn.
10794: मङ्कुर मङ्कुर, m. A mirror; cf. मुकुर।
10795: मङ्क्तृ मङ्क्तृ, i. e. मज्ज् + त्रि, m., f. त्री, and n.  1. Bathing or drowning.  2. Cleaning by immersion.
10796: मङ्क्षु मङ्क्षु, ind. (= नक्षु),  1. Quickly, instantly.  2. Much, exceed-ingly.
10797: मङ्क्षुण मङ्क्षुण, n. Armour for the thighs or legs.
10799: मङ्ग मङ्ग, m. The head of a boat.
10800: मङ्गल मङ्गल,  I. adj. Lucky, propitious, Man. 2, 34; brave, Pañc. 8, 15.  II. m. and n.  1. Prosperity, welfare, Ṛt. 6, 34; bliss, Utt. Rāmac. 89, 4.  2. Rejoicing, a festival, Pañc. 129, 17; solemnity, Vikr. d. 43 (सन्-ध्या-, Evening service).  3. Blessing, Dāśak. in Chr. 201, 10; Sund. 2, 4; prayer, ib. 188, 22.  III. m.  1. The planet Mars.  2. Burnt offering on various occasions of rejoicing.  IV. f. ला।  1. Umā, the wife of Śiva.  2. A sort of bent grass, Panicum dactylon.  V. n. Turmeric, Vikr. d. 53 (Sch.).  -- Comp. अ-,  I. adj. inauspicious, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 23.  II. n. ill luck, Ku-māras. 5, 65; evil omen, Śāk. 63, 13.  III. m. the castor-oil plant, Ricinus communis. कौतुक-, n. a solemn ceremony, Pañc. 129, 17. पान-, n. a banquet, Kathās. 36, 67. सर्व-, f. ला, Durgā, Hit. 99, 8. सु-, adj. very fortunate or auspicious.
10801: मङ्गल्य मङ्गल्य, i. e. मङ्गल + य,  I. adj., f. या।  1. Auspicious, conferring happiness, Utt. Rāmac. 99, 1.  2. Beautiful.  3. Pious, pure, implying holiness, Man. 2, 31.  II. m.  1. The holy fig-tree, Ficus religiosa.  2. A sort of pulse or lentils.  III. n.  1. Sour curds.  2. Sandal.  3. Red lead.  4. Gold.  5. Water brought from various holy places for the conse-cration of a king.  IV. f. या। The name of several plants, Agallocum, etc.
10802: मङ्गिनी मङ्गिनी, i. e. मङ्ग + इन् + ई, f. A boat.

10804: †मच् मच्, मञ्च् मञ्च्, मुच् मुच्, and मुञ्च् मुञ्च्,  1. To cheat, to be wicked.  2. To boast, to be vain.  3. To pound.
10806: मज्ज् मज्ज् (probably मद्-जन्; cf. मद्गु and Lat. mergere; the Indian grammarians write मस्ज्), i. 6, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 2, 605). The base of many forms is मञ्ज्।  1. To dive, Bhartṛ. 2, 91.  2. To bathe, MBh. 1, 5299.  3. To sink, Vikr. d. 133; to perish in water, Rām. 1, 1, 89.  4. To sink into, MBh. 1, 3717 (loc.); Man. 4, 81 (acc.).  5. To be plunged, Man. 10, 91.  6. To become disheartened, MBh. 1, 5631. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. मग्न,  1. Plunged, Hit. i. d. 4, M.M.; dived, immersed, Rām. 3, 52, 19.  2. Sunk, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 6; drowned, Chr. 17, 27. Caus.  1. To cause to plunge, MBh. 1, 3908.  2. To overwhelm, Rām. 2, 77, 13. -- With the prep. उद् उद्,  1. To emerge, Śāk. d. 167.  2. Pass. impers. To rise, Śiś. 9, 30. Caus. To force up, Man. 8, 115. -- With नि नि,  1. To bathe, Man. 5, 73.  2. To sub-merge, to sink under, Man. 4, 194; Hit. ii. d. 145.  3. To disappear, MBh. 2, 1504.  4. To cause to sink (into hell), MBh. 1, 4156. निमग्न,  1. Plunged in, immersed, Rājat. 5, 85.  2. Sunk in (not prominent), Vikr. d. 80; Rājat. 5, 74; slender, d. 129.  3. Covered, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 6 Caus.  1. To cause to dive under water, Man. 8, 114.  2. To cause to be submerged, MBh. 3, 16612. -- With प्र प्र, प्र-मग्न, Immersed, drowned.
10807: मज्जकृत् मज्जकृत्, i. e. मज्जन्-कृ + त्, n. A bone.
10808: मज्जन् मज्जन् (perhaps for ori-ginal मर्जन्; cf. O.H.G. marag; A.S. mearh, mearg, merg), m.  1. The mar-row of the bones and flesh.  2. The pith or sap of trees.
10809: मज्जा मज्जा (cf. the last), f. The marrow of the bones and flesh. Pañc. i. d. 191, cf. my translation, n. 171.  -- Comp. निर्मज्ज, i. e. निस्-, adj. marrow-less, Hariv. 14533.
10810: मज्जन मज्ज् + अन, n.  1. Immersion.  2. Bathing.  3. Drowning, Pañc. i. d. 34.
10812: मज्मन् मज्मन्, n. Strength, Chr. 290, 3 = Rigv. i. 64, 3. -- Cf. Lat. mag-mentum.
10813: मञ्च् मञ्च्, i. 1, Ātm. †  1. To hold. †  2. To grow high or tall. †  3. To adore. †  4. To shine. Cf. मच् and म्लुञ्च्। -- With the prep. निस् निस्, To purify, Naiṣ. 7, 43. Cf. मृज्।
10814: मञ्च मञ्च, m.  1. A bedstead.  2. A scaffold, Johns. Sel. 9, 12.  3. A chair, Ragh. 6, 1.
10815: मञ्ज् मञ्ज्, see मार्ज् (Lass. 74, 4, read मज्जत्).
10816: मञ्जर मञ्जर, n., and f. री,  1. A pearl.  2. A creeper.
10817: मञ्जरि and मञ्जरी मञ्जरी̆, f.  1. = मञ्जर, Rām. 6, 15, 7 (pearl).  2. A shoot, sprout, Vikr. d. 26, 76 (मञ्-जरी-चामर, A fan-like sprout).  -- Comp. काम-, मदन-, and राग -मञ्जरी, f. proper names. लोभ -मञ्जरी, f. used instead of काममञ्-जरी, Daśak. in Chr. 192, 21 (the pearl of covetousness.)
10818: मञ्जरीपिञ्जरित मञ्जरीपिञ्जरित, i. e. मञ्जरी-पिञ्जर + इत, adj. Adorned with pearls and gold, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 1.
10819: मञ्जा मञ्जा, f., मञ्जि मञ्जि, m., and मञ्जी मञ्जी, f. A creeper.
10820: मञ्जिका मञ्जि + का, f. A harlot.
10821: मञ्जिष्ठा मञ्जिष्ठा, properly su-perl. of मञ्जु, f. Bengal madder, Rubia manjith Roxb.
10822: मञ्जीर मञ्जीर,  I. m. and n. An ornament for the feet.  II. m. A post round which passes the string that works the stick of a churn.
10823: मञ्जु मञ्जु (based on मञ्ज्, a form of मृज्), adj. Beautiful, Vikr. 60, 12.
10824: मञ्जुल मञ्जु + ल,  I. adj. Beau-tiful.  II. m. A gallinule.  III. n.  1. A bower.  2. A watercourse.
10825: मञ्जूषा मञ्जूषा, f.  1. A basket, Kathās. 4, 74.  2. A receptacle, Rām. 1, 67, 4.
10826: † मठ् मठ्, i. 1, Par.  1. To in-habit.  2. To grind.  3. To go.

10828: मठर मठर,  I. adj. Intoxicated.  II. m. The name of a saint.
10829: मडव मडव, or मडवराज्य म-डव-राज्य, n. The name of a district in Kashmir, Rājat. 5, 84; 302: 446.
10830: मड्डु मड्डु, m.  A sort of drum.
10831: मण् मण्, i. 1, Par. To sound, to murmur. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. मणित, Nalod. 2, 60. n. A murmuring sound.
10832: मणि मणि, m. and f., and मणी मणी, f.  1. A precious stone, a jewel, Vikr. d. 40.  2. A pearl, Vikr. d. 51.  3. Fleshy processes hanging from the neck of a goat.  4. 10835: मणिमय मणि-मय, adj., f. यी, Consisting of jewels, Megh. 65.  -- Comp. सित-मणि + मय, adj. made of crystal, Megh. 67.
10836: मणीचक मणीचक, m.  1. The kingfisher.  2. The moon-stone, a fa-bulous stone.
10838: † मण्ठ् मण्ठ्, i. 1, Ātm. To remember with regret.

Comp. अ-, adj. not adorned, Nal. 16, 17.
10840: मण्ड मण्ड् + अ,  I. m.  1. Ornament.  2. The castor-oil tree, Palma christi.  II. m. (and n.).  1. Scum, Utt. Rāmac. 90, 7.  2. Pith.  3. The head, Lass. 4, 18.  III. f. डा।  1. Spirituous liquor.  2. Emblic myrobalan.  -- Comp. दधि-, m. Whey, Bhāg. P. 5, 1, 34.
10841: मण्डक मण्ड + क, m. A kind of pastry, Pañc. 245, 24 (see my transla-tion, n. 1387).

10845: मण्डयन्त मण्डयन्त् + अ (vb. मण्ड्), m. An ornament.

10847: मण्डलय मण्डलय, a de-nomin. derived from the preceeding; with परि परि, in the ptcple. pf. pass. परिमण्डलित, Turned round, Kir. 5. 42.
10848: मण्डलिन् मण्डलिन्, i. e. मण्डल + इन्, m.  1. A snake.  2. A cat.
10849: मण्डूक मण्डूक,  I. m.  1. A frog, Pañc. 197, 21.  2. A flower, Bignonia indica.  II. f. की, A female frog.  -- Comp. कूप-, m. a frog in a well, applied to a person of no enterprise, one who never leaves his home, Hit. 82, 2.
10850: मण्डूर मण्डूर, m. and n. Rust of iron.
10852: मतंग मतंग, i. e. मत (vb. मन्), + म्-ग, m.  1. A cloud.  2. An ele-phant. Hiḍ. 1, 13.  3. A proper name, Utt. Rāmac. 19, 14.

10855: मति मति, i. e. मन् + ति, f.  1. Mind, Pañc. iii. d. 76.  2. Understanding, Pañc. 251, 6; intelligence, Hit. pr. d. 42.  3. Thought, Pañc. iii. d. 258; resolution, Pañc. 216, 14.  4. 10856: मतिमन्त् मति-मन्त्, adj., f. मती, Sensible, intelligent, wise, Pañc. ii. d. 20; Hit. i. d. 127, M.M.
10857: मत्क मत्क,  1. i. e. 2. मद् + क, adj. Mine.  2. m. A bug.

10860: मत्सर मत्सर, probably 2. मअ-सृ + अ,  I. adj.  1. Envious, hostile, Utt. Rāmac. 133, 13.  2. Niggardly.  3. Wicked.  II. m.  1. Envy, Śiś. 9, 63; Man. 3, 231.  2. Jealousy, Mālav. 55, 8.  3. 11000: मरकत मरकत, and मरक्त मरक्-त, n. An emerald, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 15 (°कत); Pañc. 9, 5 (°कत).
11001: मरण मरण, i. e. मृ + अन, n.  1. Dying, Rām. 3, 48, 1.  2. Death, Pañc. 128, 7.  -- Comp. आ-मरण + म्, adv. till death, Hit. i. d. 187, M.M. (आमरण -अन्त, adj. ending only at death). सह-, n. a widow's burning herself with her deceased husband.
11002: मरणज मरण-ज, adj. Produced by death, Pañc. v. d. 24.
11003: मरत मरत, i. e. मृ + अत, m. Death.
11004: मराल मराल,  I. adj. Soft.  II. m.  1. A sort of goose.  2. A duck.  3. A cloud.  4. A grove.  5. Lamp-black used as collyrium.
11005: मरिच and मरीच मरी̆च, n. Pepper.
11006: मरीचि मरीचि (also °ची, f., Rām. 1, 56, 18).  I. m. and f. A ray of light, Vikr. d. 47.  II. m.  1. One of the Prajāpatis, Man. 1, 58; first of the Pitṛs, 3, 194.  2. A proper name, Daśak. in Chr. 179, 7.
11007: मरीचिका मरीचि + का, f. The mirage.
11008: मरीचिप मरीचि-प (vb. 1. पा), m. A kind of genius, Sund. 3, 5.
11009: मरु मरु, i. e. मृ + उ, m.  1. A desert, Hit. i. d. 10, M.M.; Bhāg. P. 6, 8, 36.  2. A mountain.  3. The name of a country. -- Cf. probably A.S. mór.
11010: मरुत् मरुत् (vb. मृ ?),  I. m.  1. pl. The deities of wind, Vikr. d. 36.  2. Wind, Pañc. i. d. 353.  3. Air, Bhāṣāp. 2.  II. n. A sort of perfume.
11012: मरुत्त मरुत्त, m. The name of a fabulous king, MBh. 14, 226; Viṣṇu P. 352.
11013: मरुत्वन्त् मरुत् + वन्त्, m.  1. Indra, Vikr. d. 15.  2. The monkey Hanumant.  3. A cloud.
11014: मरुल मरुल। m. A sort of duck.
11015: मरूक मरूक, m. A sort of deer.
11016: मरोल मरोल, m. A marine monster.
11017: मर्क मर्क (vb. मृ), m.  1. A body,  2. The vital breath which pervades the body.  3. A monkey.  4. An imp Stenzler, in Journ. of the German Oriental Society, vii. 531, 16.
11018: मर्कट मर्क + ट, m.  1. A monkey, Man. 12, 67; Pañc. 118, 12.  2. A spider.  3. A large crane, Ardea argala.  4. A kind of venom.
11019: मर्करा मर्करा, f.  1. A chasm, a hole.  2. A vessel.  3. A barren woman.
11021: मर्जू मर्जू, i. e. मृज् + उ,  I. m.  1. A washerman.  2. A catamite.  II. f. Cleansing, cleanliness.
11022: मर्त मर्त (old ptcple. pf. pass. of मृ), m. A mortal, a man, Chr. 291, 13 = Rigv. i. 64, 13. -- Cf. μορτός, βροτός; Lat. mortuus, mortalis.
11023: मर्त्य मर्त्य, i. e. मर्त + य,  I. m.  1. A mortal, a man, Pañc. ii. d. 89.  2. The earth.  II. f. या, A woman.  III. n. The body, Bhāg. P. 3, 33, 32.  -- Comp. अ-, 1. adj. immortal, Ragh. 7, 50. 2. m. a deity.
11024: मर्द मर्द, i. e. मृद् + अ, m. Grind-ing, pounding, MBh. 1, 1121.
11025: मर्दन मर्दन, i. e. मृद् + अन, n.  1. Rubbing, Pañc. 238, 7.  2. Touch-ing, Śṛṅgārat. 14.  3. Grinding, Hit. iii. d. 76.  -- Comp. अरि-, m. 1. a de-stroyer of enemies, Draup. 6, 14. 2. a proper name, Hariv. 1917. सर्व-क्ष-त्रिय-, m. the destroyer of all the mili-tary class, Johns. Sel. 3, 16.
11026: मर्दल मर्दल, m. A sort of drum.
11027: मर्दिन् मर्दिन्, i. e. मृद् + इन्, adj., f. नी, Grinding; in महिष-मर्दिनि, f. Durgā. लोष्ट-, adj. Who or what breaks clods of earth, Man. 4, 71.
11029: मर्मज्ञ मर्मज्ञ, i. e. मर्मन्-ज्ञ,  I. adj. One who knows another's weak points, Pañc. i. d. 278.  II. m. A learned and intelligent man, Hit. 92, 5.
11030: मर्मन् मर्मन्, i. e. मृ + मन्, n.  1. A vital member or organ, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1586.  2. A joint of a limb, Hit. iv. d. 32.  3. A weak point, Hit. iii. d. 9.  4. A secret, Pañc. iii. d. 200.  5. Design, Hit. iii. d. 19.  6. Truth.  -- Comp. अन्तर्-, n. the heart, Utt. Rāmac. 128, 5. शिरोम्°, i. e. शिरस्-, m. a hog. -- Cf. Lat. membrum.
11031: मर्ममय मर्ममय, i. e. मर्मन् + मय, adj., f. यी, Containing (their) secrets, Pañc. 184, 22.
11032: मर्मर मर्मर (a reduplicated form based on an imitative sound), m. The rustling sound of cloth, or dry leaves, Ragh. 6, 57 (at the end of a comp. adj.); of the wind, Rājat. 2, 165 (roaring). -- Cf. Lat. murmurare; O.H.G. murmuron; μόρμορος, μορμύρω, etc.
11033: मर्मरीक मर्मरीक, m. A low, a wicked man.
11034: मर्मविद् मर्मविद्, and मर्मवेदिन् मर्मवेदिन्, i. e. मर्मन्-विद्, or -वेदिन्, m. A learned and intelligent man.
11035: मर्मस्पृश् मर्मस्पृश्, i. e. मर्मन् -स्पृश्, adj. Giving pain.
11036: मर्य मर्य, i. e. मृ + य,  I. m. (ved.), A man, a warrior, Chr. 290, 2 = Rigv. i. 61, 2; a husband.  II. f. या, A boundary.  -- With  I. cf. perhaps Lat. maritus.
11037: मर्यादा मर्यादा, i. e. मर्या-द (vb. दा), f.  1. A landmark, Mān. 9, 201.  2. A boundary, limit, Pañc. i. d. 65.  3. Continuance in the right way, rectitude.  -- Comp. अ-मर्याद, adj. not keeping within the right way, Pañc. i. d. 158; unrestrained, unruly. अग्नि-साक्षिक-, adj. one who is married in presence of the sacred fire, Hit. i. d. 191. अन्-अप-ईक्षित-, adj. regardless of the limits (drawn by the holy scrip-tures), Man. 8, 309. दुर्म्°, i. e. दुस् -मर्याद, adj. wicked, Utt. Rāmac. 113, 4. निर्म्°, i. e. निस्-,  I adj. 1. boundless. 2. unruly. 3. sinful, im-pious, Pañc. 152, 7. 4. confused, Rām. 3, 69, 19.  II. n. confusion, MBh. 4, 1052; a sort of battle, Hariv. 15978. भिन्न- (vb. भिद्), adj. unbounded, un-restrained, Utt. Rāmac. 137, 3. स-, adj. 1. bounded. 2. near. 3. correct in conduct.
11038: मर्यादिन् मर्यादिन्, i. e. मर्यादा + इन्, adj. not trespassing one's boundary, Lass. 1, 12.
11039: † मर्व् मर्व्, i. 1, Par. To fill; cf. मार्ज्।
11040: मर्ष मर्ष, i. e. मृष् + अ, m. En-durance.  -- Comp. अ-, m. 1. im-patience, inability to endure, Utt. Rāmac. 134, 1; indignation, Johns. Sel. 5, 27. 2. passion, wrath, Rām. 6, 100, 3. निस्-अ-, adj. devoid of energy, MBh. 5, 2896. सामर्ष, i. e. स-अ-, adj. full of passion, wrathful, Rām. 6, 91, 6. °षम्, adv. angrily, Mṛcch. 19, 17.
11041: मर्षण मर्षण, i. e. म्रिष् + अन, n. Enduring.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. impatient, unable to endure, Nal. 12, 54; wrath-ful, Hiḍ. 4, 54 (अति-अ-)। अघ-, n. the name of a holy text, Man. 11, 260. दुर्म्°, i. e. दुस्-,  I. adj. difficult to be endured, or to be managed, Rām. 6, 3, 33.  II. m. a proper name.
11042: † मल् मल्, मल्ल् मल्ल्, i. 1, Ātm., and भल मल्, 1. 10, मलय, or मलापय, Par. To hold.
11043: मल मल,  I. adj.  1. Dirty.  2. Niggardly.  II. (m. and) n.  1. Dirt, filth, Dāśak. in Chr. 184, 9.  2. Sedi-ment, dregs.  3. Filthy refuse, Man. 11, 93.  4. Excretion of the body, as fæces, etc., Man. 5, 132.  5. Sin, Man. 2, 102.  6. Defilement, Man. 11, 70.  7. Rust.  8. Camphor.  9. Cuttle fish-bone.  -- Comp. अ-, adj., f. ला, pure, Pañc. ii. d. 182; white, Vikr. d. 157. कांस्य-, n. verdigris, Suśr. 2, 237, 18. निर्म्°, i. e. निस्-, adj., f. ला। 1. stainless, Hit. i. d. 47, M.M. 2. pure, Hit. ii. d. 134; clear, Pañc. 248, 5. 3. bright, Johns. Sel. 12, 33. बहु-, m. lead. वि-,  I. adj. 1. clean, spotless, Chr. 40, 12. 2. pure, Pañc. v. d. 36; Śiś. 9, 13. 3. clear, Pañc. iii. d. 147 = day, Chr. 37, 31. 4. transparent. 5. white. 6. beautiful.  II, n. silvergilt. शान्त-, adj. exempt from soil, literally and figuratively. स-,  I. adj. 1. dirty. 2. sinful.  II. n. fæces, ordure. -- Cf. μέλας (cf. मलिन), μόρον, μάρμαρος, μαρμαάιρω; A.S. smere, smerian, smer-wian, smyrian.
11044: मलपङ्किन् मलपङ्किन्, i. e. मल -पङ्क + इन्, adj. Covered with mud and dirt, Chr. 46, 20.
11045: मलमल्लक मल-मल्ल + क, n. A piece of cloth worn over the privities, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 24.
11046: मलय मलय, m.  1. A mountainous range in the Dekhan, Lass. 38, 17; Vikr. d. 25.  2. The country lying along this range, Malabar.  3. A garden.  4. The garden of Indra.
11047: मलयज मलय-ज, m. and n. Sandal-wood. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3322; Vikr. d. 51.
11048: मलाका मलाका, i. e. मल + आक, f.  1. A lewd woman.  2. A female messenger.  3. A female elephant.
11049: मलिन मलिन, i. e. मल + इन् + अ,  I. adj.  1. Dirty, Pañc. iii. d. 178; soiled, Hit. ii. d. 39.  2. Black, Śiś. 9, 18; obscure, ib. 23; obscured, Hit. i. d. 27, M.M.  3. Sinful.  4. Bad.  II. n.  1. Fault.  2. Buttermilk.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. pure, Bhartṛ. 3, 100.
11050: मलिनत्व मलिन + त्व, n. Blackness, Cāṇ. 76 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 412.
11051: मलिम्लुच मलिम्लुच् + अ (from an anomal. frequent. of म्लुछ्), m.  1. A thief.  2. The intercalary lunar month.  3. Fire.  4. Wind.  5. An imp.
11052: मलीमस मलीमस (cf. मल), adj.  1. Dirty, Hit. ii. d. 148; stained, Ragh. 2, 33.  2. Wicked.
11054: मल्ल मल्ल,  I. adj.  1. Strong.  2. Excellent.  II. m.  1. A wrestler; the son of an outcaste Kṣatriya, Man. 10, 22; 12, 45.  2. A cup.  3. The hemi-cranium.  4. The residue of an ob-lation.  III. f. ला।  1. A woman.  2. Arabian jasmine.  -- Comp. हस्तिमल्ल, i. e. हस्तिन्-, m. 1. the elephant of Indra. 2. गणेश। 3. a chief of the Nāgas, or serpents.
11055: मल्लक मल्ल + क,  I. m.  1. A tooth.  2. A leaf to wrap up something, or a cup, Mṛcch. 126, 9 v. r.; cf. Wilson, Hind. Th. i. 2 ed. 134, n., and Stenzler, n.  II. m., and f. लिका, An oil vessel.
11056: मल्लघटी मल्लघटी, f. A kind of dancing, Vikr. 62, 19.
11057: मल्लि and मल्ली मल्ली̆, f. Arabian jasmine, Jasminum zambac, Lass. 67, 7 (ली).  -- Comp. मधु-मल्ली, f. double jasmine. रङ्ग-मल्ली, f. a lute.
11058: मल्लिक मल्लिक,  I. m.  1.  A sort of goose with brown legs and bill, Utt. Rāmac. 20, 4 (rather मल्लिकाख्य)  2. A shuttle.  3. The month Māgha.  II. f. का (i. e. मल्लि + क).  1. Arabian jasmine, Ṛt. 6, 6.  2. A goblet.  3. A river.  4. See मल्लक।
11059: † मव् मव्, and मव्य् मव्य्, i. 1, Par. To bind, see मू।
11060: † मश् मश्, मिश् मिश्, i. 1, Par.  1. To sound.  2. To be angry.
11061: मशक मशक (akin to मक्षिका, q. cf.), m.  1. A gnat, a musquito, Hit. i. d. 80, M.M.; Pañc. iii. d. 98.  2. A kind of cutaneous eruption.  3. A leather water-bag.  -- Comp. दंश-, m. a biting gnat, Man. 1, 40.
11062: मशहरी मशहरी (मश [= मश-क]-हृ + अ + ई), f. Curtains to keep off musquitoes.
11063: मशुन मशुन (perhaps a form of महा-श्वन् + अ), m. A dog.
11064: † मष् मष् (and मुष् मुष्), i. 1, Par. To kill, to hurt.
11065: मषि m., and मषी f. मषी̆, and मसि m., मसी f. मसि,  1. Ink, Kathās. 4, 69 (षी); also in Pehlewi मसि, Haug, in Journ. of the German Oriental Society, xix. 305; if it was originally the juice of the cuttle-fish, which the Romans also used for writing, it may be akin to Zend. मश्यो = Sskr. मत्स्ÿअ।  2. The stalk of the Nyctanthes tristis.
11067: मस् मस् (cf. मा), i. 4, Par. To mete, to measure. Ptcple. pf. pass. मस्त। -- Cf. perhaps μεστός.
11068: मसार मसार, m. A sapphire, Rām. 3, 48, 12 (? cf. Böhtl. s. v. गल्-वर्क).
11071: मसुर and मसूर मसू̆र,  1. m., and f. रा, A sort of lentil, Ervum hirsutum, Suśr. 1, 24, 9; 26, 1 (?).  2. f. रा, A harlot.
11072: मसूरिका मसूरिका, i. e. मसूर + क, f. A procuress.
11073: मसृण मसृण,  I. adj.  1. Soft, Utt. Rāmac. 24, 14.  2. Unctuous, shining, ib. 107, 6.  II. f. णा, Lin-seed.
11074: मसृणित मसृणित, i. e. मसृण + इत, adj. Polished. Utt. Rāmac. 129, 1.
11075: † मस्क् मस्क्, मष्क् मष्क्, and मक्क् मक्क्, i. 1, Ātm. To go.
11077: मस्करिन् मस्करिन्, i.e. मस्कर + इन्, m.  1. A religious mendicant, Lass. 76, 15.  2. The moon.
11078: मस्त मस्त (perhaps vb. मन्), n. The head, Lass. 70, 2 (at the end of a comp. adj.); cf. मस्।
11079: मस्तक मस्त + क, m. n.  1. The head, Pañc. 246, 14.  2. The top, the summit, Man. 4, 47; Pañc. 262, 17.  -- Comp. मधु-, n. a sweetmeat made of flour, honey, oil, and butter (cf. मस्तु),
11080: मस्तिष्क मस्तिष्क (akin to मस्त), n. The brain, Lass. 4, 17; Hariv. 4740.
11082: मस्तुलुङ्ग and मस्तुलुङ्गक मस्तु-लुङ्ग and °ग + क, m. The brain.
11083: मह् मह्, i. 1, and i. 10, Par. To adore, to honour Pañc. ii. d. 72; Kir. 5, 24. The original form was मघ् and the original signification ‘To be great, powerful.’ -- Cf. मघ, महन्त्, and Goth. and A.S. magan; Goth. magu, mavi, mahts; A.S. mact, meaht, miht; Goth. mahteig; O.H.G. magan, great, heavy; A.S. maegn, meagn, strength; Goth. magus, a boy; A.S. mag, maeg, maegen, macian; Goth. magaths; A.S. maegdh; O.H.G. macôn; A.S. macian; μόγος, μόχθος, μόγις (for μόγλοις) μέγαρον (cf. O.H.G. ga-mah; N.G. Gemach), μηχανή, μηχανάομαι; Lat. magnus, mactus.
11084: मह मह् + अ,  I. adj. f. ही, Great, Chr. 288, 14 = Rigv. i. 88, 14.  II. m.  1. Light.  2. A festival.  3. A sacri-fice.  4. A buffalo.  III. f. हा, A cow.  IV. f. ही।  1. The earth, Utt. Rāmac. 172, 13 (as deity); Daśak. in Chr. 179, 6; landed property, Pañc. i. d. 322.  2. A cow.  3. Name of a river.  -- Comp. धनुर्मह, i. e. धनुस्-, m. a festival at the consecration of a bow, Hariv. 4391. -- Cf. मईअ, मैअ꣡च्।
11085: महत्त्व महत्त्व, i. e. महन्त् + त्व, n. Greatness, Pañc. iii. d. 254; finite magnitude (as found in the त्रसरेणु), Bhāṣāp. 57.
11086: महन्त् महन्त् (properly ptcple. pres. of मह्); the bases of all cases, except the sing. voc. msc., are महान्त् and महत्; ved. महाम् instead of म-हान्तम्, Chr. 297, 14 = Rigv. i. 112, 14.  I. adj.  1. Great, large, Vikr. 11, 18.  2. Pre-eminent, Hit. pr. d. 28, M.M.  3. Much, many.  4. Excellent, Nal. 2, 25.  II. adv. हत्, Exceedingly, much, Utt. Rāmac. 42, 2.  III. m. The intel-lectual principle, Sāṅkhyak. 3, 22; Man. 12, 14.  IV. n.  1. Greatness, infinity, Bhāṣāp. 25.  2. Kingdom.  V. f. अती, The lute of Nārada.  -- Comp. वि-, adj. exceedingly tall, Indr. 1, 33. सु-, adj. 1. very great, Chr. 12, 26; very tall, Rām. 3, 55, 1. 2. very important, Nal. 8, 2. 3. abundant. -- Cf. μέγας, μεγάλου, etc., μείζων, μέγεθος, μεγαίρω, μάλα, μᾶλλον, μῆκος, μακρός, μάκαρες; Lat. magis, major, majus, maximus, magister, Majus; Goth. mikils; A.S. meagol, micel, micyl, etc.; comparat. Goth. mais; A.S. ma, mae; superl. Goth. maist; A.S. maest, maegeste.
11087: महर् महर्, and महर्लोक महर् -लोक (महर् for महन्, akin to म-हन्त्, or anomal. for महस्), m. The abode of the saints who survive a destruction of the world; it is said to be situated above the polar star, Weber, Ind. St. ii. 178; cf. 213; Vedāntas. in Chr. 269, 1 (महर्).
11088: महर्द्धि महर्द्धि, i. e. महा-ऋद्धि, adj. Very perfect, Rājat. 5, 33.
11089: महर्षि महर्षि, i. e. महा-ऋषि, m. A sage of a pre-eminent class, Man. 1, 34.
11090: महस् मह् + अस्, n.  1. Light, lustre, Utt. Rāmac. 15, 5; Lass. 97, 6 = Rigv. vi. 64, 2.  2. A festival.  3. A sacrifice.  -- Comp. पीयूष-, m. the moon. मित्र-, adj. having a friendly light or lustre, Chr. 289, 11 = Rigv. i. 50, 11. वि-, adj. very resplendent, Chr. 292, 1 = Rigv. i. 86, 1.
11092: महाऽ महा-, a substitute for म-हन्त्, when former part of compounds of the Bahuvrīhi and Karmadhāraya classes; e. g. महा-राज, m. A great king, Chr. 3, 4. महा-दुर्ग, adj. Very difficult to be crossed, Pañc. 123, 17. महा-तपस्, adj. Practising great austerities, Chr. 9, 39.
11093: महात्यागमय महा-त्याग + मय, adj., f. यी, Consisting in great liberality, Kathās. 23, 84.
11094: महानस महानस, n. A kitchen, Pañc. 253, 14.
11096: महाराजिक महाराजिक, i. e. महा -राज + इक, m. A kind of demigod.
11097: महावस महा-वस (vb. वस्), m. The Gangetic porpoise.
11098: महासाहसिकता महा-साहसिक + ता, f. Great boldness, Pañc. 129, 22.
11099: महि मह् + इ, ved. adj. Great.
11101: महित्वन महि + त्वन, ved. n. Greatness, Chr. 291, 7 = Rigv. i. 85, 7.
11102: महिमन् महिमन्, i. e. महन्त् + इमन्, m. Greatness, Hit. ii. d. 2; majesty, Vikr. d. 5; exaltation, Utt. Rāmac. 42, 2.  -- Comp. अ-कृत-त्याग-, adj. not having practised the greatness (i. e. great virtue) of liberality, Pañc. ii. d. 72. अ-मोघ-, adj. possessing a great-ness which is not devoid of effect.
11103: महिला महिला, f.  1. A woman, Hit. iv. d. 54.  2. A plant = प्रियङ्गु।
11104: महिष मह् + इष (cf. मह),  I. m.  1. A buffalo, Hit. i. d. 86, M.M.  2. The emblem and vehicle of Yama.  II. f. षी।  1. The female buffalo, Pañc. ii. d. 53; 252, 15.  2. A queen, Utt. Rāmac. 159, 9; Pañc. 27, 6.  -- Comp. अग्र-, f. the first of a king's wives, Rām. 5, 22, 16.
11106: महीक्षित् मही-क्षि + त्, m. A king, Chr. 3, 23.
