11182: माध्य माध्य, i. e. मध्य + अ, adj., f. या, and माध्यम माध्यम, i. e. मध्यम + अ, adj., f. मी, Middle.
11183: माध्यस्थ माध्यस्थ, i. e. मध्य-स्थ + अ, n.  1. Middle state.  2. Indif-ference to earthly objects, Man. 4, 257.
11184: माध्यस्थ्य माध्यस्थ्य, i. e. मध्य-स्थ + य, n.  1. Mediation.  2. Office of an arbiter, Lass 92, 4.
11185: माध्वक माध्वक, i. e. मधु + अ + क (anomal.), n. Spirit distilled from the flowers of the Bassia.
11186: माध्वी माध्वी, i. e. मधु + अ + ई (anomal.), f.  1. Spirituous liquor dis-tilled from the flowers of the Bassia, Man. 11, 94.  2. A sort of fish.
11187: माध्वीक माध्वी + क, n.  1. Spi-rituous liquor made from the Bassia.  2. Wine.
11188: मान् मान्, i. 10 (properly Caus. of मन्, q. cf.), and † i. 1, Par. To honour.
11189: मान मान,  I. m., i. e. मान् + अ।  1. Self-confidence, Pañc. v. d. 3.  2. Pride, Pañc. iii. d. 13.  3. Arrogance, Pañc. iii. d. 108; female caprice, indignation, anger, Vikr. 37, 8.  4. Honour, Pañc. 16, 4; i. d. 251.  5. Taking.  6. An agent.  7. A block-head.  8. A barbarian.  II. i. e. मा + अन, n.  1. Measuring, Bhāṣāp. 108.  2. Measure in general, Pañc. 7, 16 ( कूट-तुला-, With a wrong balance).  3. A particular measure, the fourth part of a खारी।  4. The computation of the duration of a year.  -- Comp. अति-, m. arrogance, Cāṇ. 50. अ-भग्न-मान + म्, adv. without injury to one's honour, Hit. ii. d. 41. निर्म्°, i. e. निस्-, adj. free from pride, Bhartṛ. 3, 95. प्रणय-, m. lover's quarrels. बहु-, m. reverence, respect, Vikr. d. 2. मास-, m. a year. स-बहु-मान + म्, adv. with great reverence, Pañc. 130, 16.
11190: मानद मान-द (vb. दा), adj.  1. Inspiring pride; a respectful address, used only in the voc. sing. m., Chr. 38, 15; Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 830.
11192: मानयितृ मानयितृ, i. e. मन्, Caus., + तृ, m. One who honours, Indr. 4, 9.
11193: मानव मानव, i. e. मनु + अ,  I. adj.  1. Human, Utt. Rāmac. 53, 1.  2. Declared by Manu, Chr. 135, 1. 2.  II. m.  1. A man, Pañc. iii. d. 61; man-kind, Chr. 8, 33.  2. A boy.  III. f. वी।  1. A woman.  2. A daughter of the first Manu.  -- Comp. कपट-, m. under the disguise of a man, Bhāg. P. 1, 1, 20. दण्ड-, m. a man bearing a staff, a Brāhmaṇa, Rām. 2, 32, 18.
11194: मानवन्त् मान + वन्त्, adj., f. वती।  1. Proud.  2. Angry, Śiś. 9, 84.
11195: मानव्य मानव्य, i. e. मानव + य, n. A multitude of boys (and of men).
11196: मानस मानस, i. e. मनस् + अ,  I. adj., f. सी, Mental, Man. 2, 85; Vikr. d. 30.  II. n.  1. The mind, the seat of reasoning and feeling, Pañc. v. 12; Bhāṣāp. 33; Hit. i. d. 140, M.M.; Pañc. iii. d. 45 ( भय-संत्रस्त-, adj. Having one's mind terrified by fear); iii. d. 180 ( शोक-संतप्त-, burned by grief).  2. The name of a lake, Vikr. d. 93.  III. f. सी, A goddess of the Jainas.  -- Comp. अन्य-, adj., f. सा, being in love with another, Chr. 14, 22. अन्-अन्य-, adj. intent only on one object, Indr. 5, 4. पूर्ण- (see vb. पॄ), adj. satisfied, Rām. 3, 75, 25. हृष्ट-(vb. हृष्). adj. glad, happy, Johns. Sel. 14, 48.
11197: ऽमानिक -मानिक, i. e. मानिन् + क, in पन्डित-, adj. Fancying one's self a learned man, MBh. 12, 6738.
11198: मानिन् मानिन्, i. e. मान + इन्, and मन् + इन्,  I. adj., f. नी।  1. Proud, Ragh. 13, 38.  2. When latter part of a comp., Who thinks or fancies (cf. comp.).  II. f. नी।  1. A woman, especially one in-dignant towards her lover, Vikr. d. 118.  2. A plant, commonly प्रियङ्गु।  -- Comp. अ-, adj. not proud. अति-, adj. very proud, Rām. 3, 34, 17. अ-स्तेन-, adj. pretending to have committed no theft, Man. 8, 197. धृष्ट-, adj. arrogant, Rām. 2, 96, 43. पण्डित-, adj. fancying one's self a learned man, MBh. 4, 113. पुरुष-, adj. fancying one's self a hero, MBh. 5, 6094. प्राज्ञ-, adj. fancying one's self a learned man. शूर-, adj. one who thinks himself a hero, a boaster, Hit. iv. d. 2. सु-भग-, adj. fancying one's self fortunate, Daśak. in Chr. 195. 12.
11199: मानुष मानुष, i. e. मनुस् (q. cf.), + अ,  I. adj., f. षी।  1. Human, Rām. 3, 53, 3; 54, 17.  2. Relating to man-kind, Man. 4, 124.  II. m. A man, Pañc. 61, 10.  III. f. षी, A woman, Nal. 13, 55.  IV. n. Human effort, Chr. 56, 16 (दैवं मानुषोपेतम्, Fate combined with human effort).  -- Comp. अ-,  I. adj., f. षी। 1. not human. 2. inhuman.  II. m. not a man, any other than a man, Man. 9, 284. अति-, adj. superhuman, Chr. 46, 19. दिव्य-, m. a demigod, Kathās. 1, 47 (एकान्तसुखिनो देवा मनुष्या नित्यदुःखिनः; दि-व्यमानुषचेष्टा तु परभागेन हारिणी। विद्याधराणां चरितम् अतस् ते वर्णयाम्य् अहम्; The gods are ever happy, men ever unhappy; [but] the doing of the demigods is charming in the highest degree. Therefore, I shall tell you the adventures of Vidyā-dharas).
11200: मानुष्य मानुष्य, i. e. मानुष + य,  I. adj. Human, Nal. 19, 28.  II. n. The state of a man.
11201: मानुष्यक मानुष्य + क, n. A mul-titude of men.
11202: मान्त्रिक मान्त्रिक, i. e. मन्त्र + इक, m. A sorcerer, Rājat. 5, 102.
11203: † मान्थ् मान्थ् (?), i. 1, Par. To hurt (see मथ्).
11204: मान्द्य मान्द्य, i. e. मन्द + य, n.  1. Indisposition, sickness.  2. Stupidity, torpor, Vedāntas. in Chr. 218, 17.  3. Slowness, languishing (and stupidity), Pañc. i. d. 205.  -- Comp. अ-, n. activity.
11205: मान्धातृ मान्धातृ, m. A proper name, Pañc. iii. d. 270.
11206: मान्मथ मान्मथ। i. e. मन्मथ + अ, adj. Caused by love, Prab. 41, 4.
11207: मापत्य मापत्य (probably from the Caus. of मे), m. The god of love.
11208: मापन मापन, i. e. मा, Caus., + अन, n. A balance.
11209: माम माम, i. e. मम, gen. sing. of अस्मद्, + अ, adj. Mine, Pañc. 98, 13; dear, 50, 12; 16; 51, 13; 23; 52, 4, etc.
11210: मामक मामक, i. e. मम, gen. sing. of अस्मद्, + क,  I. adj., f. की and मिका, Mine, Bhag. 1, 1.  II. m.  1. A mother's brother.  2. A niggard.
11211: मामकीन मामकीन, i. e. मामक + ईन, adj. Mine.
11212: माय माय, i. e. मन् + य,  I. m.  1. A juggler.  2. An Asura.  II. f.  1. Understanding.  2. Fraud, deceit, Man. 7, 104; Hit. i. d. 194, M.M.  3. Trick in negotiation, diplomacy, Pañc. i. d. 404 (यो मायां कुरुते मूधः प्राण-त्यागे धनादिषु, The fool who uses tricks about wealth, etc., his life being in danger).  4. Wickedness.  5. Illu-sion, unreality, Vedāntas. in Chr. 205, 2.  6. Magical power, Kathās. 25, 274.  7. Compassion.  8. The wife of a juggler.  -- Comp. अ-, f. honesty, truth, Hit. ii. d. 33. देव-, f. a phantom created by a god, Bhāg. P. 2, 7, 42. बहु-, adj. Very wicked, Pañc. i. d. 364. सु-, adj. abounding in tricks (?), Chr. 293, 1 = Rigv. i. 88, 1.
11213: मायाद माया-द (vb. दा), m. A crocodile.
11214: मायाधर माया-धर, adj. Deceit-ful, disguised, Rām. 3, 49, 17.
11215: मायामय माया + मय, adj., f. यी,  1. Illusive, Rām. 3, 49, 31.  2. Magical, Indr. 1, 7; Rām. 3, 55, 31.
11216: मायावन्त् माया + वन्त्,  I. adj., f. वती, Deceitful, illusory, unreal.  II. m. A name of Kansa.  III. f. वती, The wife of Kāma.
11217: मायायिन् मायायिन्, and मायाविन् मायाविन्, i. e. माया + विन्,  I. adj.  1. De-ceitful, using tricks, Rām. 3, 49, 47 (विन्).  2. Illusory, unreal.  II. m.  1. A juggler.  2. A cat.
11218: मायिक मायिक, i. e. माया + इक, m. A juggler.
11219: मायिन् मायिन्, i. e. माया + इन्,  I. adj.  1. Wise, Chr. 290, 7 = Rigv. i. 64, 7.  2. Deceptive.  II. m.  1. A juggler.  2. A cheat.  3. Agni, Viṣṇu, Brah-man.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. void of deceit. दुर्म्°, i. e. दुस्-, adj. using tricks, Bhāg. P. 8, 11, 6.
11220: मायु मायु,  I. m. Bile.  II. i. e. 2. मा + उ, Sounding, crying, at the end of comp. words; ved. गोमायु see s. v.
11221: मायूर मायूर, i. e. मयूर + अ,  I. adj., f. री।  1. Belonging to, or coming from, peacocks, Rām. 2, 100, 63 Gorr.; agreeable to peacocks, Mālav. d. 20.  2. Made of its feathers.  II. n. A flock of peacocks.
11222: मार मार, i. e. मृ + अ,  I. m.  1. Dying.  2. Death.  3. Killing, Hit. 18, 3, M.M.  4. Obstruction.  5. The god of love.  II. f. री।  1. Plague.  2. A name of Caṇḍī or Durgā.  -- Comp. अ-, m. not dying, Rājat. 5, 64. धुन्धु-, m. a proper name and surname, Rām. 1, 72, 21 Gorr; MBh. 3, 13486. पशु-, m. the manner of killing a beast, MBh. 3, 370. महा-मारी, f. a name of Durgā, Dev. 12, 7. शिशु-, m. 1. the Gangetic porpoise, Pañc. 51, 9. 2. the heavenly porpoise, or collection of the stars and planets; north-west, Johns. Sel. 40, 36. 3. a name of Viṣṇu.
11223: मारक मारक, i. e. मृ, Caus., + अक, m.  1. A slayer.  2. A hawk.  3. Plague.  -- Comp. पशु-मार + क, adj. accom-panied by sacrificing beasts, Bhāg. P. 4, 27, 11.
11224: मारकत मारकत, i. e. मरकत + अ, adj., f. ती, Emerald-like, Hit. pr. d. 41, M.M.
11225: मारण मारण, i. e. मृ, Caus. + अन, n.  1. Killing.  2. Being killed, Man. 5, 38.
11226: मारि मारि (vb. मृ), f.  1. Killing.  2. Plague.
11227: ऽमारिन् -मारिन्, i. e. मृ + इन् in पूर्व-, adj., f. इनी, Dying before, Man. 5, 167.
11228: मारिष मारिष (for मार्ष, q. cf.),  I. m. A venerable person (in dramatic language), Vikr. 3, 6.  II. f. षा, The mother of Dakṣa, Lass. 59, 15.
11229: मारीच मारीच, i. e. मरीचि + अ, m. The name of a Muni, Śāk. 100, 8; of a Rākṣasa, Rām. 3, 48, 2.  -- Comp. सह-, adj. With Mārīca, Rām. 3, 48, 8.
11230: मारुत मारुत, i. e. मरुत् + अ,  I. adj.  1. Belonging to the Maruts, Chr. 293, 6 = Rigv. i. 87, 6.  2. Consisting of the Maruts, Chr. 291, 12 = Rigv. i. 64, 12.  II. m.  1. A Marut.  2. Wind Pañc. iii. d. 56.  3. Vital air, Lass. 17, 6 ( ऊर्ध्व-, m. Pressing upwards).  III. n. Burnt offering on conception.  -- Comp. अति-, m. strong wind, Yājñ. 1, 149. पश्चान्मारुत, i. e. पश्चात्-, m. wind blowing from behind, Ragh. 7, 51. पुरोमारुत, i. e. पुरस्-, m. wind blow-ing in front, ib.
11231: मारुति मारुति, i. e. मरुत् + इ, pa-tronym., m.  1. Hanumant.  2. Bhī-masena.
11232: मार्कण्डेय मार्कण्डेय, m. The name of a Muni.
11233: मार्ग् मार्ग् (properly a denomin. derived from मार्ग), i. 1 and 10, Par. (in epic poetry also i. 1, Ātm.).  1. To trace out, to search, Johns. Sel. 93, 50; Pañc. ii. d. 130. i. 10, †  2. To purify. †  3. To adorn. †  4. To go. -- With the prep. परि परि,  1. To search, MBh. 3, 10975.  2. To beg for, 14948.
11234: मार्ग मार्ग, i. e.  A. मृज् + अ (ori-ginally, the tracing out of game by a sporting dog), m.  1. Search.  2. Musk.  3. Trace, Vikr. 57, 12.  4. A road, Pañc. 122, 6; Vikr. 19, 18; way, Pañc. 98, 22; figuratively, Pañc. 167, 22; use, Lass. 20, 18; title of law, Man. 8, 3; mode. Johns. Sel. 11, 28.  5. The anus.  B. मृग + अ,  I. adj. Coming from deer, Rām. 2, 100, 63 Gorr.  II. m.  1. The name of a month, November -- December.  2. The con-stellation Mṛgaśīrṣa.  -- Comp. अम्-बर-चर-, m. the road of the birds, Pañc. i. d. 350. अर्ध-, m. mid-way, Vikr. d. 3. आहार-निःसरण-, m. the anus, Pañc. i. d. 458. उन्म्°, i. e. उद्-, m. wrong way, Hit. 4. 2, M.M. कर्म(न्)-, m. an opening in walls, etc., serving as a way for thieves, Mṛcch. 64, 12. कुल-, m. the road of honesty, Lass. 40, 6. कृत-, adj. made accessible, Vikr. d. 21. त्रि-,  I. the three worlds, Rām. 1, 45, 40 Gorr.  II. f. गी, three roads. देव-, m. the penis and the anus, Rām. 5, 61, 4, 6; Pañc. ed. orn. 55, 9. न-क्षत्र-, m. the road of the stars, Indr. 2, 12. राज(न्)-, m. a royal or main road, Pañc. 129, 16.
11235: मार्गण मार्गण, i. e. मार्ग् + अन,  I. adj. Begging, a beggar.  II. m.  1. A solicitor.  2. An arrow, Chr. 34, 15.  III. n.  1. Searching, Hit. iv. d. 71.  2. Begging.
11236: मार्गणता मार्गण + ता, f. The nature of an arrow, Vikr. d. 144.
11237: मार्गव मार्ग + व, m. The son of a Niṣāda by an Ayogava female, Man. 10, 34.
11238: मार्गशिर मार्गशिर, and मार्ग-शीर्ष मार्गशीर्ष (cf. मार्ग, and शिरस्, and शीर्ष), m. The name of a month, November -- December, Bhag. 10, 35 (-शीर्ष).
11239: मार्गिक मार्गिक, i. e. मृग and मार्ग, + इक, m.  1. A hunter.  2. A traveller.
11240: मार्ज् मार्ज् (cf. मृज्), † मञ्ज् मञ्ज्, † मर्च् मर्च्, † मर्व् मर्व्, i. 10, Par.  1. † To cleanse.  2. † To sound.
11241: मार्ज मार्ज, i. e. मृज् + अ, m.  1. Clean-ing.  2. A washerman.  3. Viṣṇu.
11242: मार्जन मार्जन, i. e. मृज् + अन,  I. n., and f. नी।  1. Cleaning.  2. Rubbing, Man. 5, 116.  3. Cleaning the person by wiping, bathing, or rubbing it with unguents.  II. f. ना, The sound of a drum, Mālav. d. 20.  III. f. नी, A brush, Pañc. ii. d. 108.
11243: मार्जार मार्जार, i. e. मृज् + आर, m., and f. री।  1. The common cat, Pañc. 110, 23.  2. The pole-cat.  -- Comp. अरण्य-, m. a wild cat, Pañc 165, 14.
11244: मार्जारक मार्जारक, i. e. मृज् + आर + क, m. A peacock.
11245: मार्जारीय मार्जारीय, i. e. मार्-जार + ईय, and मार्जालीय मार्जालीय (with ल् for र्), m.  1. A cat.  2. A Śūdra.  3. Cleaning the body.
11246: मार्तण्ड मार्तण्ड, i. e. मृतण्ड + अ, m.  1. The sun, Utt. Rāmac. 140, 9; Rājat. 5, 153.  2. A hog.
11247: मार्त्तिक मार्त्तिक, i. e. मृत्तिका + अ,  I. adj. Earthen.  II. m. A lid, a cover.
11248: मार्त्य मार्त्य, i. e. मृत + य (adj. or sbst. n.), Mortal, the mortal part, Bhāg. P. 3, 33, 32.
11249: मार्दङ्ग मार्दङ्ग, i. e. मृदङ्ग + अ,  I. m. A drummer.  II. n. A town.
11250: मार्दव मार्दव, i. e. मृदु + अ, n. Softness, Chr. 57, 24; Bhartṛ. 1, 5.  -- Comp. सु-, n. beautiful softness, Pañc. iv. d. 62.
11251: मार्ष मार्ष, i. e. मर्ष + अ, m. A venerable man (in dramatic language), Sch. ad Vikr. ed. Bollensen, p. 142.
11252: मार्ष्टि मार्ष्टि, i. e. मृज् + ति, f.  1. Cleaning.  2. Cleaning the person by bathing, etc.; cf. मार्जन।
11253: माल माल,  I. m.  1. A name of a barbarous tribe, Lass. 38, 14.  2. The name of a country, Megh. 16.  3. Viṣṇu.  II. i. e. मल + अ, f. ला।  1. A line.  2. A garland, a necklace, Hit. i. d. 174, M.M. (धृत-कनक-माल, adj. Bearing a gold necklace).  3. A chaplet of flowers.  4. A rosary.  5. A chain, Pañc. 255, 19.  III. n. A field.  -- Comp. अक्ष-, f. ला, 1. a rosary, Dev. 2, 23. 2. a name of Arundhatī, the wife of Vaśiṣṭha, Man. 9, 23. केतु-,  I. m. 1. pl. the name of a people, Hariv. 8227. 2. the name of a वर्ष or division of the earth, Bhāg. P. 5, 2, 19. 11254: ऽमालक -माल + क, at the end of comp. adj., f. लिका; e. g. अक्षर-, Con-sisting of a line of letters, Pañc. ii. d. 183. बद्ध-वन्दन-, adj. Having fastened garlands of salutation, Pañc. 207, 24 (but cf. वन्दन-माला, s. v. माल).
11255: मालती मालती, f.  1. A bud.  2. A young woman.  3. Moonlight.  4. Night.  5. A river.  6. Great-flowered jasmine, Jasminum grandiflorum, Megh. 26; Ṛt. 2, 25.
11256: मालव मालव, m. The province of Malva, Hit. 113, 19.
11257: मालाकार माला कार, m., f. री, A flower-seller, a gardener, Pañc. i. d. 394; Lass. 24, 8.
11258: मालिक मालिक, i. e. माला + इक,  I. adj. Relating to a garland.  II. m.  1. A flower-gatherer, Pañc. v. d. 55 (cf. Pañc. 156, 20).  2. A painter.  3. A sort of bird.  III. f. का।  1. A gar-land of flowers, Pañc. 236, 16.  2. A multitude, Hit. iii. d. 89.  3. A neck-lace.  4. A daughter.  5. A palace.  6. A spirituous liquor.  7. Double jas-mine.  -- Comp. वन्दन-, f. का, the ornamented arc of a gateway; cf. मा-लक।
11259: मालित मालित, i. e. माला + इत, Sur-rounded, Lass. 4, 18.
11260: मालिन् मालिन्, i. e. माला + इन्,  I. m. A florist.  II. f. नी।  1. A female vendor of flowers.  2. A name of Durgā.  3. The Ganges of heaven.  4. A plant, Hedysarum alhagi.  5. A shrub, Echites caryophyllata.  III. As latter part of compounds, very often adj., f. नी, Wearing a garland or chaplet of, cf. comp.  -- Comp. अंशु-, m. the sun, Ṛt. 1, 28. अक्ष- (cf. अक्ष-माला), m. a name of Śiva, MBh. 12, 10374. ऊर्मि-,  I. adj. adorned with a chaplet of waves, Rām. 2, 113, 21.  II. m. the sea, Ragh. 5, 61. कपाल-, adj. wear-ing a string of skulls, MBh. 14, 202. गण्ड-, adj. sbst. one who has the erysipelas, Man. 3, 161. जालक-, adj., f. नी, adorned with a necklace in the form of a net, Bhāg. P. 8, 20, 17. नगर-, adj. garlanded with cities, Johns. Sel. 4, 19. पद्म-, m. the name of a Rākṣasa, Rām. 6, 7, 33. f. epithet of Śrī, MBh. 12, 8353 (adorned with a string of lotus flowers). पुर-, f. नी, the name of a river, MBh. 6, 329. मरीचि-,  I. adj. surrounded by a circle of rays, Hit. 38, 1, M.M.  II. m. the sun. वन-, m. Kṛṣṇa. वीचि-, m. the ocean. हेम-, adj. adorned with a chaplet of gold, Rām. 3, 50, 20.
11261: मालिन्य मालिन्य, i. e. मलिन + य, n. Blackness, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1915 (मालिन्यं को दोषः, What an object of blame is the blackness! i. e. the blackness is no object of blame).
11262: मालूर मालूर, m. A fruit-tree, Aegle marmelos, Lass. 86, 6 (Prākṛ.).
11263: माल्य माल्य, i. e. माला + य,  I. adj. Fit for a garland.  II. n.  1. A flower, Johns. Sel. 40, 38.  2. A garland, Pañc. 199, 19.  3. A chaplet, Man. 2, 177.  -- Comp. गन्ध-, n. an agree-ably smelling wreath, Pañc. 182, 10.
11264: माल्यगुणाय माल्यगुणाय, a denomin. derived from माल्य-गुण with य, Ātm. To become a garland, Bhartṛ. 2, 78.
11265: माल्यवन्त् माल्य + वन्त्,  I. m. The name of a mountainous range.  II. f. वती, The name of a river.
11266: माष माष, m.  1. A sort of kidney bean, Phaseolus radiatus, Man. 3, 267.  2. A goldsmith's weight, Man. 8, 134.  3. A fool.  4. A cutaneous disease.  -- Comp. महा-, m. a sort of bean, Doli-chos catjang.
11267: माषक माष + क, m. A weight of gold and of silver, Man. 8, 135.
11268: ऽमाषिक -माषिक, i. e. माष + इक, latter part of comp. adj. Amounting to māṣas; e. g. पञ्च(न्)-, Amounting to five māṣas, Man. 8, 298.
11269: माषीण माषीण, and माष्य माष्-य, i. e. माष + ईन, or य, n. A field of kidney beans.
11270: मास् मास् (= मास, q. cf.), m.  1. The moon.  2. A month.  -- Comp. पुष्प-, m. spring (the season), Rām. 3, 79, 16.
11271: मास मास, (sprung from मान्त्, ptcple. pres. of मा); the base of many cases is optionally मास्, m. A month, Pañc. 169, 6.  -- Comp. अर्ध-, m. half a month, a fortnight, Man. 4, 25. गर्भ-, m. a month of pregnancy, Kathās. 26, 146. पुष्प-, m. spring (the season), Rām. 3, 79, 39. पूर्ण-, m. 1. the full of the moon. 2. a monthly sacrifice performed on the day of full moon. -- Cf. μήν; Lat. monsis; Goth. mêna; A.S. mona; Goth. mênôths; A.S. monadh.
11273: मासर मासर, m. The scum of boiled rice.
11274: मासशस् मास + शस्, adv. For months, MBh. 13, 5659.
11275: मासानुमासिक मासानुमासिक, i. e. मास-अनु-मास + इक, adj. Performed from month to month, Man. 3, 122.
11276: मासावधिक मासावधिक, i. e. मास -अवधि + क, adj. Having as limit a month, taking place after a month, Daśak. in Chr. 189, 1.
11277: मासिक मासिक,  I. adj., f. की।  1. Monthly, Man. 3, 123; 5, 140.  2. Pay-able in a month.  3. Hired by the month.  4. Lasting for a month.  5. Happening at the end of a month.  II. n. An obsequial sacrifice performed every day of the new moon.  -- Comp. अष्टमासिक, i. e. अष्टन्-, f. की, lasting eight months, Chr. 47, 36. स्कण्मा-सिक, i. e. षष्-, adj. happening every sixth month, Pañc. 252, 14.
11279: मासूर मासूर, i. e. मसूर + अ, adj., f. री, Consisting, made of lentils or pulse.
11280: † माह् माह् (माड् माड्) i. 1, Par. Ātm. To mete, to measure.
11281: माहाकुल माहाकुल, i. e. महा -कुल + अ, adj. Of a respectable family.
11282: माहात्मिक माहात्मिक, i. e. महा -आत्मन् + इक, adj.  1. Majestic, Man. 5, 94.  2. Of great honour.  3. Glorious.
11283: माहात्म्य माहात्म्य, i. e. महा-आ-त्मन् + य, n.  1. Majesty, might, Utt. Rāmac. 96, 3; Pañc. 48, 18; ii. d. 52.  2. The peculiar efficacy or virtue of a deity or sacred shrine.  3. A work giving an account of the merits of any holy object, Dev. title.
11284: माहित्र माहित्र, (n.), The name of a holy text, Man. 11, 249.
11286: माहिष माहिष, i. e. महिष + अ, adj., f. षी, Belonging to, or coming from, a buffalo (flesh, milk, etc.), Śārṅg. 82, 219.
11287: माहिषिक माहिषिक, i. e. महिष + इक, m. A keeper of buffaloes, Man. 3, 166.
11288: माहिष्य माहिष्य, i. e. महिष + य, m. The offspring of a Kṣatriya father and a Vaiśya mother.
11289: माहेन्द्र माहेन्द्र, i. e. महा-इन्द्र + अ, adj. Relating to Indra.
11290: माहेयी माहेयी, i. e. मही + एय + ई, f. A cow.
11291: मि मि, ii. 5, Par. Ātm. To throw.
11292: † मिछ् मिछ्, पिछ् पिछ्, i. 6, Par.  1. To inflict pain.  2. To obstruct.
11293: † मिञ्ज् मिञ्ज् (?), i. 10, Par. To speak. To shine.
11294: मितद्रु मित-द्रुइ (vb. मा), m. The ocean.
11295: मितंपच मितंपच, i. e. मित (vb. मा), + म्-पच् + अ, adj. Niggardly, a niggard, Hit. i. d. 154, M.M.
11296: मिति मिति, i. e. मा + ति, f.  1. Measur-ing.  2. Determining.  3. Knowledge.
11297: मित्त्र मित्त्र, commonly written मित्र मित्र, i. e. मिद् + त्र,  I. m.  1. A vedic deity, Chr. 298, 25 = Rigv. i. 112, 25.  2. The sun, Pañc. ii. d. 75.  II. n.  1. A friend, Rām. 3, 51, 9.  2. An ally.  -- Comp. अ-, m., and f. रा, an enemy, Rām. 3, 51, 9. कु-, n. a treacherous friend, Pañc. iii. d. 61. निस्-अ-, 1. adj. free from enemies, Rām. 2, 18, 7 Gorr. 2. m. a proper name. धन- and पुरु-, m. proper names. स-, adj. with (his) friends, Chr. 54, 16. सु-, f. त्रा, one of the wives of Daśaratha.
11298: मित्त्रता मित्त्र + ता, f., and मित्त्रत्व मित्त्र + त्व, n. Friendship, Pañc. ii. d. 32; iii. d. 1.
11299: मित्त्रयु मित्त्र + यु,  I. adj. Ac-quiring friends.  II. m. A person ac-quainted with the ways and manners of mankind (?).
11300: मित्त्रवन्त् मित्त्र + वन्त्, adj., f. वती। One who has friends, Pañc. ii. d. 26.
11301: मिथ् मिथ्, मिध् मिध् (see मेध्), † मिद् मिद्, † मेद् मेद्, i. 1, Par. Ātm. †  1. To understand.  2. To hurt.  3. To rival (ved.). Caus. मेधय, To further, MBh. 13, 7510.
11302: मिथस् मिथ् + अस्, adv.  1. Mutually, reciprocally, with each other, Pañc. 125, 10; from each other, Pañc. 42, 22.  2. Privately, Man. 8, 195 (Daśak. in Chr. 192, 20, read पार्थिवं मिथो).
11303: मिथिला मिथिला, f. The name of a town.
11304: मिथुन मिथ् + उन (for + वन),  I. n.  1. A couple, Utt. Rāmac. 36, 8.  2. Copulation.  3. Union.  II. m. The sign of the zodiac, Gemini.  -- Comp. गो-, n. a bull and a cow, Man. 3, 29.
11305: मिथ्या मिथ्या (vb. मिथ्), adv. Falsely, Pañc. 7, 16; untruly, feigned, Lass. 9, 11; wrong, Pañc. 206, 11; what does not concern one, Pañc. 9, 24; in vain, Sāv. 6, 14.
11306: मिद् मिद्, i. 1, Ātm., i. 4, मेद्य, Par., and i. 10, Par., also † मिन्द् मिन्द्, i. 10, Par.  1. To be unctuous.  2. † To liquefy. †  3. To love.  4. To rejoice (ved.). -- With प्र प्र, Caus. प्रमेदित, Made unctuous; greasy. See मिथ्। -- Cf. μειδάω.
11309: † मिन्व् मिन्व्, i. 1, Par.  1. To sprinkle.  2. To gratify by service.
11310: मिल् मिल् (probably an old de-nomin. based on a noun derived from मिश्ल (= मिश्र), changed to मिल्ल), i. 6, Par. Ātm.  1. To associate, Pañc. 220, 13.  2. To be connected, 229, 11 (पृष्ठ आगत्य मिलितः, Was the last).  3. To meet, Hit. 83, 6, M.M.  4. To assemble, Pañc. 53, 20; Rājat. 5, 465. Ptcple. pf. pass. मिलित, Mixed (co-vered), Pañc. 122, 11. -- With परि परि, परिमिलित, Penetrated, filled, Śiś. 11, 23. -- With सम् सम्, संमिलित, Col-lected, Pañc. 229, 5.
11312: मिश्र् मिश्र्, and † मिस्र् मिस्र्, i. 10 (rather a denomin. derived from मिश्र), Par. To mix, Śāk. d. 30. मिश्रित,  1. Mixed, Pañc. 215, 2.  2. Respected (i. e. मिश्र + इत, cf. मिश्र).  -- With the prep. वि वि, To put in dis-order, MBh. 1, 3282.
11313: मिश्र मिश्र, i. e. मिश् (perhaps for मिक्ष्, desider. of मिह्, without red., cf. मिह् with सम्), + र,  I. adj. Mixed, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 187; Pañc. 9, 4; Utt. Rāmac. 42, 11.  II. n. Mixing.  III. m.  1. An elephant.  2. A respectable person, Sir, Lass. 95, 9; in this sense it is a common affix to nouns, Vikr. 3, 12, and proper names, Lass. 89, 6.  -- Comp. आर्य-, m. pl. a respectable person, Rām. 2, 82, 18; Prab. 25, 2. -- Cf. Lat. miscere; O.H.G. miscjan; A.S. mis-can; μίσγω, μίγνυμι.
11314: मिश्रक मिश्र + क,  I. m.  1. A mixer.  2. An adulterator of commodities, a mixer of bad wares with good ones, Man. 11, 50.  II. n. A grove of paradise.
11315: 1. मिष् मिष् (probably for मिक्ष्, and akin to मिह्), i. 1, Par. To sprinkle. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. मिष्ट।  1. Sprinkled.  2. Sweet, Pañc. 119, 7. n. A fine dish, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1787; sweetmeat.
11316: 2. मिष् मिष्, i. 6, Par. (properly To wink, to contract the eyelids, cf. मील्, क्ष्मील्, श्मील्, स्मील्, and स्मि).  1. To look at angrily, Chr. 4, 16 (हरामि मिषतां वस्, I shall take [her] while you are looking on angrily, i. e. in spite of you).  2. † To contend, to resist. --With the prep. उद् उद्,  1. To open one's eyes, Bhag. 5, 9; Kumāras. 5, 25.  2. To flash, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 16. --With प्रत्युद् प्रति-उद्, To break forth, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 4. -- With नि नि, To shut one's eyes, to wink, MBh. 3, 10649. -- Cf. Lat. miser; μῖσος, probably also μύω, cf. ὄμματα, σψμ-μεμυκότα, ἀναμεμυκότα; Lat. micare.
11317: मिष मिस्ह् + अ,  I. m. Emulation.  II. n. Fraud.
11318: † मिस् मिस्, i. 4, Par. To go.
11320: मिह् मिह् (for original मिघ्), i. 1, Par.  1. To sprinkle.  2. To urine, Chr. 290, 6 = Rigv. i. 64, 6; Man. 4, 52. Ptcple. of the pf. Par. मीढ्वंस् (ved.), also before vowels, मीऌह्° for मीढ्°, One who effuses or gives, Lass. 100, 1 = Rigv. vii. 15, 1. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. मीढ।  Comp. पुरु-, m. a pro-per name. -- With the prep. प्र प्र, प्रमीढ,  1. Passed, as urine.  2. Thick. -- With सम् सम्,  1. To sprinkle, to give, Chr. 288, 16 = Rigv. i. 48, 16. (मिमिक्ष्व, imperat., ii. 3, Ātm. or anomal. desider.). Desider. मिमिक्ष, To wish to mix, to unite one's self, Chr. 293, 6 = Rigv. i. 87, 6 (मिमिक्षिरे, anomal. pf. red.). -- Cf. Lat. mingere, mejere; A.S. mígan; Goth. maihstus; A.S. meox, miox, mist; ὁμίχλη, ὀμιχεΐν, μοιχός, μιαίνω, μιαρός.
11321: मिहिर मिहिर, m.  1. i. e. मिह् + इर, A cloud.  2. (borrowed from the Per-sian language), The sun.  3. The moon.  4. Wind.  5. A proper name.
11322: मिहिलारोप्य मिहिलारोप्य, n. The name of a town, Pañc. 3, 9.
11323: 1. मी मी, ii. 9, मीना, मीनी, and ved. मिना, मिनी, Par. To hurt. Comp. ptcple. pres. अ-मिनन्त्, Not hurting, Chr. 295, 12 = Rigv. i. 92, 12. i. 4, Ātm. To perish. -- With the prep. आ आ, ii. 9, To hurt, to scrape off, Chr. 295, 10 = Rigv. i. 92, 10. -- With प्र प्र, ii. 9,  1. To diminish, Chr. 295, 11 = Rigv. i. 92, 11.  2. To sur-mount, to surpass. i. 4, To perish. प्रमीत, Deceased, Man. 3, 245. Caus. मापय, To cause to perish, Man. 1, 57; to kill, 8, 295. -- Cf. Lat. prō-mī-nere, e-minere, minere, prō-minare, e-minus, co-minus, minari.
11324: 2. † मी मी, i. 1 and 10, Par. To go, see मे। -- Cf. Lat. meare and mo-vere (causal).
11325: मीन मीन (probably vb. मिह्), m.  1. A fish, Pañc. ii. d. 3.  2. The sign of the zodiac, Pisces.
11326: † मीम् मीम्, i. 1, Par.  1. To go.  2. To sound (cf. 2. मा).
11328: मीमांसक मीमांसक, i. e. मीमां-सा + अक, m. A follower of the Pūrva-Mīmāṃsā philosophy.
11329: मीमांसा मीमांसा, i. e. मीमांस + अ, f. Two of the philosophical systems of the Hindus, distinguished as पूर्व and उत्तर।
11330: मीमांसाकृत् मीमांसा-कृ + त्, m. The author of the Pūrva-Mīmāṃsā philosophy, Jaimini, Pañc. ii. d. 34.
11331: मीर मीर (vb. मिह्), m. The ocean.
11332: मील् मील् (originally a denomin. based on a noun derived from मिस्ह् by an affix, with initial ल्), i. 1, Par.  1. To wink, to contract the eyelids, to close the eyes, Gīt. 10, 16.  2. To be closed of itself (viz. the eyes), Bhaṭṭ. 14, 54.  3. To be col-lected, Utt. Rāmac. 126, 5 (with v. r.). Comp. ptcple. pf. pass. ईषन्मीलित, i. e. ईषत्- adj. Closed a little, Lass. 13, 7. Caus. मीलय, To close (viz. one's eyes), लोचने मीलयित्वा, Like a mo-ment, Megh. 109. -- With the prep. अभि अभि, To close (viz. one's eyes), Rāj. t. 5, 348. -- With आ आ, To close (viz. one's eyes), Daśak. in Chr. 199, 4.  -- With उद् उद्,  1. To open one's eyes, MBh. 3, 11155.  2. To be opened of itself (as one's eyes), Bhaṭṭ. 16, 8.  3. To open, Gīt. 1, 36; (one's eyes), Vikr. d. 5.  4. To show, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 23.  5. To hang down (as curls), Utt. Rāmac. 14, 4. Caus. To open (viz. one's eyes), MBh. 2, 2630.  -- With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, To open one's eyes, Gīt. 4, 19. -- With समुद् सम्-उद्, To open of itself, to spring up, Bhartṛ. 2, 78. -- With नि नि,  1. To close (viz. one's eyes), Śiś. 9, 11; Vikr. 7, 5; Pañc. 165, 15.  2. To fall asleep, Man. 1, 52.  3. To be covered, Rājat. 5, 481. Caus.  1. To cause to shut the eyes, to kill, Pañc. iii. d. 269.  2. To close, Ṛt. 6, 26. -- With विनि वि-नि, To close the eyes, Bhaṭṭ. 11, 9. -- With प्र प्र, To close the eyes, Gīt. 4, 19. -- With सम् सम्,  1. To close (viz. the eyes), Ragh. 3, 26 (Calc.).  2. To close (as flowers), Śāk. 45, 4 Chezy. Caus.  1. To cause to shut the eyes, to make insensible, Utt. Rāmac. 23, 7.  2. To close, Ragh. 13, 10 (Calc.).
11333: † मीव् मीव्, i. 1, Par. To grow cor-pulent.
11334: मीवर मीवर (probably from vb. मिह्), adj., f. री, Mischievous.
11335: मीवा मीवा (perhaps from vb. मिह्), f. The worm of the intestines, asca-rides, etc.
11337: मुकुट मुकुट,  I. n. A crest, a dia-dem, Pañc. 3, 10.  II. (vb. 2. मुच्, cf. मुचुटी), f. टी, Snapping the fingers.  -- Comp. प्रताप-, m. a proper name, Lass. 5, 20.
11338: मुकुन्द मुकुन्द, m.  1. A precious gem.  2. Quicksilver.  3. One of Ku-vera's treasures.  4. A name of Viṣṇu, Bhāg. P. 4, 9, 36.  5. Gum olibanum.
11339: मुकुर मुकुर (also मकुर मकुर), m.  1. A looking-glass, Śiś. 9, 73 (मु°).  2. The stick of a potter's wheel.  3. A bud.  4. A tree, Mimusops elengi.  5. Arabian jasmine.
11340: मुकुल मुकुल (also मकुल मकुल), m. and n.  1. An opening bud, Ragh. 9, 27 (मु°); Utt. Rāmac. 14, 5 (द-शन-मु°, bud-like teeth).  2. The body.  3. The soul.
11341: मुकुलित मुकुलित, i. e. मुकुल + इत, adj.  1. Half closed (as a bud).  2. Half shut (as the eye), Vikr. 47, 19.
11342: मुक्तक मुक्त + क (vb. मुच्क्), n. Any missile weapon.
11343: मुक्ता मुक्ता (f. of the ptcple. pf. pass. of मुच्), f. A pearl, Vikr. d. 153.  -- Comp. शङ्ख-, f. Shells and pearls, Rām. 3, 49, 36.
11344: मुक्ताकण मुक्ता-कण, m. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 34.
11345: मुक्ताकारता मुक्ताकारता, i. e. मुक्-ता-आकार + ता, The form of a pearl, Bhartṛ. 2, 57.
11346: मुक्ति मुक्ति, i. e. 2. मुच् + ति, f.  1. Leaving off, Bhartṛ. 2, 52.  2. Deliver-ance, release (मुक्तिं प्राप्नुमः, We shall be released), Pañc. 106, 1; ii. d. 44.  3. The delivery of the soul from the body, and exemption from further transmigration, final beatitude.
11347: मुख मुख,  I. n.  1. The mouth, Pañc. 258, 16.  2. The face, Pañc. 238, 23.  3. Front, Draup. 8, 8.  4. Entrance, Utt. Rāmac. 15, 19; the entrance to a house.  5. An aperture, Śiś. 9, 2.  6. Commencement, Pañc. 29, 16; Chr. 8, 33.  7. A means.  8. Sound.  II. m. 11391: मुनि मुनि, i. e. मन् + इ (उ for अ, by the influence of the preceding labial),  I. m.  1. A holy sage, endowed with divine inspiration, Vikr. d. 3.  2. An ascetic, Pañc. 34, 13.  3. The saint Agastya, Vyāsa, Kir. 5, 49.  4. The name of two plants.  II. f. नी̆, A female saint.  -- Comp. महा-,  I. m. 1. a great Muni, Chr. 15, 29; Rām. 3, 49, 50 (epithet of Agastya.) 2. the saint Agastya. 3. epithet of Paraśurāma, Chr. 19, 12, and of Vyāsa. 4. time.  II. n. Coriander.
11392: मुमुक्षु मुमुक्षु, i. e. मुमुक्ष, desider. of मुच्, + उ,  I. adj.  1. De-siring to dart (viz. arrows), Ragh. 9, 58.  2. Anxious for liberation from mundane existence or final beatitude, Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 22; Vikr. d. 1.  II. m. A sage abstracted from all human passion.
11393: मुमुक्षुत्व मुमुक्षु + त्व, n. Con-dition of one who is anxious for final beatitude; wishing for final beatitude, Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 7.
11394: मुमूर्षा मुमूर्षा, i. e. मुमूर्ष, desider. of मृ, + अ, f. Desire to die, MBh. 1, 1899.
11395: मुमूर्षु मुमूर्षु, i. e. मुमूर्ष, desider. of मृ, + उ, adj. Being about to die, Hit. 64, 8; Rājat. 5, 218; 411.
11396: † मुर् मुर्, i. 6, To circle, to surround. -- Cf. perhaps Lat. mūrus.
11397: मुर मुर, m. The name of a Daitya killed by Viṣṇu.
11398: मुरज मुरज,  I. m. A small drum, Mālav. d. 21.  II. f. जा।  1. A large drum, Kumāras. 6, 40.  2. The wife of Kuvera.
11399: मुरला मुरला, f. The Narmadā river, Utt. Rāmac. 50, 2.
11402: मुर्छ् मुर्छ् (akin to मृ and म्लै), i. 1, मूर्छ, Par.  1. To be faint, to lose consciousness, Rām. 2, 34, 17.  2. To increase, to grow vehement, Ragh. 12, 57 (Calc.).  3. To be fre-quent, Śāk. 66, 4.  4. To fill, 6, 9 (Calc.).  5. To be a match for, 2, 34 (Calc.); to be powerful, Śāk. d. 191 (to appear in a looking-glass). Ptcple. of the pf. pass. मूर्छित।  1. Fainted, Vikr. 54, 17; insensible, Rām. 2, 34, 17.  2. Stupid.  3. Intoxicated, MBh. 3, 1864.  4. Infatuated, Chr. 37, 27; bewildered, Lass. 7, 10.  5. Increased, grown.  6. Tall.  Comp. क्रोध-, adj. over-powered by wrath, Indr. 5, 48. -- With the prep. अभि अभि, अभिमूर्छित, Intoxicated, infatuated, MBh. 1, 7794. --With वि वि, विमूर्छित, Wrapped (Stenzler), Yājñ. 3, 75. -- With सम् सम्,  1. To increase, Kir. 5, 41.  2. To be powerful, Ragh. 16, 64 (Calc.). Caus. To cause to faint, Utt. Rāmac. 47, 2. -- Cf. Goth. untila-malsks, foolish.
11403: मुर्मुर मुर्मुर, m.  1. A fire of chaff.  2. The god of love.  3. A horse of the sun.
11404: † मुर्व् मुर्व्, i. 1, मूर्व, Par. To bind, to tie.
11406: मुशल मुशल, मुषल मुष् + अल (see मुस्), and मुसल मुस् + अल,  I. m. n. A pestle, a club, Arj. 10, 5 (ष्).  II. f. लि। A house-lizard.  -- Comp. कङ्काल-मु-षल, m. or n. a kind of weapon, Rām. 1, 30, 13 Gorr.; 57, 12 Gorr. चक्र -मुषल, adj. performed with the disk and club, Hariv. 5346. दन्त-मुषल, m. or n. a pestle-like tusk, Pañc. 69, 1. Cf. मुसल।
11407: 1. मुष् मुष्, ii. 9, मुष्णा, मुष्णी, and i. 6 (MBh. 3, 13047; Lass. 35, 16), Par. To steal, Daśak. in Chr. 189, 22; to rob, to plunder, Rājat. 5, 268; to cap-tivate, Nal. 5, 7. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. मुषित।  1. Stolen.  2. Robbed, plun-dered, Daśak. in Chr. 194, 1.  3. De-prived of, free from, Hit. 42, 12. -- With परि परि, To rob, to plunder, MBh. 3, 13030. -- With प्र प्र, To rob, Bhaṭṭ. 17, 60. See मष्, मुस्, and मूष्।
11408: 2. मुष् मुष्,  I. f. Stealing, Rājat. 5, 168 (read मुषे instead of मुखे, ‘Having turned his mind on stealing.’)  II. Latter part of comp. adj. Stealing, robbing; e. g. धृति-, adj. Stealing, destroying constancy, Hit. i. d. 193, M.M. नेत्र-, adj. Captivating the eyes, MBh. 3, 1720. श्री-, Having stolen, i. e. possessed of the beauty, Megh. 48.
11409: मुषल मुषल, see मुशल and मु-सल।
11411: मुषितक मुषित + क (vb. मुष्), n. Stolen objects, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 14.
11412: मुष्क मुष्क, m.  1. i. e. मुष् + क, A thief.  2. A testicle, the scrotum, Hit. 76, 1, M.M.; 49, 14.  3. A heap, a multitude.  4. The name of a plant.
11413: मुष्कर मुष्क + र, m. A man with large testicles.
11414: मुष्टि मुष्टि, m. and f.  1. The fist, Rām a, 15, 17; Pañc. i. d. 203.  2. A handful, Pañc. 215, 1.  3. The handle of a sword. -- Cf. perhaps A.S. fyst.
11416: मुष्टिता मुष्टि + ता, in दृढ- (vb. दृंह्), f. Firmness of grasp, Johns. Sel. 12, 30.
11417: मुष्टिंधय मुष्टिंधय, i. e. मुष्टि + म्-धे + अ, m. A child.
11418: मुस् मुस्, or मुष् मुष्, i. 4, Par. To break to pieces.
11419: मुसल मुस् + अल, also मुषल मुष् + अल (see मुस्), n.  1. A pestle, Man. 3, 88 (स्).  2. A club. Cf. मुशल।
11420: मुसलिन् मुसलिन्, i. e. मुसल + इन्, m. A name of Baladeva.
11421: मुसल्य मुसल्य, and मुषल्य मु-षल्य, i. e. मुसल + य, adj. Deserving death by pounding with a pestle.
11422: † मुस्त् मुस्त्, i. 10, Par. To ac-cumulate.
11423: मुस्त मुस्त, m., and f. ता, A fragrant grass, Cyperus rotundus, Śāk. d. 39 (ता).  -- Comp. स-भद्र-मुस्त, adj. full of Cyperus rotundus (cf. भद्र -मुस्तक), Ṛt. i, 17 (but v. r. सु -भद्र-, containing very auspicious Cyperus rotundus).
11424: मुस्तक मुस्त + क,  I. m. and n. A fragrant grass, Cyperus rotundus.  II. n. A sort of poison.  -- Comp. भद्र-, n. = मुस्त, q. cf.
11425: मुस्तु मुस्तु, m. The fist (cf. मुष्टि).
11427: मुह् मुह्, i. 4, Par.  1. To be faint, to lose consciousness, Chr. 32, 24.  2. To be disturbed (in mind), to be per-plexed, Bhag. 2, 13.  3. To fail, Hit. iii. d. 54. Ptcple. of the pf. pass.  I. मूध।  1. Perplexed, confused, Śiś. 9, 77.  2. Foolish, stupid, Nal. 6, 12; 18, 10.  3. Deceived.  4. Ignorant, un-learned, Pañc. 243, 18. m.  1. A fool, Vikr. 32, 15.  2. A sluggard.  II. मुग्ध।  1. Stupid, Pañc. 166, 25.  2. Being in love, Śāk. d. 36.  3. In-nocent, d. 24.  4. Simple.  5. Beautiful, lovely, Utt. Rāmac. 14, 5.  Comp. अ-मूढ, adj. 1. not perplexed, bold. 2. wise. दिङ्मूढ, i. e. दिश्-, adj. one who has lost the points of the compass, and cannot tell the east from the west, Rām. 3, 60, 3. महा -मूढ, adj. very foolish, a great fool, Pañc. 38, 12. अति-मुग्ध, being much in love, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 2. Frequent. मोमुह्य, To be much dis-turbed, MBh. 4, 801. Caus. मोहय,  1. To perplex, MBh. 1, 5457.  2. To infatuate, Hit. i. d. 179, M.M.; Rām. 3, 55, 22; मोकित, Infatuated, Hit. i. d. 25, M.M.  3. To stupefy, Man. 11, 96. मोहित,  1. Puzzled, Utt. Rāmac. 36, 8.  2. Beguiled, Nal. 8, 16. -- With the prep. व्या वि-आ, Caus. To disturb, to perplex, Pañc. 129, 8. व्यामोहित, Infatuated, Pañc. 199, 1. -- With उद् उद्, उन्-मुग्ध, Disturbed, Siddh. K. 16, 6. --With परि परि, Caus., Ātm. To per-plex, MBh. 1, 3571. परिमूढ, Be-wildered, Utt. Rāmac. 23, 7. -- With प्र प्र,  I. प्रमूढ।  1. Fainted, Utt. Rāmac. 160, 10.  2. Disturbed, perplexed, Matsyop. 54.  3. Foolish, stupid, a fool.  II. प्रमुअध। Fainted, Utt. Rāmac. 164, 17. Caus. To pérturb, Draup. 6, 21. प्रमोहित, Insensible. -- With विप्र वि-प्र, To be disturbed, Bhag. 2, 72. Caus. To perplex, MBh. 1, 5978. -- With वि वि,  I. विमूढ।  1. Bewildered, Utt. Rāmac. 101, 1.  2. Beguiled.  3. Foolish. m. A kind of divine being (i. e. मूध with वि, Wise), Sund. 3, 5.  II. विमुग्ध, Bewildered, Hit. 91, 9, M.M.; absorbed. Caus.  1. To disturb, Bhag. 3, 40.  2. To infatuate, Rājat. 5, 378. विमोहित, Bewitched, Kathās. 25, 274. -- With सम् सम्, To be disturbed, MBh. 3, 10978.  I. संमूढ।  1. Be-wildered.  2. Stupefied.  3. Foolish, Hit. iv. d. 71.  4. Produced rapidly.  5. Heaped.  6. Broken.  II. सं-मुग्ध।  1. Fascinated.  2. Stupefied, Utt. Rāmac. 171, 5.  3. Beautiful. Caus.  1. To perplex, MBh. 2, 1949.  2. To infatuate, Pañc. i. d. 210.
11428: मुहिर मुह् + इर,  I. adj. Foolish.  II. m. Love, the god of love.
11429: मुहुर् मुहुर्, probably मुह् + उ + त्रा, adv.  1. A moment, Rām. 3, 50, 10 (cf. मुहूर्त and Rām. 3, 50, 6).  2. Repeatedly, Vikr. d. 6. Doubled, मु-हुर्-मुहुर्, adv. Repeatedly, Ṛt. 6, 9.
11430: मुहूर्त मुहूर्त, i. e. मुहुर् + त,  I. m. and n.  1. A moment, Rām. 3, 50, 6; some time, Vikr. 40, 4 (परं मुहूर्-तात्, After some time, not yet).  2. 11431: मुहेर मुह् + एर, m. A fool.
11432: † मू मू, i. 1, Ātm. To bind; see मव्।
11433: मूक मूक,  I. adj. Dumb, Pañc. i. d. 71.  II. m.  1. A fish.  2. A poor man.  3. A Daitya. -- Cf. Lat. mūtus.
11434: मूढता मूढ + ता (vb. मुह्), f., and मूढत्व मूढ + त्व, n. Foolishness, Pañc. 123, 13; 228, 3.
11435: मूढवत् मूढ + वत् (vb. मुह्), adv. Like a fool, Chr. 8, 30.
11436: मूत्र् मूत्र् (properly a denomin. derived from मूत्र), i. 10, Par. To urine. -- With the prep. अव अव, To urine on somebody, Man. 8, 282.
11437: मूत्र मूत्र (vb. मिह् and aff. त्र), n. Urine, piss, Pañc. 121, 15.
11438: मूत्रित मूत्रित, i. e. मूत्र + इत, adj. Soiled with urine.
11439: मूर्ख मूर्ख, i. e. मुर्छ् + अ, m. A fool, a blockhead, Vikr. 33, 2.
11440: मूर्खता मूर्ख + ता, f., मूर्खत्व मूर्ख + त्व, n., and मूर्खिमन् मूर्खि-मन्, i. e. मूर्ख + इमन्, m. Stupidity, Pañc. iii. d. 246; 127, 14.
11441: मूर्छता मूर्छता, i. e. मुर्छ् + अ + ता, f. Denseness, Vikr. d. 48.
11442: मूर्छन मूर्छन, i. e. मुर्छ् + अन,  I. n. Modulation, Rām. 1, 4, 11.  II. f. ना।  1. A melody, Megh. 84.  2. A tone as placed in its scale, the seventh part of a scale, Lass. 39, 9; Pañc. iii. d. 43.
11443: मूर्छा मूर्छा, i.e. मूर्छ् + अ, f. Fainting, loss of consciousness, Utt. Rāmac. 58, 7; Pañc. 35, 10 (instr. by fainting, i. e. fainted).
11445: मूर्त मूर्त (akin to मूर्ति), adj., f. ता।  1. Solid, material, corporeal, Bhāṣāp. 86; 157; Utt. Rāmac. 60, 7.  2. Embodied, incarnate, Śāk. d. 32; Kathās. 3, 62.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. incor-poreal, Bhāṣāp. 87; Kathās. 20, 70.
11446: मूर्तत्व मूर्त + त्व, n. Corporality, Bhāṣāp. 24.
11447: मूर्ति मूर्ति, probably better मूर्त्ति, i. e. मृद् + ति, cf. Man. 12, 120.  1. Matter, substance, Man. 1, 17; hard substances, Man. 12, 120 (Jones: the terrene parts of the human body).  2. Figure, form, Bhartṛ. 2, 1; Pañc. ii. d. 169.  3. Body, Rājat. 5, 364.  4. In-carnation, Man. 1, 98.  5. Image, Man. 2, 225.  6. Beauty, Pañc. ii. d. 107.  -- Comp. अष्ट(न्)-, m. a name of Śiva, Śiś. 14, 18. तपस्-,  I. f. in-carnation of devotion, Rām. 1, 31, 11.  II. m. a proper name, Bhāg. P. 8, 13, 29. तेजस्-, adj. consisting entirely of light, Man. 3, 93. त्रि-, adj. having three forms, Kumāras. 2, 4. -- Cf. per-haps βρέτας and μορϕή.
11448: मूर्तितस् मूर्ति + तस्, adv. = abl. sing. of मूर्ति, Man. 1, 55.
11449: मूर्तिमन्त् मूर्ति + मन्त्, adj., f. मती।  1. Having shape or substance, embodied, Utt. Rāmac. 13, 4.  2. Incarnate, Hit. 100, 2; Śāk. d. 112.  -- Comp. विश्व-, adj. taking all forms, omnipresent, Viṣṇu, Johns. Sel. 90, 31.
11450: मूर्धज मूर्धज, i. e. मूर्धन्-ज, m. Hair, the hair of the head, Śāk. d. 29.
11451: मूर्धन् मूर्धन्, m. The head, Pañc. 184. 10.  -- Comp. रण-, m. battle, Chr. 59, 21. त्रि-, m. instead of त्रिशिरस् (see -शिरस्), the name of a Rākṣasa, Utt. Rāmac. 42, 14.
11452: मूर्धन्य मूर्धन् + य, adj. Cerebral (rather lingual).
11454: मूर्वा मूर्वा, f. A sort of creeper, Sanseviera zeylanica, from the fibres of which are made bowstrings and the girdle of the Kṣatriyas.
11455: † 1. मूल् मूल् (cf. मूल), i. 1, Par. (and Ātm.), To stand, to be rooted, or firm.
11456: 2. मूल् मूल्, also † मुल् मुल्। i. 10 (rather a denomin. derived from मूल), To plant. -- With the prep. उद् उद्,  1. To uproot, Hit. ii. d. 84.  2. 11457: मूल मूल (vb. मह्),  I. n.  1. The root of a tree, Vikr. 41; root (figu-ratively), Pañc. ii. d. 23.  2. An eatable root, Utt. Rāmac. 33, 8.  3. The lowest part, Megh. 77.  4. Origin.  5. 11458: मूलक मूल + क,  I. m. A sort of poison.  II. n.  1. An esculent root, Man. 8, 341.  2. The radish, Raphanus sativus.  3. A sort of yam.  -- Comp. मस्तक-, n. the neck.
11459: मूलखानक मूलखानक, i. e. मूल -खन् + अक, m. A digger for roots, Man. 8, 260.
11460: मूलहरत्व मूलहरत्व, i. e. मूल -हृ + अ + त्व, n. Complete ruin, Daśak. in Chr. 189, 4.
11461: मूलिक मूलिक, i. e. मूल + इक,  I. adj. Radical, primary.  II. m. A devotee.  III. f. का, A multitude of roots (?), Pañc. 157, 24.
11462: मूल्य मूल्य, i. e. मूल + य,  I. n.  1. The original price, Man. 8, 144.  2. Price, Pañc. ii. d. 61.  3. Wages.  4. An article purchased.  II. adj.  1. Purchasable.  2. 11463: † मूष् मूष्, मुष् मुष्, i. 1, Par. To steal (cf. मुष्).
11464: मूष मूष,  I. m. A rat, a mouse, Pañc. 190, 21.  II. f. षा and षी।  1. A female mouse.  2. A crucible. --Cf. μῦς; Lat. mus; O.H.G. and A.S. mūs.
11465: मूषिक मूषिक, i. e. मूष + इक,  I. m., f. का, A mouse, a rat, Pañc. 190, 19; 22.  II. m.  1. A thief.  2. A tree, Mimosa śirīṣa.  3. The name of a country.
11466: मूषिकाञ्चन मूषिकाञ्चन, i. e. मू-षिक-अञ्च् + अन, m. Gaṇeśa.

11659: यज् यज्, i. 1, Par. Ātm. (ved., also ii. 2, Lass. 101, 13 = Rigv. vii. 16, 5).  1. To sacrifice, Man. 11, 87; with acc., Rām. 1, 31, 5; with instr., MBh. 1, 2473.  2. Ātm. यजमान, m. A person who institutes a sacrifice and pays the expense of it, Pañc. 169, 8; 182, 12. Pass. इज्य, in epic poetry ptcple. pres. इज्यन्त्, MBh. 2, 1325. Pf. ptcple. इष्ट। Ptcple. of the fut. pass. याज्य, To be sacrificed. m. A sacrificer, Man. 8, 317. n. Presents for sacrificing.  Comp. अ-, m. one for whom it is not al-lowed to sacrifice, Man. 11, 59. Infin. यष्टम्, in epic poetry anomal. ईजितुम्, MBh. 2, 1230 (looks like an infin. of the redupl. pf.). Desider. यियक्ष, To wish to sacrifice, MBh. 2, 59. Caus. याजय, To perform a sacrifice for another, Man. 3, 151 (also Ātm., MBh. 1, 8123). -- With the prep. सम् सम्, To worship, Bhaṭṭ. 15, 96. Ptcple. of the fut. pass. (Caus.?), संयाज्य, n. Sacrificing, Man. 11, 59.  Comp. अ -संयाज्य, adj. one with whom nobody is allowed to sacrifice, Man. 9, 238. Caus. To perform a sacrifice for another, MBh. 1, 6375. -- Cf. ἅγιος, ἁγίζω, ἁγνός.
11660: यजत यज् + अत, m. An officiating priest at a sacrifice.
11661: यजति यजति, 3. sing. pres. of यज्।  1. A technical term for those sacrifices which are denoted by the word यजति (cf. जुहोति), Man. 2, 84.  2. m. A sacrifice (ŚKD.).
11662: यजत्र यज् + अत्र,  I. adj. Adorable, Lass. 102, 9 = Rigv. vii. 14, 2.  II. m. A Brāhmaṇa who keeps a sacrificial fire.  III. n. Maintenance of a sacrificial fire.
11663: यजन यज् + अन, n.  1. Sacrificing, Man. 1, 88.  2. Worshipping.  -- Comp. देव-, n. a place of offering to the deities, MBh. 5, 7354; Utt. Rāmac. 10, 4.
11664: यजि यज् + इ,  1. Sacrifice, Man. 10, 79.  2. A sacrificer.
11665: यजुस् यज् + उस्, n. The यजुस्, one of the four Vedas, Man. 1, 23.
11666: यज्ञ यज्ञ, i. e. यज् + न, m. A sacri-fice, Man. 1, 22; 23.  -- Comp. अ-, m. time when the sacrifice is over, Man. 3, 120. ऋषि-, m. inaudible muttering of prayers, Man. 4, 21; cf. 3, 81. ग्रह-, m. a sacrifice offered to the planets, Yājñ. 1, 294. जप-, murmur-ing prayers, Man. 2, 85. नाम(न्)-, m. a nominal sacrifice only (not real), Bhag. 16, 7. पञ्च(न्)-, m. (pl.), the five great sacraments, Man. 3, 67. पाक-, m. a domestic sacrifice, Man. 2, 86; 11, 118. प्रस्ताव-, m. sacrifice-like treating of a subject, i. e. treating a subject where those who partake of it must propound and prove their views, as at sacrifices every one must give presents, Pañc. ii. d. 176. महा-, m. an essential ceremony, a sacrament, Man. 1, 112; 2, 28. विधि-, m. a cere-monial act of worshipping, Man. 2, 85.
11667: यज्ञवाहस् यज्ञवाहस्, i. e. यज्ञ -रह् + अस्, adj. sbst. Carrying away the sacrifices, Chr. 292, 2 = Rigv. i. 86, 2.
11668: यज्ञसेन यज्ञ - सेन (cf. सेना), m. A name of Drupada, Chr. 55, 6.
11669: यज्ञिय यज्ञिय, i. e. यज्ञ + इय,  I. adj. Suitable to a sacrifice, Man. 2, 23.  II. m. The द्वापर, or third युग।
11670: यज्ञोपवीतवन्त् यज्ञोपवीतवन्त्, i. e. यज्ञ-उपवीत + वन्त् (vb. व्ये), adj. Invested with the sacred thread, Johns. Sel. 10, 18.
11671: यज्यु यज्यु (vb. यज्), m. An as-sistant priest at a sacrifice.
11672: यज्वन् यज् + वन्, m. A sacrificer, Pañc. i. d. 333.  -- Comp. अ-, m. one who performs no sacrifices, irreligious, Man. 11, 14; 20.
11673: यज्विन् यज् + विन्, m. A sacrificer, Bhāg. P. 5, 14, 32.
11674: यत् यत् (an old denomin. based on a noun derived from यम्, by an aff. with initial त्), i. 1, Ātm. (ved., and in epic poetry also Par., MBh. 3, 2722).  1. To exert one's self, Pañc. i. d. 284; Chr. 4, 16; to endeavour Man. 11, 6; with infin., MBh. 1, 6360; with dat., Bhag. 7, 3; Vikr. 5, 11 (यतिष्ये सखीप्रत्यानयनाय, I shall endeavour to bring back your friend); Pañc. i. d. 99 (नाशाय, to remove); loc., MBh. 3, 2727; gen., 1, 8085.  2. With acc. To make, to produce, Rām. 3, 49, 56. Ptcple. of the pf. pass.  I. यतित, Endeavoured, tried, MBh. 1, 6015.  II. यत्त।  1. Exerting one's self, Chr. 18, 16.  2. Watchful, Rām. 1, 32, 7.  3. Resolved. Cf. यम्। Caus. and i. 10, Par. यातय।  1. To pre-pare, to cause to be shown. Mālav. 74, 17.  2. To distress, to torture, Bhāg. P. 5, 26, 31; also Ātm. with आत्मानम्, 5, 26, 18.  3. Ātm. To be used, Rām. 2, 62, 26 Gorr.  4. Ātm. To return, to requite, MBh. 3, 1383.  5. To repre-hend, to despise. -- With the prep. अधि अधि, To put on, Chr. 290, 4 = Rigv. i. 64, 4. -- With आ आ, आयत्त।  1. Depending on, Man. 7, 65.  2. Docile, tractable, Hit. 54, 5.  Comp. अन्-, adj. independent, Hit. ii. d. 21. पर-, adj. 1. depending on another, Pañc. i. d. 295, v.r.  2. ruled, Kathās. 18, 381. --With अत्या अति-आ, To exert one's self excessively, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 6. --With समा सम्-आ, समायत्त, De-pending on, MBh. 3, 10484. -- With निस् निस्, Caus., or i. 10,  1. To give back, to restore, Man. 11, 164.  2. To requite, MBh. 2, 2660.  3. To pardon, 1, 3018. -- With प्रतिनिस् प्रति-निस्, Caus., or i. 10, To give back, MBh. 3, 13183. -- With प्र प्र,  1. To endeavour, Man. 7, 198.  2. To apply to, Rām. 1, 58, 21. प्रयतित, Determined, Johns. Sel. 32, 61. -- With प्रति प्रति, Caus., or i. 10, To requite, MBh. 3, 14728. -- With वि वि, Caus., or i. 10, To punish, MBh. 1, 3019.
11675: यतम यतम, यतर यतर, see यद्।
11676: यतस् य + तस् (यद्), adv.  1. Whence, Rām. 3, 53, 27; from any place, Man. 11, 17; Pañc. i. d. 6 (यतस् ततस्, from wherever, Chr. 19, 5).  2. Since, Rām. 2, 7, 1.  3. As, Hit. 127, 10.  4. Because, Pañc. i. d. 402.  5. That, Vikr. d. 118.  6. For, Hit. 7, 2, M.M.; Daśak. in Chr. 194, 4.  7. Where, Brāhmaṇav. 1, 20.  8. Doubled, यतोयतस्, Whencesoever.
11677: 1. यति यति, i. e. यम् + ति (or perhaps rather a curtailed form of यतिन्),  I. m.  1. A sage of subdued passions, Hit. ii. d. 171.  2. A religious mendi-cant, Rām. 3, 52, 26.  II. f.  1. (i. e. यम् + ति), A pause (in music), Pañc. v. d. 44.  2. also यती यती, A widow.
11678: 2. यति य + ति (यद्), adj. As many.
11679: यतिन् यतिन्, perhaps यत + इन् (vb. यम्),  I. m. One who has subdued his passions.  II. f. नी, A widow.
11680: यत्किंचिद यत्किंचिद, i. e. यद् -किम्-चिद् + अ, The name of a holy text, Man. 11, 252.
11681: यत्न यत् + न, m.  1. Effort, Pañc. ii. d. 133; 99 (यत्नात्, in spite of every effort), perseverance, energy, Man. 2, 88.  2. Will, Bhāṣāp. 4.  3. Dili-gence, Chr. 51, 1. यत्नेन, Carefully, Pañc. 192, 12.  4. °नात्, Necessarily, Pañc. 176, 8.  -- Comp. अ-, m. absence of hardship; instr. and abl. sing. without hardship, Man. 5, 47; easily, Pañc. 201, 16. स-,  I. adj. endeavour-ing, Hit. 20, 8, M.M.  II. °नम्, adv. vigorously.
11682: यत्नतस् यत्न + तस्, adv.  1. Vigor-ously, strenuously, Bhartṛ. 2, 5.  2. Carefully, Hit. i. d. 128, M.M.; Bhartṛ. 2, 97.  -- Comp. अ-, adv. without hard-ship, Vedāntas. in Chr. 219. 9.
11683: यत्र य + त्र (यद्), adv.  1. = loc. of यद्, Bhag. 8, 23.  2. Where, in what place.  3. Doubled, यत्रयत्र, Wher-ever, Hit. iii. d. 69.  4. Because, Nal. 12, 7.  5. That, Nal. 8, 17.  6. With following कुत्र, In whatever, Hit. iv. d. 84 (cf. v. r. in Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1225).  7. With following तत्र, Wherever, Chr. 8, 22.
11684: यत्रत्य यत्र + त्य, adj. Where being, whose, Mālat. 144, 17.
11685: यथा य + था (यद्), adv.  1. In which manner, like, as, Hit. pr. 38, M.M.; Chr. 8, 25; with following तद् एरम्, As -- just so, Vikr. 37, 7, 8.  2. With following तथा, In every way, Hit. ii. d. 138.  3. As truly as (a form of asse-veration), Chr. 7, 16 (literally: ‘As truly I love nobody but thee, so truly I touch my head,’ i. e. ‘As I touch my head, so I love nobody but thee’).  4. In order that, that, Chr. 12, 30.  5. It is used often as introduction to a direct sen-tence, Śāk. 7, 1, bel. ज्ञायते यथायम् आभोगस् तपोवनस्येति, ‘One perceives these are the environs of a forest of ascetics.’  6. Doubled, यथायथा, In what proportion, Man. 4, 20.  7. Very often it is the former part of comp. adv., of which the latter part has the form of an acc. sing. n.; they may be re-solved by supplying ‘is,’ and generally translated by ‘according to that which is implied by the latter part,’ e. g. यथा -काम + म्, literally, ‘as is desire,’ ‘ac-cording to one's wish,’ ‘at pleasure, ad libitum,’ Chr. 56, 17. यथा-यथ + म्, adv. Properly, suitably (ŚKD.).  -- Comp. तद्-, adv. namely, Pañc. 3, 10; 7, 15; for, Utt. Rāmac. 35, 17.
11686: यथाक्रमम् यथा-क्रम + म्, adv. In order, successively, Vikr. 66, 21.
11687: यथादिशम् यथा-दिश् + अ + म्, adv. In all directions, MBh. 5, 1753.
11688: यथाभीष्टदिशम् यथाभीष्टदि-शम्, i. e. यथा-अभि-इष्ट-दिश् + अ + म् (vb. इष्), adv. In whatever direction one lists, Pañc. 63, 2
11689: यथार्थाक्षर यथार्थाक्षर, i. e. यथा-अर्थ-अक्षर, adj. Of which the letters imply the true sense. Vikr. d. 1.
11690: यथावकाशम् यथावकाशम्, i. e. यथा-अवकाश + म्, adv. When there is any opportunity, Hit. 102, 11.
11691: यथार्हतस् यथार्हतस्, i. e. यथा -अर्ह + तस्, adv. Justly, Man. 7, 16.
11692: यथावत् यथा + वत्, adv.  1. Ex-actly as it was, truly, Chr. 63, 63.  2. According to law, Man. 2, 89.  3. Ac-cordingly, suitably, Nal. 6, 8.
11693: यथेच्छकम् यथेच्छकम्, i. e. यथा-इच्छ + क + म्, and यथेच्छम् यथेच्छम्, i. e. यथा-इच्छ + म् (cf. इच्छा), adv. As one lists, Pañc. 192, 13.
11694: यथेष्टतस् यथेष्टतस्, i. e. यथा इष्ट (vb. इष्), + तस्, adv. According to will or inclination, Hiḍ. 2, 13.
11695: यद् यद्,  I. Relative pronoun; the base of the cases and of most derivatives is य, Who, which, what, Chr. 5, 8.  II. Indefinite pronoun, Any, Chr. 23, 30.  III. Doubled.  1. In proportion, as each of which, Man. 1, 20.  2. Who-ever, whatever, Hit. pr. d. 34, M.M.  IV. With following interr. pronoun (किम्), Whoever, whatever. Pañc. i. d. 403.  V. Two and more relatives may be combined with one verb; e. g. यद् येन युज्यते, What is fitting for some-thing, Hit. i. d. 53, M.M.; यो ऽत्ति यस्य यदा मांसम्, When one eats the flesh of some (creature), Hit. i. d. 65, M.M.  VI. यद्, acc. sing. n., a particle.  1. As, since, because, Hit. pr. d. 8, M.M.; wherefore.  2. That, Hit. 41, 4, M.M.  3. It is often used as introduction to a direct sentence, Pañc. 175, 13. वदन्ति यद् अस्माकं राजा किं करिष्यति, ‘They say: what will the king do to us?’ 227, 7.  3. With following वा, Or, Rājat. 5, 441.  4. With following अपि, Although, Pañc. i. d. 7.  VII. येन, instr. sing. n., adv.  1. In what manner, Man. 4, 178.  2. Because, MBh. 3, 10631.  3. As, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1212.  4. That, Pañc. 84, 17.  VIII. यस्मात्, abl. sing. n., adv. Because, Hit. iv. d. 88; Chr. 16, 11. -- Cf. probably ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, ἵνα, εἵνε-κα (= येन); Goth. ja in jabai.
11696: यदा य + दा (यद्), adv.  1. When, at what time, Hit. 98, 18.  2. Doubled, Whenever, Bhag. 4, 7.  3. With fol-lowing कदा चिद् -- न, Nevermore, Hit. 58, 12.
11697: यदि यदि (probably यद् + य, cf. आदि, आद्य), adv. If, Pañc. 229, 13; with following अपि, Although, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2389; with following वा, Or, Pañc. iii. d. 108.
11698: यदु यदु, m.  1. The name of a king, Śiś. 9, 38.  2. The name of a country.  3. pl.  a. The name of a people.  b. The descendants of Yadu, Johns. Sel. 46, 73.
11699: यदृच्छा यद्-ऋच्छ् + आ (see vb. ऋ), f. Following one's own will or fancy; instr. °छया, Pañc. iii. d. 2 (with-out being stopped); by itself, MBh. 12, 6676; as one lists, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 20; by chance, accidentally, Vikr. d. 10; also यदृच्च-, as former part of a comp., by itself, Bhag. 4, 22; Utt. Rāmac. 127, 11 (-संवद, accidental meeting).
11700: यद्वत् यद् + वत्, adv. In what man-ner, as, Pañc. ii. d. 62.
11701: यन्तृ यन्तृ, i. e. यम् + तृ,  I. m., f. त्री, and n. A person or thing that restrains.  II. m. A charioteer, Man. 2, 88.  -- Comp. देह-, m. a charioteer, i. e. subduer, of (his) body, i. e. of his senses, Lass. 53, 11.
11702: यन्त्र् यन्त्र्, † i. 10 (properly a denomin. derived from यन्त्र), Par., and † i. 1, Par. To restrain. यन्त्रित,  1. Checked, restrained, Rām. 1, 40, 17.  2. Bound, fettered, MBh. 3, 33.  Comp. अ-, adj. one who does not govern his passions, Man. 2, 118. सु-, adj. 1. well governed. 2. one who governs his passions completely, Man. 2, 118. --With the prep. उप उप, उपयन्त्रित, Solicited, Man. 11, 177. -- With नि नि, नियन्त्रित,  1. Fastened, Utt. Rāmac. 106, 1.  2. Checked.  3. Squeezed, Śāk. 9, 20 (Prākṛ.).  4. Ruled, Vedāntas. in Chr. 209, 17.  5. Fettered, Pañc. 142, 14.  6. Embanked, Rājat. 5, 103. -- With सम् सम्, संगन्त्रिट, Stopped, Śāk. 100, 21.
11703: यन्त्र यन्त्र, i. e. यम् + त्र, n.  1. An engine or machine in general, any implement, or apparatus, Man. 7, 75; Johns. Sel. 39, 30; Rājat. 5, 104.  2. A thong, Man. 8, 292.  3. A sort of vessel, Hit. iii. d. 52.  4. A mystical diagram, Rāmatap. Up. 1, 13.  5. Restraining.  -- Comp. कोदण्ड-, n. a bow, Rājat. 5, 104. कूट-, n. a trap for deer, birds, etc. गृह-, n. an apparatus for raising flags on a house, Kumāras. 6, 41. घटिका- (thus to be corrected, Pañc. 212, 4), and घटी-, n. the rope and bucket of a well, Mārk. P. 12, 20. जल-, n. a machine for raising water, Hariv. 8425. ताल-, n. 1. a small pair of pincers, Suśr. 1, 23, 16. 2. a lock. तैल-, n. an oil mill, Bhāg. P. 5, 21, 13. तोय-, n. a clepsydra, Sūryas. 13, 21. धारा-, n. a water-spout, Prab. 79, 11. ध्रज-, n. an apparatus for planting the staff of a standard, Rām. 4, 13, 20. नाडी-, n. any tube-like apparatus, Suśr. 1, 23, 17. महा-, n. any great mechanical work, Man. 11, 63. सु-, adj. with machines, Hit. iii. d. 52. सूत्र-, n. 1. a loom. 2. a shuttle. स्त्री-, n. a woman who works like an artificial machine, Pañc. i. d. 204. स्व-माया-, adj. formed by his art, Kathās. 29, 18.
11704: यन्त्रक  1. यन्त्र् + अन, m. An artisan, Rām. 2, 80, 1.  2. यन्त्र + क, n. A lathe.  -- Comp. जल-, n. an engine, Hariv. 8432.
11705: यन्त्रण यन्त्रण, i. e. यन्त्र् + अन,  I. n.  1. Binding.  2. Restraining.  3. Confining.  II. f. णा।  1. Torturing, pain (ŚKD.), Mālav. 46, 3.  2. A means of fastening, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 5; Pañc. rec. orn. MS. Berol. 81, a., and Weber, Ind. St. iii. 372, 4, below (read यन्त्रणया instead of यन्त्रया).  -- Comp. निर्यन्त्रण, i. e. निस्-, adj. unrestrained, unobstructed, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 408. °नम्, adv., Ṛt. 1, 9. मुख-, n. the bit of a bridle.
11706: † यभ् यभ्, जभ् जभ्, जम्भ् जम्भ्, i. 1, Par. To lie with.
11707: यम् यम् (akin to दम्), i. 1, यच्छ, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 1, 5704).  1. To tame, to restrain.  2. To govern (as horses), MBh. 3, 751.  3. To give, Man. 2, 55. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. यत, Restrained, governed, Hit. iii. d. 130; in epic poetry also यत्त, MBh. 2, 2011 (main-tained by the metre).  Comp. वाग्यत, i. e. वाच्-, adj. silent, taciturn, Man. 3, 236. Caus., and i. 10, या̆मय।  1. To restrain.  2. † To give food. Ptcple. pf. pass. यमित, Restrained, Śāk. d. 29.  Comp. अ-, adj. not pared (as nails), Megh. 89. -- With the prep. अधि अधि, To give, Chr. 292, 12 = Rigv. i. 85, 12. -- With आ आ,  1. To stop, Bhaṭṭ. 6, 119.  2. To suppress, Man. 11, 149.  3. To draw, to bend (as a bow), Rām. 3, 50, 9; Johns. Sel. 50, 101.  4. Ātm. To extend, Śāk. 73, 4, C.  5. Ātm. To possess, Bhaṭṭ. 8, 46. आयत, Long, Pañc. ii. 8.  Comp. पूर्ण-आयत, adj. completely drawn (as a bow), Hariv. 13413. Comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass. अन्-आयम्य, Not to be drawn, unpliant, MBh. 1, 6953. -- With निरा निस्-आ, निरायत, Contracted, Śāk. d. 8. -- With व्या वि-आ,  1. Ātm. To exert one's power, MBh. 3, 12740.  2. To fight, Mṛcch. 202, 7; Ātm., Bhaṭṭ. 6, 119.  3. To open wide one's eyes, Johns. Sel. 47. 76. व्यायत, Long.  2. Excessive.  3. Busy.  4. Hard, firm. Caus. यामय, To use exercise, Man. 7, 216. -- With उद् उद्,  1. To rise, Hit. 81, 4 (with infin., in order to kill).  2. To lift up, Man. 4, 64.  3. To brandish, Man. 5, 58.  4. To govern (as horses), Chr. 36, 19.  5. To offer, MBh. 1, 1853.  6. To en-deavour, MBh. 2, 2357.  7. To study. उद्यत,  1. Raised, Chr. 3, 1.  2. Ready, Hit. 41, 4, M.M.  3. P. 8, 10, 26.
11864: योनि योनि, i. e. यु + नि, m. f., and नी, f.  1. The vulva, Suśr. 2, 397, 10; the womb, Pañc. 188, 5; 6.  2. Place of birth, Hit. iv. d. 68.  3. Origin, Man. 2, 25.  4. A mine.  5. 11869: योषिता योषित् + आ, f. A woman.

11871: यौगक यौगक, i. e. योग + क, adj. Relating to the religious practice called योग (see s.v. योग,  19.)

11874: यौगिक यौगिक, i. e. योग + इक, adj.  1. Usual.  2. Proper.  3. Relating to the religious practice called योग (see s.v. योग,  19.).
11875: † यौट् यौट्, यौड् यौड्, i. 1, Par. To join (i. e. जोस्-धा, see यु, and cf. Zend. यओज़्ह्दा and supra मृड्).
11876: यौतक यौतक, i. e. युतक + अ, n.  1. Appropriating, Man. 9, 214.  2. Pro-perty, Man. 9, 131 (a nuptial gift, presents made to a bride by her father or friends.).
11877: यौधिष्ठिर यौधिष्ठिर, i. e. यु-धिष्ठिर + अ, adj. Belonging to Yu-dhiṣṭhira, Johns. Sel. 96, 77.

11880: यौवनवन्त् यौवन + वन्त्, adj., f. वति,  I. Youthful, Hit. 63, 2, M.M.  II. and यौवनस्थ यौवन-स्थ, f. था, Marriageable, Lass. 23, 15; Pañc. 183, 25.

11882: यौष्माक यौष्माक, and यौष्माकीन यौष्माकिन, i. e. युष्मद् + क + अ, or इन, adj. Yours.
11883: 1. रंह् रंह् (akin to लङ्घ्, q. cf.), i. 1, Par. and † i. 10, Par. To go, to move, with speed. Caus. To impel to speed, Chr. 291, 5 = Rigv. i. 85, 5. --Cf. perhaps τρέχω; Goth. thragjan; in this case the Sskr. word has dropped the initial.
11884: 2. † रंह् रंह्, वंह् वंह्, i. 10, Par. To speak, to shine.
11885: रंहस् 1. रंह् + अस्, n. Speed, velo-city, Ragh. 2, 34 (Calc.).  -- Comp. अति-, adj. of excessive velocity, Śāk. d. 5. वात-, adj. swift as the wind, Indr. 1, 7.
11886: † रक् {†रक्,} लक् लक्, रग् रग्, लग् लग्, रघ् रघ्, i. 10, Par.  1. To taste.  2. To obtain.
11887: रक्क रक्क, m. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 423.
11888: रक्तक रक्त + क (see रङ्ज्), m.  1. Red garments, or cloth.  2. A man affected with fondness or passion.  3. A player.  4. The name of several plants.
11889: रक्तप रक्त-प (1. पा, cf. रञ्ज्।),  I. adj. Who or what drinks blood.  II. m. A Rākṣasa, or demon.  III. f. पा।  1. A leech.  2. A female fiend.
11890: रक्तपायिन् रक्त-पायिन् (vb. रङ्ज्।),  I. m. A bug.  II. f. नी, A leech.
11891: रक्तफेनज रक्त-फेन-ज, m. A part of the body, apparently intending the lungs.

To keep off, Rām. 1, 32, 2. -- Cf. pro-bably ἀρκέω, ἀλκτήρ, ἀλαλκτήρ (fre-quent.), ἄλξις, ἀλέξω; Lat. arx; Goth. ga-rehsns.
11893: रक्ष रक्ष् + अ,  I. m. One who guards, Lass. 34, 8.  II. m., and f. क्षा।  1. Preserving, guarding, Pañc. 184, 8; protecting, protection, Pañc. 157, 7.  2. 11894: रक्षक रक्ष् + अक,  I. adj. Who or what protects, who tends, Man. 8, 102.  II. m. 11895: रक्षण रक्षण, i. e. रक्ष् + अन, n. Preserving, protecting, Hit. 114, 7; Pañc. iv. d. 29.

11898: रक्षिक रक्षिक, i. e. रक्ष + इक (adj. or m.?), A watchman, a police-man, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 18; 199, 24.

11901: रक्ष्ण रक्ष्ण, i. e. रक्ष् + न, m. Protection.
11902: † रख् रख्, रङ्ख् रङ्ख्, रिख् रिख्, रिङ्ख् रिङ्ख्, i. 1, Par. To go, to move.

11907: रघुष्यद् रघुष्यद्, i. e. रघु -स्यन्द्, adj. Moving quickly, Chr. 290, 7 = Rigv. i. 64, 7.
11908: रङ्क रङ्क, adj.  1. Niggardly.  2. Slow.  3. Indigent, poor a beggar, Pañc. i. d. 12; 284.  -- Comp. रण-, m. the part of an elephant's face between his tusks.
11909: रङ्कु रङ्कु, m. A sort of deer, the spotted axis.
11911: † रङ्ग् रङ्ग्, रिङ्ग् रिङ्ग्, i. 1, Par. To go, to move.
11912: रङ्ग रङ्ग, i. e. रञ्ज् + अ,  I. m.  1. Colour, paint.  2. 11915: रङ्घ् रङ्घ्, i. 1, Ātm. To go, to move swiftly (cf. लङ्घ्), Bhaṭṭ. 14, 15. † i. 10, To speak, to shine.
11916: रच् रच्, i. 10, रचय, Par.  1. To make mechanically, Megh. 75.  2. 11918: रज रज (see रजस्), m.  1. Dust, Hit. i. d. 152, M.M.  2. The pollen of flowers.  3. The menstrual excretion.  4. The quality of passion.  -- Comp. नी-रज, i. e. निस्-, adj. 1. free from dust, MBh. 13, 3822. 2. free from passion, epithet of Śiva, ib. 13, 1261.

11925: रजनीकर रजनीकर, and रजनीचर रजनीचर, see s.v. रजनि°।
11926: रजस् रजस्,  I. i. e. रञ्ज् + अस्, n. (the original signification was probably ‘Dimness;’ cf. रजनि and Goth. riquis).  1. Sky, Chr. 289, 7 = Rigv. i. 50, 7.  2. Dust, Man. 11, 110.  3. To colour, Pañc. 132, 24.  2. To illuminate, Vikr. d. 60; MBh. 1, 6772.  3. To cause to be attached, to conciliate, Pañc. 113, 24; Man. 7, 19.  4. † To worship.  II. † रजय, To hunt. -- With the prep. अनु अनु, i. 4,  1. To grow red and fond, Śiś. 9, 7.  2. To be attached, Bhag. 11, 36; Pañc. i. d. 335.  3. To love, Rām. 3, 55, 15.  4. To dally lasciviously with, Man. 3, 173. अनु-रक्त,  1. Fond, attached, Pañc. 32, 9; loving, Vikr. 59, 21; propitious, Hit. 53, 18.  2. Pleased. Caus.  1. To cause to be in love, to inspire with affection, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 22.  2. To con-ciliate, to win, Daśak. 196, 17. -- With अप अप, अपरक्त (rather रक्त with अप), Discoloured, blanched, Śāk. d. 133. -- With अभि अभि, i. 4, To be re-joiced, Rām. 2, 67, 13. Caus. To colour, to illuminate, Rām. 1, 38, 21. -- With उप उप, उपरक्त,  1. Eclipsed, Rām. 1, 55, 9.  2. Afflicted with pain or calamity. m. Rāhu. -- With वि वि, i. 4, To grow discoloured (viz. the hair), and disinclined (viz. the servants), Pañc. i. d. 94.  2. To grow alienated, Mṛcch. 23, 5. विरक्त,  1. Disin-clined, Bhartṛ. 2, 2.  2. Free from worldly passion, Pañc. 33, 16.  3. Impassioned.  Comp. अ-विरक्त, adj. faithful, Hit. iii. d. 87. -- With सम् सम्, i. 4, To grow red, MBh. 1, 6443. संरक्त,  1. Red, MBh. 5, 273.  2. Inflamed.  3. Impassioned. -- With अनुसम् अनु-सम्, अनुसंरक्त, At-tached, loving, with acc., Rām. 1, 17, 16. -- Cf. ῥέζω, ῥέγος, ῥεγεύς, ῥήσσω, ῥῆγος, λέγνον; probably A.S. ge-reg-nian, to colour.
11935: रञ्जक रञ्ज् + अक,  I. m.  1. A dyer, Man. 4, 216.  2. A stimulus, an in-citer of affection.  II. n. Red sandal.

12118: रिष्टि रिष्टि,  I. f. m. A sword (cf. ऋष्टि).  II. रिष् + ति, f. Bad luck.

12121: 1. री री, ii. 9, रिणा, रिणी। Par.  1. To go.  2. To howl.  3. To hart.

12126: † रीव् रीव्, i. 1, Par. Ātm. To take.

12128: † 2. रु रु, i. 1, Ātm.  1. To go.  2. To hurt, or to be angry (?).  3. To speak.

12132: रुक्ष and रूक्ष रू̆क्ष, adj.  1. Rugged, rough, difficult, Vikr. d. 61 (र्ŭ).  2. Harsh, unkind, Pañc. iv. d. 62 (रू°); uncouth, Pañc. v. d. 6 (र्ŭ°, but cf. Böhtl. Ind. 12133: रुक्ष्म रुक्ष्म, Hard, fleshless (?), Rājat. 5, 433 (? perhaps to be changed to रुक्ष).
12134: रुग्नता रुग्न + ता (cf. रुज्), f.  1. Sickness.  2. Crookedness.

Caus.  I. रोहय, To order to descend, Ragh. 1, 54.  II. रोपय,  1. To take down, MBh. 4, 1318.  2. To root up, Johns. Sel. 53, 123.  3. To diminish, Man. 1, 82.  4. Ātm. To ascend to (with acc., MBh. 3, 1727. अङ्कम् आरुह्य, Having climbed into one's lap, Hit. ii. d. 166.  3. With संशयम्, To doubt, Hit. i. d. 6.  4. Absel. आरुह्य, Having encountered, Hit. i. d. 5, M.M.  3. To put upon, Pañc. 41, 15.  4. To draw (a bow), Utt. Rāmac. 118, 1.  5. To take to, Man. 3, 17.  6. Rāmac. 147, 14. -- With अध्या अधि-आ, To mount, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 16. Caus. रोपय,  1. To cause to ascend, Rām. 2, 55, 15.  2. To elevate, Pañc. 24, 9. -- With अन्वा अनु-आ, To ascend after, MBh. 2, 36. -- With समन्वा सम्-अनु-आ। The same, MBh. 1, 2818. -- With उपा उप-आ,  1. To ascend, MBh. 2, 37.  2. To obtain, Ragh. 17, 30 (Calc.). -- With प्रा प्र-आ, To as-cend. MBh. 3, 10594. -- With प्रत्या प्रति -आ, Caus. To cause to remount, Utt. Rāmac. 133, 4. -- With समा सम्-आ,  1. To mount on, Pañc. 115, 3; Chr. 45, 12.  2. To engage, Prab. 116, 9. समा-रूढ, Mounted, Pañc. 48, 10. Caus. रोपय,  1. To cause to mount, Pañc. 44, 16; to lift up, 52, 2.  2. To deposit, Man. 6, 38. -- With उप उप, उपरूढ, Undergone, Mālav. 31, 13. -- With प्र प्र,  1. To shoot up, Pañc. iii. d. 55.  2. To grow, Man. 9, 14.  3. To heal, Pañc. iii. d. 112. प्ररूढ,  1. V. f. नी, Red arsenic, Pāṇ. iv. 2, 2.  VI. n. The æther, Chr. 288, 1 = Rigv. i. 49, 1.  -- Comp. गो-रोचना, f. a yellow pig-ment, Pañc. i. d. 107 =  III. योग-रो-चना, f. a magical रोचना, or un-guent, which makes invisible and invulnerable, Mṛcch. 47, 22 -- 24. वंश-रोच् हना, f. Bambu manna.
12224: रोचिष्णु रोचिष्णु, i. e. रुच् + इष्णु, adj. Elegantly dressed, Paṇ. iii. 2, 136.
12225: रोचिस् रोचिस्, i. e. रुच् + इस्, n. Light, flame.  -- Comp. वसु-, n. a re-ligious ceremony in which the Vasus especially are worshipped.
12226: † रोड् रोड् (cf. रुष्), i. 1, Par.  1. To be mad.  2. and रौट् रौट्, रौड् रौड्, i. 1, Par. To despise.
12227: रोदन रोदन, i. e. रुद् + अन, n.  1. Weeping, Lass. 30, 7.  2. A tear, tears.
12228: रोदस् रोदस्, i. e. रुद् + अस् (the seat of the roaring storm), n. Heaven. du. सी, and as former part of a comp. Heaven and earth, Vikr. d. 1; Chr. 46, 23; Nal. 3, 32.
12229: रोध रोध, i. e. रुध् + अ, m.  1. Ob-struction, Kir. 5, 15.  2. A bank, a shore.  -- Comp. प्राण-, m. danger of life, Hit. iv. d. 23 (but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3136).
12230: रोधन रोधन, i. e. रुध् + अन,  I. adj. That which obstructs.  II. m. The planet Mercury.  III. n.  1. Obstructing.  2. Besieging.
12231: रोधस् रोधस्, i. e. रुध् + अस्, n.  1. A bank, a shore, Vikr. d. 8.  2. The brink of a well, Bhāg. P. 9, 19, 4.  3. The flank, Bhāg. P. 3, 20, 29.
12232: ऽरोधिन् -रोधिन्, i. e. रुध् + इन्, adj. Stopping, Rājat. 5, 346; Śāk. d. 135.
12233: रोध्र रोध्र, i. e.  I. रुध् + र, n.  1. Sin.  2. Offence.  II. Probably akin to रुधिर, m. A tree, the bark of which is used in dyeing, Ragh. 2, 29.
12235: रोप रोप,  I. m. probably रुह्, Caus., + अ, An arrow.  II. i. e. रुप् = लुप् + अ, Confusing.  III. n. A hole.
12236: रोपण रोपण, n.  I. i. e. रुह्, Caus., + अन।  1. Planting.  2. Raising.  3. Placing.  4. Cicatrizing.  5. A healing application to sores.  II. i. e. रुप् = लुप् + अन, Confusing.
12237: रोपणाका रोपणाका, f. A bird, Tur-dus salica, Chr. 289, 12 = Rigv. i. 50, 12.
12239: रोमन् रोमन्, i. e. रुह् + मन्, n. The hair of the body, Pañc. iii. d. 186.  -- Comp. ऊर्ध्व-,  I. adj. one whose hairs are erect, Bhāg. P. 6, 1, 28.  II. m. the name of a mountain, ib. 5, 20, 15. काञ्चन-, and सुवर्ण-, adj. having gold-like wool, Rām. 3, 49, 4; (Pañc. 35, 1, i. e. a ram). स्तब्ध- (vb. स्तम्भ्), m. a hog.
12240: रोमन्थ रोमन्थ, probably a noun derived from रुज्, and compounded with मन्थ् + अ, m.  1. Ruminating, Śāk. d. 39.  2. Chewing, Rājat. 5, 364. -- Cf. O.H.G. ita-rucjan; A.S. roccettan; Lat. rūmen, ruminare (for rug-men), ructare; ἐρεύγομαι (old frequent.), ἐρυγγάνω, ὀρυγγάνω, etc.
12241: रोमन्थाय रोमन्थाय, a denomin. derived from रोमन्थ with य, Ātm. To ruminate, Pāṇ. iii. 1, 15.
12242: रोमवन्त् रोमवन्त्, i. e. रोमन् + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Hairy, woolly.
12243: रोमश रोमश, i. e. रोमन् + श,  I. adj.  1. Hairy, Man. 3, 7.  2. Woolly.  II. m.  1. A ram.  2. A hog.
12244: रोमाञ्च रोमाञ्च, i. e. रोमन्-अञ्च् + अ, m. Horripilation, considered as a sign of rapture, Pañc. ii. d. 175.
12245: रोमाञ्चित रोमाञ्चित, i. e. रोमाञ्-च + इत, adj.  1. Affected with hor-ripilation, Utt. Rāmac. 81, 4.  2. En-raptured, Pañc. 128, 21.
12246: रोष रोष, i. e. रोष् + अ, m. Anger, wrath, Vikr. d. 144; Pañc. 174. 25.  -- Comp. वि-, adj. angry, Draup. 9, 6. स-, adj. angry, Śiś. 9, 83. षम्, adv. angrily, Vikr. 55, 7.
12247: रोषण रोषण, i. e. रुष् + अन,  I. adj. Angry.  II. m.  1. Quicksilver.  2. A touchstone.
12248: रोषणता रोषण + ता, f. Wrath, Śāk. d. 93.
12249: रोह रोह, i. e. रुह् + अ, m.  1. A bud.  2. Mounting, Rājat. 5, 15.
12250: रोहक रोहक, i. e. रुह् + अक,  I. adj. Riding, mounted on any vehicle.  II. m. A sort of goblin.
12251: रोहण रोहण, i. e. रुह् + अन,  I. m. A mountain, Adam's peak in Ceylon, Pañc. MS. Berol., cf. Wilson in Trans. of the R.A.S. i. 169.  II. n.  1. Grow-ing.  2. Mountaing.  3. Semen virile.
12252: रोहिण रोहिण, i. e. रुह् + इन् + अ,  I. m.  1. The Indian fig-tree.  2. A fragrant grass.  II. n. A part of the forenoon. See रोहित।
12253: रोहित् रोहित्, probably akin to रु-धिर, ह् for ध्,  I. m. The sun.  II. f. The female of the black antelope.
12254: रोहित रोहित, akin to रुधिर, ह् for ध्,  I. adj., f. ता and इणी।  1. Red.  2. Coloured, Man. 1, 38.  II. m.  1. Red, the colour.  2. A (kind of) deer, Utt. Rāmac. 117, 4.  3. A fish, Cypri-nas rohita, Man. 5, 16.  III. f. इणी, also रोहिणि रोहिणि।  1. The fourth lunar asterism, Vikr. 38, 12 (णी).  2. The mother of बल-राम।  IV. f. इणी।  1. Lightning.  2. A girl at the commence-ment of the menstruation, Pañc. iii. d. 213.  3. A woman stained with red pigments.  4. Inflammatory affection of the throat.  5. A cow.  6. Yellow myrobalan.  7. Bengal madder.  V. n.  1. Blood.  2. Safflower.  3. The rain-bow appearing in a straight form.
12255: रोहिन् रोहिन्,  I. रुह् + इन्, m.  1. The Indian fig-tree.  2. The holy fig-tree.  II. (cf. रोकित्।) A stag, Rām. 5, 36, 35 (but perhaps is to be read रोहिन् -मांसम्, i. e. रोहित्-).
12256: रौक्म रौक्म, i. e. रुक्म + अ, adj. Golden, Man. 4, 36.
12257: रौक्ष्य रौक्ष्य, i. e. रू̆क्ष + य, n. Roughness, hardness, Ragh. 5, 58.
12258: रौचनिक रौचनिक, i. e. रोचना + इक, adj., f. की, Yellowish, Kir. 5, 45 (cf. also Pāṇ. 4, 2, 2 Sch.).
12259: रौच्य रौच्य, m. An ascetic with a staff of Vilva wood.
12260: रौट् रौट्, रौड् रौड्, see रोड्।
12261: रौद्र रौद्र, i. e. रुद्र + अ,  I. adj., f. द्री।  1. Relating to Rudra-Śiva, Arj. 3, 50; cf. 10, 42; descended from Rudra, Johns. Sel. 22, 117.  2. Formidable, Pañc. i. d. 116.  3. Irascible.  4. Acute.  II. m. Heat.  III. f. री, The wife of Śiva.  -- Comp. अति-, adj. exceedingly terrible, Pañc. 216, 9. सोम-, the name of a holy text (perhaps Rigv. vi. 74), Man. 11, 254.
12262: रौद्रता रौद्र + ता, f. Horribleness, Mālat. 77, 7.
12263: रौद्रीभाव रौद्रीभाव, i. e. रौद्र -भू + अ, m. The character of Śiva, Johns. Sel. 93, 47.
12264: रौप्य रौप्य, i. e. रूप्य + अ,  I. adj.  1. Of silver, Man. 8, 135.  2. Like silver, Rām. 3, 48, 12.  II. n. Silver, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 14.
12265: रौप्यमय रौप्य + मय, adj., f. यी, Made of silver, Rājat. 5, 46.
12266: रौम रौम, and रौमक रौम + क, n. A sort of salt (cf. रुमन्वन्त्).
12267: रौरव रौरव,  I. i. e. रुरु + अ, adj., f. वी।  1. Proceeding from the common deer (viz. flesh, etc.), Man. 2, 41; 3, 269; Utt. Rāmac. 105, 11.  2. Un-steady.  II. adj.  1. Formidable.  2. Dishonest.  III. m.  1. The name of a hell, Man. 4, 88.  2. A savage.  -- Comp. महा-, m. the name of a hell, Man. 4, 88.
12268: रौहिण रौहिण (cf. रोहित), n. Sandal wood, MBh. 1, 1381.
12269: रौहिष रौहिष (cf. रोहित्),  I. m. A sort of deer.  II. f. षी।  1. A doe.  2. A creeper.
12271: लक्तक लक्तक, n.  1. A rag, or rags.  2. i. e. = रक्त + क (vb. रञ्ज्), Lac, the animal dye.
12272: लक्ष् लक्ष् i. 10 (probably a de-nomin. derived from लक्ष), Par. and Ātm.  1. To mark, MBh. 3, 14852.  2. To see, Vikr. d. 8; to perceive, Śāk. 16, 20. Pass. To appear, Vikr. d. 53; MBh. 3, 2110. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. लक्षित, Perceived, evident, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 13.  Comp. अ-, adj. unobserved, Hit. 65, 10, M.M. सु-लक्षित, adj. well-ascertained, Man. 8, 403. Ptcple. of the fut. pass. लक्ष्य।  1. To be seen, visible, Vikr. d. 37; Daśak. in Chr. 198, 24.  2. Deserving to be re-garded, Hit. iv. d. 14.  3. To be de-fined or described, Vedāntas. in Chr. 210, 10.  4. Having attributes at-tached, Vedāntas. in Chr. 212, 14; 23. n.  1. A mark.  2. A butt.  3. Aim, Utt. Rāmac. 124, 8 (बद्ध, vb. बन्ध्, adj. Having taken his aim); Megh. 72 ( कामिन्-, Aim, represented by lovers).  4. Object, Vedāntas. in Chr. 205, 22.  5. A Lac, a hundred thousand, Hit. ii. d. 36.  Comp. अ-, adj. 1. invisible, Kathās. 24, 8. 2. undistinguishable, unimportant, Kumāras. 5, 72. अभि-लक्-ष्य + म्, adv. to the aim, Rām. 2, 63, 22. दुर्ल्°, i. e. दुस्-, adj. difficult to be perceived, Bhāg. P. 7, 10, 53. यूप-, m. a bird. स्थूल-, adj. 1. = स्थूल-लक्-ष (see लक्ष). 2. aiming carelessly. Caus.  1. To cause to be seen, to perform, to settle, Chr. 20, 17.  2. To signify, Vedāntas. in Chr. 204, 17. -- With the prep. अभि अभि, अभिलक्षित, Marked.  -- With आ आ,  1. To see, to perceive, MBh. 2, 2403.  2. To view, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 12. Pass. To appear, Śāk. d. 133. आलक्ष्य, Śāk. d. 176, is लक्-ष्य with आ, adj. Hardly visible. -- With समा सम्-आ,  1. To direct one's look to, Lass. 2. ed. 66, 17.  2. To see, MBh. 1, 5249. -- With उप उप,  1. To see, to perceive, Vikr. 78, 21; MBh. 3, 2186.  2. To suspect, Śāk. 15, 15.  3. To con-sider, MBh. 3, 12188.  4. Pass. To be probable, Rām. 2, 61, 11. उपलक्षित, Comprehended, understood.  Comp. अन्-, adj. not perceived, Daśak. in Chr. 190, 15. -- With समुप सम्-उप। To see, to perceive, MBh. 2, 1557. -- With निस् निस्; निर्लक्ष्य, Kathās. 6, 119, is लक्-ष्य with निस्, adj. Imperceivable. --With वि वि, To perceive, Gīt. 2, 19; to see, Pañc. 235, 25. विलक्षित,  1. Seen.  2. Affected without a cause.  3. Dis-appointed, Utt. Rāmac. 148, 13; Johns. Sel. 52, 115 (rival).  4. Unmarked (i. e. लक्षित with वि, adj.). -- With सम् सम्,  1. To perceive, MBh. 3, 16751.  2. Pass. To appear, Vikr. d. 157. संलक्षित, Distinguished. संलक्ष्य, To be marked.  -- Comp. दुःस्°, i.e. दुस्-, adj. difficult to be perceived, Rājat. 6, 64.
12273: लक्ष लक्ष, probably from रङ्ज्, and for original रक्त,  I. n.  1. A mark, MBh. 3, 14852; Caurap. 15.  2. Aim, Ragh. 1, 61; Vikr. 54, 4 (? look, perhaps corr. °लक्-षणः).  3. Disguise, fraud.  II. m., and f. क्षा, and n. (Pañc. 255, 23), A Lac, a hundred thousand, Pañc. 255, 23.  -- Comp. वि-, adj. 1. unmarked. 2. having no characteristic property. 3. having a mark or character contrary to what is usual. 4. surprised. 5. (one who has missed his aim), ashamed, abashed, Pañc. 29, 15; embarrassed, Pañc. 147, 4. 6. with कृ, becoming विलक्षी कृ, to scoff, to insult, Kathās. 6, 126. स्थूल-, adj. 1. liberal, Indr. 4, 11. 2. wise. 3. remembering both benefits and offences.
12274: लक्षण लक्षण, i. e. लक्ष् + अन,  I. n.  1. Seeing, sight.  2. A character-istic mark, Pañc. iii. d. 130; Bhartṛ. 2, 70; a spot.  3. A holy mark, Hit. 99, 7; a lucky mark, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 11.  4. Form, Bhāg. P. 5, 20, 38.  5. A name, Pañc. iii. d. 35 (read यात्रालक्षणम्, called यात्रा).  6. An indication, a definition, Man. 1, 112.  7. Settlement, 8, 406.  8. A symptom of actual disease.  II. m.  1. The In-dian crane.  2. A proper name.  III. f. ना।  1. Metonymy, as distinguished from a word's literal meaning, Vedāntas. in Chr. 212, 16; Bhāṣāp. 81. Cf. सा-हित्य, Darp. ii.  2. The female of the Indian crane.  3. A goose.  -- Comp. अ-,  I. n. a mark of ill fortune, Man. 4, 156.  II. adj., f. णा, 1. without distinguishing marks, Man. 1, 5. 2. inauspicious, Ragh. 14, 5. अजहल्लक्षणा, i. e. अ-जहत्- (vb. 2. हा), f. using a word in an elliptic meaning, without depriving it of its original signification; e. g. शोण, adj. ‘of a chesnut colour,’ in the sense of ‘a horse of a chesnut colour,’ Vedāntas. in Chr. 214, 11. कृत-, adj. brandished, Man. 9, 239. ऋग्यजुःसामलक्षण, i. e. ऋच्-यजुस्-सामन्-, adj. named Ṛc, Yājus, and Sāman, Man. 1, 23. ज्ञान-, adj., f. णा, one of the three transcen-dental perceptions, Bhāṣāp. 62, cf. 64. द्वि-, adj. of two kinds, Man. 7, 163. निर्लक्षण, i. e. निस्-, adj. not distin-guished, unimportant, Rām. 2, 113, 5 Gorr. राजलक्षण, i. e. राजन्-, n. 1. royal insignia. 2. any natural mark indicating royalty. लक्षित-, adj., f. णा, in which are evident the marks (of a town), Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 13. वि-, see s. v. विशेष-, n. characteristic mark or sign. सामान्य-, f. णा, one of the three transcendental perceptions, Bhāṣāp. 62, 63. सु-,  I. adj. having auspicious marks, Rām. 3, 49, 57.  II. n. determining.  III. f. णा, a proper name.
12275: लक्षता लक्ष + ता, f. Condition of being the aim, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 24.
12276: लक्षितत्व लक्षित + त्व (vb. लक्ष्, n. Condition of being hinted at, of being supplied, Vedāntas. in Chr. 214, 15.
12277: लक्ष्मण लक्ष्मण, i. e. लक्ष्मन् + अ,  I. m.  1. The son of Daśaratha by Su-mitrā, Rām. 3, 50, 24.  2. The Indian crane, Arj. 9, 21.  II. f. णा, The female of the Indian crane.  III. n.  1. A mark, a spot, Śiś. 9, 31 (and at the same time Lakṣmaṇa).  Comp. सह-, adj. with Lakṣmaṇa, Rām. 3, 52, 2.  2. A name.
12278: लक्ष्मन् लक्ष् + मन्, n.  1. A mark, Ragh. 19, 30; a spot, Śāk. d. 19.  2. Chief.
12279: लक्ष्मी लक्ष्मी, i. e. लक्ष्म (i. e. cur-tailed लक्ष्मन्), + ई, f. (nom. sing. मीस्).  1. The wife of Viṣṇu, and goddess of prosperity, Rām. 3, 52, 26; Hit. pr. d. 31, M.M.  2. Prosperity, Bhartṛ. 2, 54.  3. Wealth, Bhartṛ. 2, 14; Rājat. 5, 18.  4. Beauty, splendour, Kir. 5, 39; Vikr. d. 23; Śāk. d. 19.  5. Royal power, Pañc. iii. d. 32; do-minion, Rājat. 5, 136.  6. A pearl.  -- Comp. अ-, f. bad luck, Rām. 3, 72, 25. अ-कृश-, adj., n. मि (nom. sing. m., f. मीस्), endowed with great prosperity, Kir. 5, 52. जय-, f. 1. 12280: ऽलक्ष्मीक -लक्ष्मी + क, at the end of comp. adj.; e. g. पुत्र-सम्-क्रान्त-, Having transferred the royal power to (their) sons, Utt. Rāmac. 14, 15.
12281: लक्ष्मीवन्त् लक्ष्मी + वन्त्, adj., f. वती,  1. Fortunate.  2. Wealthy.
12282: लक्ष्यता लक्ष्य + ता (see लक्ष्), f. Visibility, Rājat. 5, 321.
12283: † लख् लख्, लङ्ख् लङ्ख्, लिङ्ख् लिङ्ख्, i. 1, Par. To go, to move.
12284: 1. लग् लग्, i. 1, Par.  1. To adhere, Pañc. i. d. 340.  2. To attach one's self, Pañc. 245, 6.  3. To stick (in the throat), Śiś. 9, 69.  4. To pass away, to expire, Pañc. 185, 19. 12287: लगुड लगुड, m.  1. A stick, a staff, Hit. 51, 6, M.M.  2. An iron club, a club, Hit. 101, 12.

12428: लिङ्गालिका लिङ्गालिका, f. A small mouse or shrew.
