12430: लिप् लिप्, i. 6, लिम्प, Par. Ātm.  1. To anoint, Bhaṭṭ. 14, 94.  2. To smear, Hit. 21, 14.  3. To stain (लिप्यते दोषेण, Incurs sin), Hit. ii. d. 118; to pollute, Man. 4, 201; 10, 104.  4. To burn, Bhaṭṭ. 6, 22. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. लिप्त।  1. Envenomed.  2. Em-braced.  3. Defiled.  Comp. अ-मेध्य -लिप्त, adj. defiled (soiled with impu-rity), Man. 4, 56. Caus. To cause to be decorated, Rām. 2, 9, 40. -- With the prep. अनु अनु,  1. To anoint, Daśak. in Chr. 183, 6.  2. To smear, Śiś. 9, 15. अनुलिप्त,  1. Smeared, Pañc. iii. d. 32.  2. Anointed, Hit. 90, 8, M.M.; glisten-ing, Śāk. d. 166. Caus. To cause to be anointed, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 7. -- With अव अव, To smear, Lass. 9, 19. अवलिप्त, Proud, arrogant, Man. 4, 79; Pañc. i. d. 341. -- With आ आ,  1. To anoint, Utt. Rāmac. 79, 1; Ṛt. 6, 12, v. r.  2. To smear, Pañc. 171, 11. -- With समा सम्-आ, To anoint, Bhaṭṭ. 17, 5. -- With उप उप, To pollute, MBh. 2, 2625; Bhag. 13, 32. Caus. To let smear, Man. 3, 206.  -- With वि वि,  1. To anoint, Bhaṭṭ. 3, 20.  2. To smear, Lass. 9, 12.  3. To pol-lute, Hit. 128, 12. -- With सम् सम्, To anoint, MBh. 1, 4950. -- Cf. λίπος, λιπαρής, ἀ-λείϕω, λισσός; Lat. limpidus, lip-pus; probably also liquidus, liquere, and O.H.G. salba, Goth. salbôn, A.S. sealf.
12431: लिपि and लिपी लिप् + ई̆, f.  1. Anointing, smearing.  2. Painting.  3. Writing, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 7; the alphabet, Ragh. 18, 45.  4. A written paper or book.
12432: लिपिकर and लिपिकार लिपि-कार, m.  1. A scribe.  2. -कर, A plasterer, whitener, Rām. 1, 12, 6 Gorr.
12433: लिप्तक लिप्त + क (vb. लिप्), m.  A poisoned arrow.
12434: लिप्सा लिप्सा, i. e. लिप्स, desider. of लभ्, + अ, f. Wish.
12435: लिप्सु लिप्सु, i.e. लिप्स (see the last), + उ, adj. Desirous, greedy, Pañc. 5, 4.
12436: लिम्पट लिम्पट (vb. लिप्, but cf. also लम्पट), m. A lecher.
12437: लिम्पाक लिम्पाक, m.  1. The lime tree, Citrus acida.  2. An ass.
12438: लिश् लिश्, i. 4, Ātm. To become small. † i. 6, Par. To go. -- Cf. क्लिश् and कृश्; ὀλίγος, perhaps λίγδος.
12439: लिह् लिह्, ii. 2, Par. Ātm. To lick, Hit. i. d. 112, M.M. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. लीढ।  1. Licked, Kir. 5, 38.  2. Eaten. Ptcple. of the fut. pass. लेह्य, To be licked, Pañc. 61, 12. n. A name of Śiva. -- With the prep. अव अव,  1. To lick here and there (figurat.), Lass. 2. ed. 79, 79.  2. To lick up or off; to eat, Śāk. d. 7.  3. To touch with the tongue, Man. 4, 203. अवलीढ, Devoured, destroyed, Kirātārj. 13, 11. Frequent. To lick re-peatedly, MBh. 1, 1181. -- With आ आ, To lick, to touch, Ragh. 10, 46. आलिढ,  1. Eaten.  2. Polished, Bhartṛ. 2, 36. n. An attitude in shooting, the right knee advanced, the left leg retracted, Ku-māras. 3, 70. -- With प्रत्या प्रति-आ-प्र-त्यालीढ, Eaten. n. An attitude in shooting, etc. = आलीढ, n. -- With परि परि, To lick, to enjoy, Rām. 2, 61, 16. Frequent. To lick repeatedly, Pañc. 55, 7 (see my transl. n. 257). -- With सम् सम्, To lick, MBh. 3, 10653. --With परिसम् परि-सम्, To lick, MBh. 3, 11500. -- Cf. λείχω, λιχανος, λειχήν; Lat. lingere, pol-lex; Goth. bi-laigôn; A.S. liccian.
12440: ऽलिह् -लिह्, latter part of comp. words, Licking.  -- Comp. रसना-, m. a dog.
12441: ली ली (the original signification is ‘To be viscous,’ then ‘To be solvable’), i. 1 and 10, Par. To melt, to liquefy, to dissolve. ii. 9. लिना, लिनी, Par.  1. To adhere.  2. To obtain. i. 4, Ātm. (properly pass.),  1. To be dissolved, to vanish, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 450.  2. To adhere or cling to.  3. To dwell, to live, to haunt, MBh. 1, 4310. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. लीन।  1. Melted, dis-solved, Vedāntas. in Chr. 219, 12.  2. Effaced, wiped away, removed, Kir. 5, 26.  3. Left.  4. Embraced.  5. Stay-ing, Pañc. 187, 5; being situated, resting, Śāk. d. 144.  6. Entered, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 830. -- With the prep. अन्तर् अन्तर्, अन्तर्लीन, Inherent, staying; haunting in the interior, Pañc. 109, 19; i. d. 420; Utt. Rāmac. 56, 10; (not coming out), Pañc. 175, 24. Acc. sing. °नम्, adv. Inwardly, Pañc. 185, 3. --With अप अप, Caus. लापय, Ātm. To deceive, Bhaṭṭ. 8, 44. -- With अभि अभि, अभिलीन, Adhering, Megh. 37. -- With अव अव, To cling to, Nal. 2, 46. -- With समव सम्-अव, i. 4, To be dissolved, Vedāntas. in Chr. 219, 15. -- With आ आ, i. 4, To faint, MBh. 3, 2573. -- With नि नि, i. 4,  1. To alight, to settle, MBh. 3, 10560.  2. To lie down, MBh. 3, 12091.  3. To hide one's self, MBh. 3, 10978. निलीन,  1. Fused in or into.  2. Transformed.  3. Destroyed.  4. En-compassed.  5. Full. -- With संनि सम् -नि, i. 4, To lie down, MBh. 3, 13654.  -- With प्र प्र, i. 4,  1. To be dissolved or absorbed, Man. 1, 54.  2. To die, Man. 4, 240.  3. To unite intimately, Man. 12, 17. प्रलीन,  1. Destroyed.  2. Unconscious, insensible. -- With संप्र सम्-प्र, pass. To be destroyed, Hit. iii. d. 129. -- With वि वि, i. 4,  1. To alight, Śiś. 1, 12.  2. To be dissolved, to vanish, Pañc. ii. d. 98; to become ineffectual, iii. d. 74. विलिन,  1. Li-quefied, melted.  2. Dissolved, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 830; Lass. 11, 15.  3. Disap-peared.  4. Imagined.  5. United.  Comp. अ-, adj. living, Utt. Rāmac. 168, 7. Caus. वि-लायय, -लापय, -ली̆नय (pro-perly a denomin. derived from विलीन), लालय (also a denomin. from लाला with वि), To dissolve. विलायित, Dissolved, Prab. 116, 8. -- With प्रवि प्र-वि, i. 4, To be dissolved, to vanish, Bhag. 4, 23.  -- With सम् सम्, संलीन,  1. Joined, put together, Pañc. 163, 6.  2. Stay-ing, MBh. 1, 7671. -- Cf. Lat. līmus (borrowed O.H.G. lim; A.S. líme, and O.H.G. leim; A.S. lám), po-līre, linere; λεῖμαξ.
12442: लीनता लीन + ता (vb. ली), f. Lying, Śāk. d. 167.
12443: लीला लीला (akin to लस्), f.  1. Play, sport, pastime, Pañc. 161, 15; लीलया (instr.), Sportively, Pañc. 229, 10; easily, without any effort, Pañc. 211, 12; Hit. 81, 18.  2. Amorous or wan-ton sport, Pañc. iii. d. 237.  -- Comp. स-लील, adj. wanton, sportive. °लम्, adv. affectionately, Kir. 5, 33.
12444: लीलावती लीलावती, i. e. लीला + वन्त् + ई, f. A wanton woman, Hit. i. d. 193, M.M.
12445: लुच् लुच् (vb. लुञ्च्), f.  1. Cutting off.  2. Dropping.
12446: लुञ्च् लुञ्च्, i. 1, Par.  1. To pull out, Bhaṭṭ. 15, 3.  2. To pare, to peel, Pañc. 121, 13. -- With the prep. अव अव, To pull off, MBh. 3, 10760. --With वि वि, To pull out, Bhaṭṭ. 18, 38.  -- Cf. probably O.H.G. liuhhan; A.S. lyccan, evellere; Lat. runcare.
12447: लुञ्चक लुञ्च् + अक, adj. One who pulls out.  -- Comp. केश-, adj. pulling out the hair, Prab. 54, 9.
12448: लुञ्चन लुञ्च् + अन, n. Pulling out, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 3.
12450: 1. लुट् लुट्, i. 1 and 4, Par.  1. To roll upon the ground, Bhaṭṭ. 3, 32 (cf. 3. लुठ्).  2. † To be connected with (?).
12451: † 2. लुट् लुट्, i. 1, Ātm.  1. To resist.  2. To suffer pain.  3. To shine. i. 10, Par. To shine, to speak. --Cf. रुट् and लुन्थ्।
12452: † 1. लुठ् लुठ्, i. 1, Par. To knock down. i. 1, Ātm.  1. To oppose.  2. To suffer pain.  3. To go.
12453: 2. लुठ् लुठ्, i. 10, Par., and लुण्ठ् लुण्ठ्, † रुण्ठ् रुण्ठ्, i. 1, Par. To rob. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. लुण्ठित।  1. Plundered, robbed, Rājat. 5, 345; 427.  2. Peeled (?), Pañc. 121, 11 (cf. my transl. n. 790). -- With the prep. निस् निस्, निर्लोठित, Robbed, Rājat. 5, 159. Cf. लुण्ट्।
12454: 3. लुठ् लुठ्, i. 6, Par.  1. To roll upon the ground, to welter, Hit. 123, 18.  2. To roll down, Rājat. 5, 92.  3. To move to and fro, Hit. ii. d. 67.  4. To agitate, to touch, Bhāg. 12455: लुठन लुठ् + अन, n.  1. A horse's rolling himself on the ground.  2. Rolling on the ground with sorrow.

Heaving, panting, Utt. Rāmac. 15, 15; Lass. 20, 20.  4. Destroyed. Caus. लोडय, To agitate, MBh. 1, 2833. Ptcple of the pf. pass.  I. लोडित, Troubled, Rām. 2, 95, 18.  II. लोलित, Agitated, Śiś. 9, 4. -- With the prep. अभि अभि, comp. ptcple. of the pf. pass. अन्-अभि-लुलित, Without being touched, Śāk. d. 61. -- With आ आ, Caus. लोडय,  1. 12457: † 2. लुड् लुड्, i. 6, Par.  1. To adhere, to be attached.  2. To cover.
12458: लुण्ट् लुण्ट्, i. 1 and 10, Par.  1. To plunder.  2. † To disregard.  3. To peel (cf. my transl. of the Pañc. n. 790). -- With the prep. उद् उद्, ptcple. of the pf. pass. उल्लुण्टित, Sacked, Pañc. rec. orn. MS. Berol. 121, a. Cf. 2. लुठ्।

To be troubled, to be clouded, Megh. 103. -- With व्या वि-आ, To remove, Megh. 71. Pass. Covetous, greedy, Daśak. in Chr. 190, 1.  3. Avari-cious, Man. 4, 87. m.  1. A hunter, Rām. 2, 71, 35.  2. A lecher. 12467: † लुम्ब् लुम्ब्, i. 1, Par. To tor-ment. i. 10, Par. To torment, or to be invisible.

12472: लू लू, ii. 9, लुना, लुनी, Par. Ātm.  1. To cut, to clip, MBh. 3, 15644.  2. To destroy, Śiś. 1, 51. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. लून।  1. Cut, clipped, Pañc. i. d. 201; cut off.  2. 12473: लूता लूता, f.  1. A spider, Man. 12, 57; Vedāntas. in Chr. 206, 13.  2. An ant.
12476: † 1. लूष् लूष्, i. 1, Par. To adorn. i. 10, Par. To hurt, to injure.
12477: † 2. लूष् लूष्, i. 10, and लुष् लुष्, i. 1, Par. To rob.

12484: लेपक लेपक, i. e. लिप् + अक, m. A bricklayer, a plasterer.

To review (an army), Hit. 94, 8. -- With समव सम्-अव, i. 10, To inspect, Cāk. d. 13. -- With आ आ, i. 1 and 10,  1. To look out, MBh. 4, 250.  2. To regard, Vikr. d. 81; to see, Pañc. i. d. 21; to inspect, to view, MBh. 3, 11024.  3. To perceive, MBh. 2, 1817.  4. To consider, Man. 8, 126. सालोकित, n. 12497: लोकपाल लोक-पाल, m.  1. A king.  2. The name of certain divinities, guardians of the world, as Indra, Soma, etc.; cf. a list of them in Wil-son's Specimens of the Theatre of the Hindus, i. 2. ed. 219, n. ad Vikr. d. 36.
12498: लोकायत लोकायत, i. e. लोक-आ-यत (vb. यम्?), n. The system of atheis-tical philosophy, taught by चार्वाक।

12505: † लोड् लोड्, लौड् लौड्, and लोट् लोट्, i. 1, Par. To be mad; cf. रोड्।
12506: लोत लोत, m.  1. A tear.  2. A mark, a sign.

12516: लोप्त्र लोप्त्र, i. e. लुप् + त्र, n. Plunder, booty, MBh. 1, 4309.

12940: वागारु वागारु, adj. One who dis-appoints.

12946: वाग्मिन् वाग्मिन्, i. e. वाच् + मिन्, adj., f. नी,  1. Talkative.  2. Eloquent, Pañc. iii. d. 84.
12947: वाघन्त् वाघन्त् (probably ptcple. pres. of a lost vb. वाघ् = Lat. vāgire; εὔχομαι) m. Praying, Chr. 294, 6 = Rigv. i. 88, 6.
12948: † वाङ्क्ष् वाङ्क्ष् (perhaps akin to the last), i. 1, Par. To wish. -- Cf. O.H.G. wunsc, wunskian; A.S. wiscan.
12949: वाङ्मय वाङ्मय, i. e. वाच् + मय,  I. adj., f. यी।  1. Relating to speech, Bhag. 17, 15.  2. Endowed with speech, Johns. Sel. 94, 53.  3. Consisting of words, Ragh. 3, 28.  4. Eloquent.  II. n. Eloquence.  III. f. यी, Sarasvatī.
12950: वाच् वाच् (vb. वच्), f.  1. Speak-ing, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2647.  2. Speech, Pañc. iii. d. 112.  3. A word, Rām. 3, 51, 20 (voice?).  4. A phrase, a pro-verb.  5. Sarasvatī.  6. 12953: वाचन वाचन, i. e. वच्, Caus., + अन, n. in स्वस्ति-, n. A preparatory religious rite in which the Brāhmaṇas invoke the blessings of the gods, etc., Vikr. 44, 14; Mālav. 56, 1 (Prākṛ.).
12954: वाचनिक वाचनिक, i. e. वाचन + इक, adj.  1. Verbal.  2. Textual.

12956: वाचस्पत्य वाचस्पत्य, i. e. वाचस्-पति + य, adj. Declared by Vācaspati, Hit. iii. d. 96.
12957: वाचा वाचा, i. e. वाच् + आ, f.  1. Speech, Vedāntas. in Chr. 216, 18.  2. A holy word, Pañc. 221, 7 (oath).

12959: वाचिक वाचिक, वाच् and वाचा, + इक,  I. adj.  1. Verbal.  2. Done by speech, Man. 12, 9.  II. n. News, intelligence.  -- Comp. त्रि-, adj. given by three holy words (by an oath), Pañc. 222, 16; 17. दण्ड-, i. e. दण्डवाच् + इक, adj. per-formed by deeds or words, Man. 8, 6.
12960: वाच्यता वाच्य + ता (vb. वच्), f.  1. Blame, Hit. iii. d. 127.  2. Ill repute.  3. The quality of being predicable.  -- Comp. अ-, f. blame (cf. अ-वाच्य, s. v. वच्), Kir. 11, 53.

12975: वाढ वाढ (cf. वहल and बहु),  I. adj., comparat. साधीयंस्, superl. साधिष्ठ।  1. Hard, firm; साधीयंस्, firmest, Daśak. in Chr. 195, 19.  2. Much.  II. acc. sing. ढम्, adv.  1. 12983: वाणी वाणी,  1. Speech, Hit. i. d. 99, M.M.  2. Voice, Chr. 294, 6 = Rigv. i. 88, 6; Pañc. 186, 17.  3. A literary production, Utt. Rāmac. 177, 6.  4. सरस्वती, the goddess of speech, Brah-mav. 2, 78. See वाणि।

13472: विभुता विभु + ता, f., and विभुत्व विभु + त्व, n. Power, Śāk. d. 42 (त्व).

13479: विभ्रंश वि-भ्रंश् + अ, m. A pre-cipice, Bhāg. P. 8, 22, 5.
13480: विभ्रंशिन् वि-भ्रंश् + इन्, adj. Fall-ing, fallen, Megh. 68.

Erroneous use, Man. 7, 24.  4. Doubt.  5. Play (of the eyes), Śāk. d. 23.  6. Amorous actions, Pañc. i. d. 151; flurry, con-fusion, perturbation, Bhag. 2, 63.  7. Enrapture, Mālat. 155, 7.  8. Rāmac. 14, 6.  -- Comp. चित्त-, m. derangement, madness, MBh. 18, 47. दृष्टि-, m. amorous playing of the eyes, Śāk. d. 23. स-, adj. playing, looking amor-ously, Ṛt. 1, 12; 6, 23.
13482: विभ्राज् वि-भ्राज्, adj.  1. Shining.  2. Elegant, richly dressed.

13484: विमतिता वि-मति + ता, f. Stupidity, Bhartṛ. 2, 44.

13488: विमर्दक विमर्दक (vb. मृद्), m. A proper name, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 7.

13490: विमर्दिन् विमर्दिन्, i. e. वि-मृद् + इन्, adj. Destroying, removing, Śāk. d. 69, v. r.
13491: विमर्श विमर्श (erroneously also विमर्ष विमर्ष, e. g. Kathās. 21, 25), i. e. वि-मृश् + अ, m.  1. Investigation.  2. Reasoning.  3. Discussion, hesita-tion, Rām. 1, 20, 23.  -- Comp. निस्-, adj. devoid of reflection, Kathās. 15, 39. स-विमर्श + म्, adv. thoughtfully, Śāk. 58, 4.
13492: विमर्शन विमर्शन, i. e. वि-मृश् + अन, n. Investigating, discussing.
13493: विमर्शिन् विमर्शिन्, i. e. वि-मृश् + इन्, adj. Thinking, deliberating.
13494: विमर्ष विमर्ष, i. e. वि-मृष् + अ, m.  1. Irritation, Chr. 60, 28.  2. Displea-sure. Cf. विमर्श।
13495: विमलता वि-मल + ता, f. Clearness, Chr. 35, 1.
13496: विमान वि-मान, m. and n.  1. A chariot of the gods, Vikr. 4, 1; Rām. 3, 48, 6.  2. Any vehicle, Rām. 3, 54, 6.  3. A horse.  4. A palace, Megh. 64.  5. (वि-मा + अन), A measure.
13497: विमानता विमान + ता, f. State of a chariot of the gods, Vikr. d. 137.
13498: विमानना विमानना, i. e. वि-मन्, Caus., + अन, f. Contempt, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 159; Rājat. 5, 339.
13499: विमानस्थ विमान-स्थ, adj. Stand-ing on a divine chariot, Pañc. iii. d. 184.
13500: विमार्ग m.  I. वि-मार्ग।  1. A bad road, Lass. 2. ed. 68, 40.  2. Evil con-duct.  II. i. e. वि-मृज् + अ, A broom, a brush.
13501: विमार्गण विमार्गण, i. e. वि-मार्ग् + अण, n. Seeking, Kir. 14, 9.
13503: विमुक्ति विमुक्ति, i. e. वि-मुच् + ति, f.  1. Separation.  2. Liberation, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 191; remission, Man. 11, 232.  3. Saving (one's life), Pañc. ii. d. 174.  4. Final emancipation from future existence.
13504: विमुखता वि-मुख + ता, f.  1. Turn-ing away.  2. Departure.  3. Disin-clination, opposition, Śāk. 66, 2.
13505: विमोक्ष वि-मोक्ष् + अ, m.  1. Letting loose.  2. Deliverance (from embarrass-ment), Chr. 54, 19.  3. Dismissing unhurt, Man. 8, 316.  4. Final emancipation, Bhag. 16, 5; Vedāntas. in Chr. 217, 7.
13506: विमोक्षण विमोक्षण, i. e. वि-मोक्ष् + अन, n., and f. णा,  1. Untying, Pañc. 107, 24.  2. Liberation, release, Johns. Sel. 97, 1. 6; Pañc. ii. d. 191.  3. Abandoning, Man. 2, 243; Pañc. 74, 20 ( अण्ड-, Laying eggs).
13507: विमोचन विमोचन, i. e. वि-मुच् + अन, n. Liberating, Brāhmaṇav. 3, 13.

13510: वियत् वियत् (perhaps वि-यम् + त्), n. Sky, heaven, Pañc. iii. d. 147.

13513: वियोगिन् वियोगिन्, i. e. वियोग + इन्,  I. adj., f. नी।  1. Separated, Nalod. 2, 12.  2. Absent.  II. m. The ruddy goose.
13514: विरक्ति विरक्ति, i. e. वि-रञ्ज् + ति, and वि-रक्ति, f.  1. Absence of affection.  2. Aversion, Pañc. 114, 1.

13521: विरलित विरलित, i. e. विरल + इत, in अ-विरलित-कपोल + म्, adv. With closely united cheeks, Utt. Rāmac. 17, 4.
13522: विरह वि-रह् + अ, m.  1. Separation, Megh. 12; Rājat. 5, 373; separation from (with instr.), Man. 5, 149.  2. Absence, Bhāṣāp. 68; want, Hit. 127, 5.  3. Cessation, Vikr. d. 130.  4. Re-linquishment.  -- Comp. प्रथम-, loc. sing. immediately after the separation, Megh. 92.

13525: विरागार्ह विरागार्ह, i. e. वि-राग -अर्ह (see राग), adj. Fit for freedom from passion, free from passion.

13635: विशुद्धि विशुद्धि, i. e. वि-शुध् + ति, f.  1. Purity, Man. 5, 67; 9, 9.  2. Cor-rectness.  3. Purifying, purification, Bhag. 6, 12; Utt. Rāmac. 9, 17.  4. Sameness.  5. Removal of doubt.
13636: विशेष विशेष, i. e. वि-शिष् + अ, m.  1. Difference, Pañc. 219, 14; at the end of comp. words, Different, e. g. गति-, m. Different ways, Pañc. 247, 11. पुरुष-, This or that man, Pañc. i. d. 124.  2. Special property, Hit. pr. d. 25, M.M.  3. A change for the better, Mālav. 46, 9.  4. Sort, kind, manner, Megh. 65; Hit. ii. d. 149; Pañc. 114, 25; a different object, Megh. 58.  5. Excellence, superiority; विशेषेण, Particularly, Pañc. 142, 15; 162, 9; at the end of comp. words, Excellent; e. g. भक्ष-, m. Excellent food, Pañc. 113, 9; 117, 2, cf. my transl. n. 767; Vikr. d. 142.  6. A limb.  7. A mark on the forehead with sandal.  8. Speciality, charac-teristic marks, Lass. 13, 4 ( तपस्विन्-, of an ascetic).  9. Abl. विशेषात्, Especi-ally, Pañc. ii. d. 100; even more, just for that, Pañc. 109, 19.  -- Comp. अ-विशेष + म्, adv. without choosing, Arj. 3, 32. तपोविशेष, i. e. तपस्-, m. pl. various modes of devotion, Man. 2, 165. दशा-, m. a special condition, Hit. 78, 8, M.M. निस्-,  I. m. want of difference, Hit. 113, 11.  II. adj. 1. having no discrimination, Hit. ii. d. 68. 2. not different. 3. equal. 4. acc. षम्, adv. a. without difference, Hit. 84, 5, M.M. b. alike, Hit. 128, 10. c. exceedingly, Utt. Rāmac. 99, 6. प्रसाधन-, m. highest accom-plishment, Vikr. d. 22. रस-, m. a more excellent juice, Pañc. ii. d. 37. स-, adj. 1. having discrimination, Hit. 55, 13. 2. having characteristic qualities. 3. extraordinary, Hit. 60, 6, M.M.
13637: विशेषक विशेषक, i. e. वि-शिष् + अक,  I. adj. Discriminative, distin-guishing.  II. m. and n.  1. An attri-bute, a predicate.  2. A mark on the forehead made with sandal, etc., and worn either as an ornament, Mālav. d. 40; Daśak. in Chr. 199, 4, or sectarial distinction.  -- Comp. पत्र-, strokes and lines drawn on the face with fragrant pigments of sandal, musk, etc., Ragh. 3, 55. वि-प्र-नष्ट- (vb. नश्), adj., f. का, one whose discriminative faculty or perception has disappeared, Rām. 3, 55, 6. स-, adj. discriminated, having distinguishing properties, Bhāṣāp. 1.
13638: विशेषज्ञ विशेष-ज्ञ, adj.  1. Deeply learned, Hit. 129, 9; iv. d. 98.  2. Wise, intelligent.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. having no judgment, Hit. iii. d. 126.
13639: विशेषण विशेषण, i. e. वि-शिष् + अन,  I. adj.  1. Discriminative.  2. Distinctive.  II. n.  1. Distinguishing, discriminating.  2. An attribute, epi-thet, Vikr. 20, 3.  -- Comp. निस्-, adj. without attributes, Bhāg. P. 2, 10, 34. स-, adj. distinguished, characterised.
13640: विशेषणता विशेषण + ता, f. The state of being a distinguishing mark, Bhāṣāp. 60; cf. Kusumāñj. transl. pp. 13, 55, n.
13641: विशेषणवन्त् विशेषण + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Having a distinguishing attri-bute, Bhāṣāp. 131.
13642: विशेषतस् विशेष + तस्, adv. Espe-cially, Hit. 80, 1, M.M.; particularly, Vikr. d. 62.  -- Comp. स-, adv. parti-cularly, excellently.
13643: विशेषवन्त् विशेष + वन्त्, adj.  1. Peculiar.  2. Excellent.  3. Superior, better, Johns. Sel. 17, 73.
13644: विशेष्यक विशेष्य + क (vb. शिष्), latter part of a comp. adj. in तद्वद्-विशेष्यक, i. e. तद्वन्त्-, Relating to an object possessing such an attribute, Bhāṣāp. 134; cf. Kusumāñj. transl. 61, 1-6.
13645: विशोधन विशोधन, i. e. वि-शुध् + अन,  I. n.  1. Cleaning.  2. Purifying, Rām. 1, 26, 19.  3. Expiation, Man. 11, 143; 156.  II. f. नी, The capital of Brahman.
13646: विशोधित्व विशोधित्व, i. e. विशोधिन् + त्व, n.  1. Cleaning.  2. Purifying.  3. Freeing from obstructions, clearing, Hit. iii. d. 86.
13647: विशोधिन् विशोधिन्, i. e. वि-शुध् + इन्, adj.  1. Cleaning.  2. Purifying.  3. Clearing.
13648: विशोषण विशोषण, i. e. वि-शुष् + अन,  I. adj.(?), Drying, Arj. 8, 8; the name of a weapon.  II. n. Drying.  -- Comp. तालु-, n. the growing dry of the palate (by much speaking), MBh. 8, 4760.
13649: विश्न विश्न, i. e. 2. विछ् + न, m. Splendour, Pāṇ. iii. 3, 90; vi. 4, 19.
13650: विश्पति विश्-पति, m. Lord of the house, Lass. 100, 13 = Rigv. vii. 15, 7.
13651: विश्पला विश्पला, f. A proper name, Chr. 296, 10 = Rigv. i. 112, 10.
13652: विश्रणन and विश्राणन विश्रा̆णन, i. e. वि-श्रण् + अन, n. Gift, donation, Ragh. 2, 54 (आ).
13653: विश्रम वि-श्रम् + अ, m. Rest, re-pose, quiet, Vikr. d. 42.
13654: विश्रम्भ वि-श्रम्भ् + अ (also विस्रम्भ विस्रम्भ), m.  1. Trust, confidence, Pañc. i. d. 306; ii. d. 190.  2. Affec-tion, Hit. 46, 1, M.M. (-आलाप, Affec-tionate talk).  3. Sportive noise.
13655: विश्रम्भिन् विश्रम्भिन्, i. e. वि-श्रम्भ्, and विश्रम्भ, + इन्, also विस्रम्भिन् विस्रम्भिन्, adj.  1. Trusting, confiding in.  2. Trustworthy, MBh. 1, 5845 (स्).
13656: विश्रय विश्रय, i. e. वि-श्रि + अ, m.  1. Abode, asylum.  2. Dependence upon.
13657: विश्रयिन् विश्रयिन्, adj.  1. Living or dwelling in.  2. Depending on.
13658: विश्रवस् वि-श्रवस्, m. A proper name, Rām. 3, 53, 30.
13660: विश्रान्ति विश्रान्ति, i. e. वि-श्रम् + ति, f. Rest, repose, Vikr. d. 20; Kathās. 22, 104 (रतेस् -- वासवेश्मेव विश्रान्त्यै --आवयोर् अभवत्, literally, It was for us like the sleeping-room of the god-dess of love for reposing in).
13661: विश्राम विश्राम, i. e. वि-श्रम् + अ, m.  1. Rest, repose, Pañc. 145, 9; Hit. i. d. 138, M.M.  2. Stop, pause, Utt. Rāmac. 103, 13.
13662: विश्राव विश्राव, i. e. वि-श्रु + अ, m., and विश्रुति वि-श्रु + ति, f. Fame, cele-brity, notoriety.  -- Comp. लोक-विश्रुति, f. 1. fame. 2. unfounded rumour.
13663: विश्लथ वि-श्लथ् + अ, adj. Relaxed, Ragh. 6, 73; languid.
13664: विश्लेष विश्लेष, i. e. वि-श्लिष् + अ, m.  1. Separation, Pañc., 225, 18 (with सह); disunion.  2. A chasm, Kathās. 2, 49.  -- Comp. चित्त-, m. separation of the hearts, loss of friendship, Pañc. 225, 17 (with instr.).
13665: विश्लेषिन् विश्लेषिन्, i. e. वि-श्लिष् + इन्, adj. Falling, Ragh. 16, 67.
13666: विश्व विश्व, probably वि-श्वि (cf. the aor. of श्वि, अ-श्वम्, and शश्वन्त्),  I. adj.  1. All, every, Lass. 97, 2 = Rigv. vi. 64, 1; every one, Lass. 101, 4 = Rigv. vii. 16, 1; particularly former part of comp. words, cf. विश्व-कर्मन्, विश्वकृत्, etc.  2. Whole.  3. Uni-versal.  II. m.  1. A term of the Vedāntra philosophy, the faculty per-ceiving singleness, Vedāntas. in Chr. 209, 13.  2. pl. (विश्वे), A class of deities, Indr. 2, 13.  III. n. The world, Śāk. d. 1.  IV. (n. and) f. वा, Dry ginger.  V. f. वा, A tree, a plant, Aconitum ferox.
13667: विश्वकद्रु विश्व + क-द्रु,  I. adj. Wicked.  II. m.  1. A dog trained for the chase.  2. Sound.
13668: विश्वकृत् विश्व-कृ + त्, m.  1. The creator.  2. A son of Brahman, the artist of the gods (= विश्व-कर्मन्), Sund. 3, 13, cf. 10.
13669: विश्वजनीन विश्वजनीन, विश्वजनीय विश्वजनीय, and विश्वजन्य विश्वजन्य, i. e. विश्व-जन + ईन, or ईय, or य, adj. Good for all men, universally salutary, Man. 9, 31 (-जन्य).
13670: विश्वजित् विश्व-जि + त्,  I. adj. All-sub-duing.  II. m.  1. A particular sacrifice, Man. 11, 74.  2. The noose of Varuṇa.
13671: विश्वञ्च् विश्वञ्च्, A false writing for विष्वञ्च्, q. cf.
13673: विश्वतुर् विश्व-तुर्, adj. All-subdu-ing, Chr. 288, 16 = Rigv. i. 48, 16.
13674: विश्वद्र्यञ्च् विश्वद्र्यञ्च्, i. e. विश्व + त्र-अञ्च् (with द् for त्; cf. also तिर्यञ्च्), adj., f. द्रीची, Moving everywhere.
13675: विश्वप्सन् विश्वप्सन्, i. e. विश्व-भस् + अन् (properly the curtailed ptcple. of the pres.), m.  1. A god.  2. Fire.  3. The sun.  4. The moon.
13676: विश्वंभर विश्वंभर, i. e. विश्व + म् -भृ + अ,  I. adj. All-sustaining.  II. m.  1. Viṣṇu.  2. Indra.  III. f. रा, The earth, Utt. Rāmac. 7, 11.
13677: विश्वसन वि-श्वस् + अन, n. Trusting, confiding in.
13678: विश्वसनीयता i. e. वि-श्वसनीय + ता (vb. श्वस्), f. Inspiring confidence, Śāk. 27, 17.
13679: विश्वसह विश्व-सह् + अ,  I. adj. All-enduring.  II. f.  1. The earth.  2. One of the tongues of fire.
13680: विश्वसुविद् विश्व-सु-विद्, adj. Giving everything well, Chr. 287, 2 = Rigv. i. 48, 2.
13681: विश्वसृज् विश्व-सृज् (nom. sing. -सृट् and सृक्, MBh. 14, 7367), m.  1. The creator of the universe, MBh. 1. 1.; Śiś. 9, 80.  2. Brahman.
13682: विश्वाची विश्वाची, i. e. विश्व-अञ्च् + ई, f. The name of an Apsaras, Lass. 2. ed. 50, 22.
13683: विश्वामित्र विश्वामित्र, i. e. विश्व -मित्र, m. The name of a Muni, Johns. Sel. 23, 118.
13684: विश्वावसु विश्वावसु, i. e. विश्व-वसु, m.  1. One of the Manus.  2. One of the Gandharvas, Indr. 2, 18.
13685: विश्वास विश्वास, i. e. वि-श्वस् + अ, m.  1. Confidence, trust, Pañc. ii. d. 23.  2. Faith, Vikr. 71, 13.  3. Secret, Hit. 73, 16.  -- Comp. अ-, m. 1. want of con-fidence, distrust, Pañc. i. d. 295. 2. treachery(?), Rām. 3, 52, 48. °शम्, adv. without confiding, distrustfully, Pañc. iii. d. 59.
13686: विश्वासन (or ना?), विश्वासन (or ना), i. e. वि-श्वस्, Caus., + अन, n. (or f.), Producing confidence, Pañc. 165, 15.
13687: विश्वासिन् विश्वासिन्, i. e. वि-श्वस्, and विश्वास, + इन्, adj., f. नी,  1. Trusting.  2. Trusty, honest.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. mistrustful, Megh. 111.
13688: विश्वासैकसार विश्वासैकसार, i. e. विश्वास-एक-सार, m. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 44.
13689: विश्वेभोजस् विश्वेभोजस् (i. e. विश्व and भोजस्), m. A name of Indra, Matsyapurāṇa, see Aufrecht, Ujjvalad. p. 250, n.
13690: † 1. विष् विष्, i. 1, Par. To sprinkle.
13691: 2. विष् विष्, ii. 3, वेविष्, Par. Ātm. To pervade, to embrace, etc. (ved.). -- With the prep. परि परि, Caus.  1. To present, to offer, Man. 3, 228; to offer food, MBh. 1, 7182 (where it is written with श् instead of ष्).  2. To wait on, Rām. 1, 13, 14.
13692: † 3. विष् ii. 9, विष्णा, विष्णी, Par. To separate.
13693: 4. विष् विष्, f. Excrement, Man. 4, 48.  -- Comp. कर्ण-, f. ear-wax, Man. 5, 135.
13694: विष विष,  I. m. and n. Poison, Pañc. iii. d. 83 (n.).  II. n.  1. Water.  2. See विस।  -- Comp. कर्ण-, n. poison sprinkled in one's ears (treacherous speech), Pañc. i. d. 338. दूषी-, n. vegetable poison that has become old and diminished in strength, Suśr. 2, 254, 7. दृष्टि-, m. a snake, Kir. 14, 25. निस्-, adj., f. षा, deprived of poison, Pañc. iii. d. 83. नेत्र-, adj. having poison in one's eyes, MBh. 2, 2140. महा-, m. a small venomous snake, Rām. 3, 53, 55. लाला-, m. an insect whose spittle is poison, as a spider. -- Cf. Lat. virus; ἰός, ἴον; Lat. viola (poison is connected with blue, cf. विष-पुष्प, and Śiva's neck grow-ing blue, by swallowing the poison churned out of the sea).
13695: विषङ्ग विषङ्ग, i. e. वि-सञ्ज् + अ, m. Attachment.  -- Comp. निस्-, adj. indif-ferent, Bhāg. P. 4, 22, 51.
13696: विषण्णता विषण्ण + ता (vb. सद्), f. Dejection, want of energy.
13697: विषता विष + ता, f. State of poison, Śiś. 9, 68.
13698: विषद विष-द,  I. adj.  1. Giving poison.  2. Shedding water.  II. m. A cloud.  III. n. Green vitriol.
13699: विषदर्शनमृत्युक विष-दर्शन-मृ-त्यु + क, m. A kind of pheasant.
13700: विषधर विषधर, i. e. विष-धृ + अ,  I. adj. Venomous.  II. m. A snake.
13701: विषम विषम, i. e. वि-सम,  I. adj., f. मा।  1. Unequal, different, Kir. 5, 40.  2. Inconstant, Hit. ii. d. 104.  3. Odd (in numbers), figurat., Pañc. i. d. 126.  4. Unhappy, Hit. iv. d. 3.  5. Un-paralleled, unequalled, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 1.  6. Uneven, Pañc. ii. d. 188; sloping, Vikr. 10, 9.  7. Rough, Vikr. d. 49; Pañc. 188, 9.  8. Difficult, pain-ful, Bhartṛ. 2, 54; disagreeable, Pañc. i. d. 12.  9. Frightful, Hit. iii. d. 133.  10. Dishonest, wicked, Hiḍ. 1, 39; Hit. ii. d. 111.  11. Partial, Man. 7, 27.  II. n.  1. Inequality.  2. Oddness.  3. Unevenness, Man. 1, 24 (uneven valleys, Jones).  4. An inaccessible place, a precipice, Rām. 3, 51, 40; Pañc. 142, 6; a thicket, a pit, Man. 8, 232.  5. Difficulty, pain, Pañc. v. d. 65; mis-fortune, Bhartṛ. 2, 95.  -- Comp. वाक्य -वज्र-, adj. rough, coarse, by (using) thunderbolt-like words, Pañc. iii. d. 236 (cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2928).
13702: विषमय विष + मय, adj., f. यी (Pañc. i. d. 211, या, but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 119, read विषमय्यो), Poi-sonous.
13703: विषमस्थ विषम-स्थ, adj.  1. Stand-ing unevenly.  2. Being in difficulty or misfortune, Nal. 10, 1.  3. Inac-cessible, Pañc. i. d. 195.  4. Safely posted.
13704: विषमित विषमित, i. e. विषम + इत, adj.  1. Made crooked, Kir. 10, 56.  2. Made difficult to be walked on, Kir. 12, 50.
13705: विषय विषय (probably वि-क्षि + अ), m.  1. A collection of villages.  2. A country, Rājat. 5, 51; Pañc. 129, 14; a kingdom, Bhartṛ. 2, 12; Rām. 3, 54, 28 ( यम-, The lower regions, death); a place, Śāk. 104, 14; Kir. 5, 38.  3. Anything indigenous or peculiar to a province.  4. Home, province, depart-ment, sphere, Vikr. 39, 14; Pañc. 4, 17 ( जीवितव्य-, Duration of life); Pañc. 227, 22 (application); element, that which is peculiarly known to those who occupy themselves with it or live therein.  5. Horizon, sight, a place which may be looked over by some-body, reach, Man. 8, 148; Hit. 28, 3, M.M.; Megh. 35; 101.  6. Any-thing perceivable by the senses, an object of sense, Man. 1, 15; Vikr. d. 9.  7. An object in general, Bhāṣāp. 36; अत्र विषये, Concerning this object, Pañc. 114, 20; धनविषये, Concern-ing wealth, Pañc. 139, 3; स्त्रीणां विषये, Concerning women, 27, 18; an object of art, Mālav. d. 29.  8. Worldly object, affair, business, enjoy-ment, etc., Pañc. iii. d. 244; sensual enjoyment, Hit. iii. d. 116.  9. Aim, Śiś. 9, 40.  10. A religious observance.  11. Refuge, asylum.  12. A lover, a husband.  -- Comp. अ-,  I. adj. unac-quainted with worldly objects, Śāk. 55, 20.  II. m. 1. not being an object, Mālat. 17, 2. 2. invisibility, Hit. ii. d. 77. अन्-अन्य-, adj. having, or referring to, no other object, Vikr. d. 1. अवकाश-, adj., f. या, literally, having as its sphere space, room, i. e. demanding a place (which it can-not get because the heart is filled with pride, etc.), Pañc. iii. d. 264. च-क्षुर्विषय, i. e. चक्षुस्-, m. sight, Man. 2, 298. अ-चक्षुस्-, adj. not distinguishable by one's eye, Man. 4, 77. गुण-समुदय-अवाप्ति-, adj., f. या, having as its object the acquire-ment of a multitude of good qualities, Hit. i. d. 174, M.M. निस्-,  I. m. no home, not being a dwelling-place, Hariv. 3654.  II. adj. 1. having no home banished, Rām. 3, 79, 47. 2. not attached to worldly objects, Bhāg. 14265: व्यामिश्र व्यामिश्र, i. e. वि-आ-मिश्र q. cf.), adj. Mixed, blended, con-founded, Bhag. 3, 2.

14279: व्यावहारिक व्यावहारिक, i. e. व्य-वहार + इक,  I. adj.  1. Active, Ve-dāntas. in Chr. 207, 6.  2. Usual, customary.  3. Judicial, relating to trials, Man. 8, 78.  II. m. A counsel-ler, Rām. 2, 51, 13, ed. Seramp. (thus to be read).  III. n. Use, Man. 8, 164.

14693: शिम्बि and वी शिम्बी, f. A legume, a pod, Mālat. 145, 20.

II. f. रा (cf. सिरा), Any vessel of the body, really, or supposed to be of a tubular form, as a nerve, Rām. 5, 32, 11; a vein.  -- Comp. त्रि-,  I. adj. having three points, MBh. 13, 7379.  II. m. the name of a Rākṣasa, Bhāg. P. 9, 10, 9.
14695: शिरःस्थ शिरःस्थ, i. e. शिरस्-स्थ, adj. Borne on the head, Pañc. v. d. 36.
14696: शिरस् शिरस् (for original शरस्, cf. Zend. शर, and शीर्ष), n. (the base of some cases is optionally शीर्षन्, i. e. शिरस् + अन्),  1. The head, Pañc. iii. d. 193; शिरसा प्र-णि-पत्, To reverence by inclining one's head, Vikr. 3, 12; शिरसा कृ, To bear on one's head, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1847.  2. The top of a mountain, Kir. 5, 17; of a tree.  3. Chief, principal.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. headless, Man. 9, 237. अभ्र-, n. a head repre-sented by the sky, Śiś. 9, 3. अश्व-,  I. n. the head of a horse, MBh. 3, 3083.  II. adj. having the head of a horse, ib. 12, 13100.  III. m. a proper name, ib. 1, 2531. उच्चैःशिरस्, i. e. उच्चैस्-, adj. m. a man of high rank. Kumāras. 1, 12. कपाल-, Rām. 2, 54, 30 (= 2, 54, 32 Gorr., where कलाप-) ? perhaps a name of Śiva. कूर्च-, n. the upper part of the palm and ball of the foot, Suśr. 1, 345, 9. त्रि-,  I. adj. having three heads, MBh. 5, 229. 14697: शिरसिज शिरस् + इ-ज, and शिरसिरुह् शिरस् + इ-रुह्, m. The hair of the head, Kir. 10, 52 (-ज).
14698: शिरस्क शिरस् + क,  I. n.  1. A hel-met.  2. A turban, a cap.  II. f. का, A palanquin.
14699: शिरस्त्र शिरस्-त्र (vb. त्रा), and शिरस्त्राण शिरस्-त्राण, n.  1. A helmet, Rājat. 5, 342; Ragh. 4, 64.  2. A turban, a cap.
14700: शिराल शिरा + ल (see शिर),  I. adj., f. ला।  1. Veiny, showing the veins, Kāśīkh. 37, 14; Bhaṭṭ. 2, 30.  2. Showing the tendons.  II. n. An acid fruit, Averrhoa carambola.
14701: शिरि शिरि, i. e. शॄ + इ, m.  1. A sword.  2. An arrow.  3. A murderer.  4. A locust.
14702: शिरीष शिरीष (akin to the last),  I. m. A tree, Acacia sirisa, Bhartṛ. 2, 6.  II. n. Its flower, Śāk. d. 145.
14703: शिरोधरा शिरोधरा, i. e. शिरस्-धृ + अ, f. The neck, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 23 (read °शिरोधरोद्देश°).  -- Comp. महा-काय-शिरोधर, adj. having a great body and neck, Rām. 3, 55, 2.
14704: शिरोधि शिरोधि, i. e. शिरस्-धा (cf. निधि), f. The neck.
14705: शिरोरुह् शिरोरुह्, i. e. शिरस्-रुह्, and शिरोरुह शिरोरुह, i. e. शिरस्-रुह् + अ, m. Hair, Pañc. iii. d. 193 (ह).
14706: † शिल् शिल्, सिल् सिल्, i. 6, Par. To glean (cf. the next).
14707: शिल शिल,  A. n. Gleaning ears of corn, Man. 3, 100; 10, 112.  B. i. e. probably शो + ल,  I. f. ला।  1. A stone, Pañc. 100, 18; a rock, Vikr. d. 49.  2. P. 3, 13, 22. जात-रूप-शिल, m. the name of a (golden) mountain, Rām. 4, 14, 52. तीर्थ-शिला, f. stone steps leading to a bathing-place, Śṛṅgārat. 1 (read °लम्, at the end of a comp. adj.). बध्य-, f. ला, rock of execution, Pañc. 52, 2. मनःशिल, i. e. मनस्-, m., and f. ला, red arsenic. स्वल्प-शिला, i. e. सु-अल्प-, f. a very small stone.
14708: शिलाटक शिलाटक, m.  1. A room on the top of a house.  2. A hole.
14709: शिलि and ली शिली̆ (cf. शिली, under शिल), f. The lower timber of a door.
14710: शिलीन्ध्र शिलीन्ध्र,  I. m.  1. A sort of tree.  2. A kind of fish.  II. f. री।  1. Clay, earth.  2. A small earth-worm (cf. शिली, under शिल).  3. A sort of bird.  III. n.  1. Hail (cf. शिला).  2. A mushroom, Megh. 11.  3. The flower of the plantain tree.
14711: शिलीपद शिलीपद (a dialect. form of श्लीपद, q. cf.), m. A morbid en-largement of the leg, Lass. 94, 10.
14712: शिल्प शिल्प, n.  1. Proficiency in any manual or mechanical art, or profes-sion; art, Pañc. i. d. 4, 446; Bhāg. P. 3, 23, 17; Chr. 51. 1; Daśak. in Chr. 180, 12.  2. A sort of spoon used at sacrifices to throw the butter into the fire.  -- Comp. कृत-, adj. one who has attained a knowledge of his art, Yājñ. 2, 184.
14713: शिल्पिक शिल्पिक, i. e. शिल्प + इक,  I. adj. Manual, mechanic.  II. n.  1. Handicraft.  2. (and शिस्पक शिल्प + क), A sort of drama.
14714: शिल्पिन् शिल्पिन्, i. e. शिल्प + इन्,  I. adj. Belonging or relating to a mechanical profession or art.  II. m., f. नी, and n. An artificer, a mechanic, Pañc. 10, 6; Johns. Sel. 9, 11.
14715: शिव शिव (probably akin to शवस्),  I. adj.  1. Prosperous, Hit. 68, 17; auspicious, Mālat. 6, 12; happy.  2. Right, Nal. 20, 17.  3. 17.  3. Comparat. शि-वतर, Very complacent, Utt. Rāmac. 145, 2.  II. m.  1. Śiva, a deity of the Hindu triad, Kir. 5, 21; dual, Śiva and his wife, ib. 5, 40.  2. The phallic emblem of Śiva.  3. An auspi-cious planetary conjunction.  4. The Vedas.  5. One of the astronomical periods termed योगस्।  6. A pillar to which cattle are tied.  7. A sort of perfume.  III. f. वा।  1. Durgā, the wife of Śiva.  2. The female jackal, Sāv. 5, 75.  3. The name of several plants.  IV. n.  1. Happiness, Arj. 5, 19; bliss, Mālat. 160, 14.  2. Well-being, Pañc. 16, 5.  3. 14716: शिवंकर शिवंकर, i. e. शिव + म्-कृ + अ, adj. Auspicious, conferring happi-ness.
14717: शिवताति शिव + ताति, f. Benevolence, Mālat. 160, 4.
14718: शिवि शिवि, m.  1. A beast of prey.  2. The name of a king, Sāv. 2, 17; MBh. 13, 2046, sqq.; pl. his descendants, Draup. 8, 3.
14719: शिविका शिविका, f.  1. A palanquin, a litter, Rām. 2, 60, 76, Seramp.  2. A tent, Johns. Sel. 9, 12; a marquee.  3. A proper name, MBh. 3, 13155.
14720: शिविर शिविर,  I. m. The name of a tribe(?), Rājat. 5, 176.  II. n.  1. A camp.  2. A royal camp or residence.  3. A guard or defence for the soldiers.  4. A sort of grain.
14721: शिशिर शिशिर (akin to शो, cf. the ved. inflection of this vb.),  I. adj. Cold, cool, Vikr. d. 41; comparat. Very cool, refreshing, Pañc. 9, 4.  II. (m. and) n.  1. Cold, frost, Megh. 81.  2. Cool-ness, Vikr. 19, 17 (of a wood).  3. The cold season, Pañc. v. d. 4.
14722: शिशु शिशु, i. e. reduplic. श्वि, m.  1. The young of man or any animal, Vikr. d. 121; Pañc. 160, 4; a child, Pañc. i. d. 241; a calf, Pañc. 182, 12; a pup, etc.  2. A boy.  3. A pupil.
14723: शिशुक शिशु + क, m.  1. A child, Pañc ii. d. 200.  2. A porpoise.
14724: शिशुता शिशु + ता, f., शिशुत्व शिशु + त्व, n. Childhood, Utt. Rāmac. 107, 6; Pañc. 220, 10.
14726: † 1. शिष् शिष्, i. 1, Par. To hurt, to kill.
14727: 2. शिष् शिष्, ii. 7, शिनष्, शिंष्, Par. To leave; pass. To be left, MBh. 2, 1964. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. शिष्ट।  1. Left, remaining.  2. Also sbst. Chief, Hit. 100, 15. To leave, Bhaṭṭ. 17, 93; with न, To destroy, Ragh. 12, 79. -- With वि वि, To distinguish, to make distinguished, to augment, Mālat. 71, 8. Pass.  1. To be distinguished, Ragh. 17, 62.  2. To prefer, with abl. and instr., MBh. 3, 14735. Pass.  a. To be better than, Man. 2, 83; Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1678 (मूर्ख-सहस्रेण प्राज्ञे एक वि शिष्-यते, One wise man is better than a thousand fools); to be of more weight, Rām. 2, 35, 8.  b. 14728: शिष्टि शिष्टि, i. e. शास् + ति, f. An order.

14747: शीर्वि शीर्वि, i. e. शॄ + वि, adj. Hurtful, destructive.
14748: शीर्ष शीर्ष, i. e. curtailed शीर्षन् (cf. शिरस्), n. The head, Utt. Rāmac. 40, 2 (-छेद्य, adj. 15680: समुत्थ समुत्थ, i. e. सम्-उद्-स्थ, adj.  1. Rising, Chr. 33, 34; getting up.  2. Born, produced, Man. 8, 353.  3. Occasioned, occurring.

15692: समुदय and समुदाय समुदा̆य, i. e. सम्-उद्-इ + अ, m.  1. Rising (as of the sun), rise.  2. A day.  3. Effort.  4. Revenue, Man. 7, 56 (ă).  5. Multi-tude, Pañc. 82, 5 (आ); number, heap, Utt. 15700: समुद्धरण समुद्धरण, i. e. सम् -उद्-हृ + अन, n.  1. Taking out.  2. Eradicating.  3. Drawing up.  4. Food vomited or thrown up.  5. Extricating, lifting out.

15767: संबन्धिन् संबन्धिन्, i. e. संबन्-ध + इन्, adj. and sbst., f. नी,  1. Con-nected with, Pañc. iii. d. 141; in-herent, Vedāntas. in Chr. 214, 2; re-ferring to, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 22.  2. 15769: सम्बल सम्बल,  I. (m.), n. Stock for travelling expenses.  II. n. Water (cf. शम्बल, शम्बर).
15770: संबाध संबाध, i. e. सम्-बाध् + अ,  I. m.  1. Being thronged, Hariv. 2677.  2. Pressing on, pressure, Johns. Sel. 60, 185.  3. Difficulty, Mārk. P. 21, 1.  4. The road to Tartarus.  5. The vulva.  6. Fear.  II. adj., f. धा (Rām. 1, 40, 22, Schlegel; 2, 65, 33, Seramp.; Śakun-talop. ap. Chezy, ii. 29).  1. Narrow.  2. Crowded, Ragh. 12, 67.  3. Blocked up, Pañc. i. d. 427 (cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1446); impassable.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. 1. large, MBh. 2, 345. 2. lonely, Kir. 3, 53. अभि-, adj., f. धा, very nar-row. आ-, adj. crowded, full of, Rām. 5, 23, 21. निस्-, adj. 1. large, Suśr. 1, 241, 7. 2. shortest (properly, without any obstruction), Daśak. in Chr. 186, 16. शर-, adj., f. धा, covered with arrows, Utt. Rāmac. 117, 2. हस्त्य-श्वरथ-, i. e. हस्तिन्-अश्व-रथ-, adj., f. धा, crowded by elephants, horses, and carriages, Rām. 3, 54, 16.
15771: संबाधन संबाधन, i. e. सम्-बाध् + अन, n.  1. Obstructing, Pañc. i. d. 427 (but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1446).  2. A barrier, a gate.  3. A door-keeper.  4. The point of a stake or spit.
15772: संबुद्धि संबुद्धि, i. e. सम्-बुध् + ति, f.  1. Calling, or calling to.  2. (In grammar), The vocative case, Pāṇ. 2, 3, 49.
15773: संबोध संबोध, i. e. सम्-बुध् + अ, m. Instructing, informing.

15775: संभव संभव, i. e. सम्-भू + अ, m.  1. Mixing, union.  2. Adaptation, appropriateness.  3. Adequacy, ability.  4. Possibility.  5. Compatibility, con-sistency.  6. Agreement.  7. P, 6, 3, 35. गर्भ-, m. the production of an embryo, pregnancy, Yājñ. 1, 69, द-धि-, adj. prepared of milk, Man. 5, 10. देव-यजन-, adj., f. वा, sprung up from a place prepared for a sacrifice, Utt. 15776: संभार संभार, i. e. सम्-भृ + अ, m.  1. Maintaining, supporting.  2. Apparatus, things required for any act or affair, Rām. 1, 11, 13; Pañc. 157, 22.  3. Provision, getting everything ready.  4. 15777: संभावन संभावन, i. e. सम्-भू, Caus., + अन, n., and f. ना,  1. Ade-quacy, ability.  2. Fitness.  3. Possi-bility.  4. Doubt.  5. Considering, Ragh. 5, 28 (f.); reflecting.  6. 15778: संभाष संभाष, i. e. सम्-भाष् + अ,  I. m. Conversation, Man. 2, 195; in स्नेह-, Kind conversation, Pañc. 51, 23.  II. f.  1. Greeting, Hit. i. d. 38, M.M.  2. 15779: संभाषण संभाषण, i. e. सम् -भाष् + अन, n.  1. Conversation, Lass. 41, 17.  2. Sexual intercourse, Lass. 10, 20.  3. War-cry, watch-word.
15780: संभूति संभूति, i. e. सम्-भू + ति, f.  1. Combination.  2. Birth, Man. 2, 147.  3. Origin, Rājat. 5, 73; pro-duction.  -- Comp. गर्भ-, f. preg-nancy, Kathās. 5, 61.
15781: संभृति संभृति, i. e. सम्-भृ + ति, f.  1. Support, nourishment.  2. Prepara-tion, provision.  3. Plenitude, fullness.
15782: संभेद संभेद, i. e. सम्-भिद् + अ, m.  1. Breaking, splitting.  2. Union, mixture, Mālat. 167, 4.  3. The con-fluence of two rivers, Man. 8, 356, or the junction of a river with the sea.
15783: संभोग संभोग, i. e. सम्-भुज् + अ, m.  1. Enjoyment, Pañc. ii. d. 67; sensual enjoyment, Rājat. 5, 230.  2. Coition, Megh. 94; copulation.  3. A catamite.  4. Use, occupation, Man. 8, 200.  -- Comp. अ-, m. non-enjoyment, Hit. i. d. 156, M.M.
15784: संभोजन संभोजन, i. e. सम्-भुज् + अन,  I. adj., f. नी, Convivial, Man. 8, 141.  II. n. A meal.
15785: संभ्रम संभ्रम, i. e. सम्-भ्रम् + अ, m.  1. Turning round, revolving.  2. Haste, MBh. 1, 764.  3. 15786: संभ्रमभृत् संभ्रम-भृ + त्, adj. Embarrassed, Śiś. 9, 71.
15787: संमति संमति, i. e. सम्-मन् + ति, f.  1. Agreement.  2. Approbation, Pañc. 229, 1.  3. Regard, respect, Kir. 10, 36.  4. Real knowledge.  5. Wish, desire.
15788: संमद संमद, i. e. सम्-मद् + अ, m. Joy, Mālat. 77, 11; happiness, Go-vardh. Āryā Saptaśatī, 275, d.
15789: संमर्द संमर्द, i. e. सम्-मृद् + अ, m.  1. Friction, rubbing.  2. War, battle, Kathās. 3, 66.  3. Trampling on, treading on, Rājat. 5, 57.

15794: संमिश्र संमिश्र, i. e. सम्-मिश्र, adj. Mixed, blended, joined.

15799: संमोद संमोद, i. e. सम्-मुद् + अ, m. Pleasure, delight.
15800: संमोह संमोह, i. e. सम्-मुह् + अ, m.  1. Beguilement, fascination.  2. Stupefaction, Utt. Rāmac. 107, 8.  3. Folly.  4. Illusion of mind, Man. 7, 12.  5. Ignorance.  6. Fainting.

15872: सर्वर्तुक सर्वर्तुक, i. e. सर्व-ऋतु + क, adj. Fit for, or inhabitable in, every season, Man. 7, 76.

15875: सर्वाङ्गीण सर्वाङ्गीण, i. e. सर्व -अङ्ग + ईन, adj.  1. Spreading through the whole body, spread over all the limbs, Vikr. d. 51; thrilling through the whole body, d. 149.  2. Relating to the Aṅgas or parts of science collec-tively.

To be able (with infin. and dat. of an abstract noun), Rām. 3, 51, 17; MBh. 3, 16543 (परिभोगाय, To enjoy).  -- With अभ्युद् अभि-उद्, To be able, to wish, Ragh. 5, 22. -- With प्रोद् प्र -उद्, Caus. 15957: साक्षिता साक्षिता, i. e. साक्षिन् + ता, f. Testimony, evidence, Man. 8, 80.

15959: साक्षिमन्त् साक्षिमन्त्, i. e. साक्षिन् + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, Having or re-quiring witness.

16005: साध्वस साध्वस, probably स-ध्वंस् + अ + अ, n.  1. Fear, terror, Vikr. d. 56; Mālav. 20, 9; 53, 21; Śāk. 12, 21.  2. Perturbation, Bhāg. P. 1, 11, 19.  3. Torpor, Utt. Rāmac. 80, 10.  -- Comp. अति-, m. too great fear, Hit. iii. d. 123. निःसाध्वस, i. e. निस्-, adj. 1. fearless, Hariv. 8709. 2. bold, Rām. 1, 64, 16 Gorr. स-, adj., f. सा, alarmed, fright-ened, timid, Vikr. 28, 10. °सम्, adv., 28, 14.
16007: सानु सानु, probably सो + नु, m. and n.  1. End, point, the top of a mountain, Mālat. 145, 10.  2. Level ground on the top or edge of a mountain, table-land, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 13.  3. 16010: सान्तानिक सान्तानिक, i. e. संतान + इक,  I. adj.  1. Expansive.  2. Relating to posterity.  3. Belonging to the heavenly tree. संतान, Kir. 18, 20.  II. m. A Brāhmaṇa intending to marry for the sake of issue, Man. 11, 1.
16011: सान्त्व् सान्त्व्, and सान्त्व सान्त्व see शान्त्व्, शान्त्व।

16013: सान्दृष्टिक सान्दृष्टिक, i. e. सम् -दृश् + ति + इक, m. Immediate conse-quence.
16014: सान्द्र सान्द्र,  I. adj.  1. Thick, coarse, gross, Caurap. 12; Ṛt. 1, 20; intense, Śiś. 9, 15; 22.  2. Stout, robust.  3. Much, abundant, Mālat. 60, 13.  4. Vehement, Böhtl. Ind. 16015: सान्धिविग्रहिक सान्धिविग्रहिक, i. e. संधि-विग्रह + इक, m. Prime mi-nister (who decides peace and war), Lass. 2. ed. 16, 9; Sāh. D. 7, 8.
16016: सान्ध्य सान्ध्य, i. e. संध्या + अ, adj. Relating to twilight or the even-ing, Kir. 5, 8; Śiś. 9, 15.
16017: सान्नहनिक सान्नहनिक, i. e. सं-नहन + इक,  I. adj.  1. Bearing or putting on armour.  2. Calling to arms.  II. m. An armour-bearer.

16027: साप्तपदीन साप्तपदीन, i. e. साप्त-पद + ईन, n. Friendship, Kumāras. 5, 39.
16028: साप्तपौरुष साप्तपौरुष, i. e. सप्-तन्-पुरुष + अ, adj., f. षी, Compris-ing seven generations, Man. 3, 146.
16029: साफल्य साफल्य, i. e. स-फल + य, n.  1. Productiveness, fruitfulness, Hit. ii. d. 21.  2. Advantage, Man. 12, 93.  3. State of earning the fruit, Mālat. 72, 9 (at the end of a Bahuvr.).

16033: सामञ्जस्य सामञ्जस्य, i. e. समञ्-जस + य, n. Fitness.

16035: सामन्त सामन्त, i. e. समन्त + अ,  I. adj.  1. Limitative.  2. Bordering, neighbouring, Man. 8, 259.  3. Universal, Ragh. 5, 28 (Sch.).  II. m.  1. 16037: सामर्थ्य सामर्थ्य, i. e. समर्थ + य, n.  1. Fitness, Rājat. 5, 308.  2. Adequacy, Pañc. i. d. 215 (that which is adequate, but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1873, v.r.); being entitled, Böhtl. Ind. 16043: सामासिक सामासिक, i. e. समास + इक, adj.  1. Compounded, Bhag. 10, 33; composite.  2. Comprehensive, com-prising the whole, Man. 7, 180; 10, 63.  3. Summary, brief.

16045: सामिधेन्य सामिधेन्य, i. e. सम् -इधेन्य (an old ptcple. of the fut. pass. of इन्ध्), + अ,  I. m. A mantra or mystical prayer.  II. f. नी,  1. Fuel.  2. A prayer used on adding fuel to the sacrificial fire.
16046: सामीप्य सामीप्य i. e. समीप + य,  I. m. A neighbour, Sāv. 2, 8.  II. n. Proximity.

16050: साम्परायिक साम्परायिक, i. e. सं-पराय + इक,  I. adj.  1. Relating to war, military, Man. 7, 185; warlike, Ragh. 17, 62.  2. Calamitous.  3. Fu-ture, relating to a future state, Man. 11, 30.  II. n. War, battle.
16051: साम्प्रतम् साम्प्रतम्, i. e. सं-प्रति + अ + म्, adv.  1. Now, at this time, Pañc. 161, 18.  2. Seasonably, fitly, properly.  -- Comp. अ-साम्प्रत, adj. unbecoming, Pañc. i. d. 275. °तम्, adv. unbecomingly, Hit. iii. d. 111.

16962: हत्नु हत्नु, i. e. हन् + त्नु, m.  1. A weapon.  2. Sickness.

O.H.G. hweion; Goth. vôpjan (probably the regular Caus.); A.S. hweóp (cry, called out), and wepan; probably also cygan (3. conj., cl. जुहू); βοή, βοάω, probably ἀΰω and ἰωή; Lat. re-boare, and perhaps vovere, vōtum.
